row.name: Szybowcowa '87
row.detailed_description: DISCOVER THE HIDDEN PRINTING HOUSE OF FIGHTING SOLIDARITY AND IMMERSE YOURSELF IN THE SECRETS OF 80s RESISTANCE “Szybowcowa '87” transports players back to the 1980s, right into a secret printing house of Fighting Solidarity located in an apartment on Szybowcowa Street in Wrocław's Gądów district. This Virtual Reality experience allows you to explore the place where the members of the Fighting Solidarity movement produced illegal press materials in their struggle against the communist regime. With authentic resources digitized from original documents, players can immerse themselves in the atmosphere of the resistance movement, and actively participate in the events that transpired during this tumultuous period. Fighting Solidarity, a Polish anti-communist underground organization founded in Wrocław, gathered hundreds of members and thousands of supporters. It was in the printing house on Szybowcowa where underground publications were produced on semitransparent blotting paper, which was prohibited by the authorities. Key Features: A story set in the realities of the 1980s, reflecting the activities of Fighting Solidarity and the struggles of the resistance Gameplay that combines elements of exploration, the production of clandestine press, and listening to intercepted communications from the opposition. A unique opportunity to discover the historical location where underground press materials were created Intricately detailed artifacts and documents sourced from real archival materials, providing a deeper understanding of life in the People's Republic of Poland
row.short_description: Travel back in time to the 1980s and explore a secret printing house of Fighting Solidarity nestled within a residential block on Szybowcowa Street in Wrocław's Gądów district. Immerse yourself in virtual reality and feel the pulse of the underground movement during that tumultuous period.

row.name: TET
row.detailed_description: Prepare a meal for the Vietnamese Lunar New Year dinner. But hurry, your guests are arriving soon! A short hand-drawn experience full of delicious surprises. TET is a fresh and colorful cooking game. Enter the world of delicious Vietnamese food through a series of mini games. Cut the tofu, wash the cabbage, delicately roll the spring rolls, and discover the secrets of the tasty recipes. TET was created by Charlotte Broccard, a Swiss-Vietnamese illustrator and game designer, with the desire to share her cultural heritage. With special thanks to game developers Etienne Frank, Guillaume Mezino, Mario von Rickenbach, and Michael Frei for their support. Initiated at ECAL, University of Art and Design Lausanne.
row.short_description: Prepare a meal for the Vietnamese Lunar New Year dinner. But hurry, your guests are arriving soon! A short hand-drawn experience full of delicious surprises.

row.name: Ranger Quest: The Elemental Orbs
row.detailed_description: A fantasy story full of magic and intrigue that will transport you to a different time and place. Ranger Quest: The Elemental Orbs is a full length puzzle game consisting of 10 levels, each longer and more challenging than the one before it. Each one of the elemental orbs possesses a magical ability. To unlock these abilities search the libraries to find the ancient spells. You will need to use magic to advance through the levels and challenge Marduk. Activate shrines and be transported between floors. Only by moving back and forth between floors and shifting the walls of the maze will you be able to find the correct path to the exit. Ranger Quest is a 2D top down adventure game that combines exploration with the puzzle aspects of a maze. Navigate your way through each level collecting items to complete your inventory. Reach the door that marks the exit and unlock the next level to be explored. Before starting your quest, make sure to play the prequel story, Ranger Quest: The Adventure Begins. The Minotaur Maze Engine takes a classic 2D Maze and reinvents it by having the walls move. A game designed to be enjoyable and challenging for players of all ages. For anyone who has enjoyed the simple pleasure of completing a maze at some point in their lives. The Minotaur Maze Engine brings the classic maze into the 21st century. Developed with the Godot game engine. Music and sound effects obtained from ZapSplat. The Minotaur Maze Engine. The maze where the walls move.
row.short_description: Disaster has befallen you, but hope is not lost. Explore the libraries and learn the ancient incantations to unlock the full power of the Elemental Orbs. Completing your epic quest requires a showdown with the evil Grand Mage Marduk in his magical fortress.

row.name: G9:League of Aces
row.detailed_description: Story Background In the futuristic sci-fi era, humanity experienced unprecedented cataclysms due to unknown radiation. Mutated beings, known as Variants, emerged as a result of this radiation, possessing distinct appearances and special abilities. Initially, this led to conflicts and chaos worldwide as people struggled to understand and deal with these newly emerged powers. To address this situation, a new international special police force was established under the coordination of the United Nations. Equipped with advanced technology and artificial intelligence capable of countering the mutant forces, this organization worked to restore order and establish peace. As conflicts and chaos subsided, people began to embrace the powers that came with biological mutation, establishing new standards vastly different from those of the past. In this environment, a new form of competition called 'G9' emerged, featuring a diverse range of participants showcasing their unique abilities on the arena. Game Features Three Major Themed Arenas The Aces Arena (5 vs. 5) Classic 5vs5 battles on three lanes, testing teamwork and tactical planning. Mystic Island (A.R.A.M.) Random champions, single lane, no place to hide; tests champion familiarity and reflexes. Crazy Carnival (25 vs. 25) Capture points, earn points; victory is not just about breaking the enemy's towers, trample opponents with a massive army of minions. Champion Personalized Skill System Same champion, different skill combinations, will determine the champion's performance and role in each battle, offering different gameplay and strategies! Find the right skill configuration and surprise your opponents.
row.short_description: In G9: League of Aces, heroes have personalized skills, allowing players to choose combinations based on preference. Three modes offer diverse gameplay: 5 vs 5, A.R.A.M., and the original Crazy Carnival Battle Park. From high-tech enhanced heroes to superhumans and aliens, all compete for glory!

row.name: Trans-Siberian Railway Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Choose one of three game modes: develop a legitimate career as a train driver, fight for survival at all costs, or take a job for the Soviet mafia and discover the dark story of the railway underworld. Immerse yourself in the grim realities of the late '80s, where a powerful locomotive is your home, means of transport, and tool for earning money. Key Game Features: Simulation of the iconic VL10 locomotive - choose between simplified and realistic controls and procedures. Railway traffic - obey signs and signals, avoid derailments and damage to the locomotive. Repairs and maintenance - monitor part wear and replace components before disaster strikes. Economy and trade - make money transporting cargo. Buy food, tools, locomotive parts, and weapons. Sell hunting trophies, meat, loot, and scrap. Hunting and combat - use weapons for hunting, self-defense, or robbery. Law and order - the Militia keeps order, and civilians defend their resources. Survival system - control hunger, thirst, illness, hypothermia, alcohol, and hangover levels to stay alive. Weather and day-night cycle - blizzards, night, and fog affect visibility. Low temperatures can kill you. Route - a section spanning several kilometers through Novosibirsk. Buy the full version, which offers about 840 km in 1:1 scale and many places and activities to discover.

row.name: King's Hand
row.detailed_description: A classic 1v1 chess with unique cards that will help you dethrone that spoiled enemy king. Every match you get a randomly generated card with a rarity of common, epic or mythic. The rarer the card, the better the ability. Throughout the game you also have access to exchanges. You might access exchanges any time and they provide exchanging X amount of pawns for a singular piece of higher rarity (for example 3 pawns for 1 bishop). In this game there is no checkmate nor stalemate, you fight until the other king dies and then you claim his kingdom so choose wisely and you might just get another kingdom. The game currently contains offers quick match where you go against a random enemy or a friendly match where you can go against your friend and ruin your friendship. The game also offers 12 unique cards with different abilities that might be used either for offense or defense.
row.short_description: Classic 1v1 Chess, but you also have unique cards that will help you with dethroning your opponent's King. There is no checkmate nor stalemate, just a brawl between two royal families.

row.name: I commissioned some bees 0

Key features: 🐝 1000+ bees 🖼️ 10 unique artworks 💡 ∞ Unlimited hints if you get stuck ♻️ Restore a small number of bees to a painting so you can find them again! 🍯 Additional bee related objects to find 🎵 Music and ambiance for each artwork 🏆 Achievements ⌨️ Use your keyboard to move/zoom in if you have no scrollwheel 💾 3 save slots 🗑️ Reset progress entirely and play again 🕒 Timer included to show how long you took to complete each level Context: The brief was simple. I commissioned artists to create a fantasy world, and hide as many bees as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 10 art pieces to choose from, and 1000+ bees, you will have a lot of searching to do. Controls: Use your mouse to move around the image and zoom in / out. When you find a bee, click it and it will disappear. You can also use WASD to move and the arrow keys to zoom. Difficulty: A full range of difficulty is included, but all levels start unlocked, your progress is saved as you play, and you can use hints if you get stuck. Get immersed: Each painting has its own music and ambiance to help you connect with the world, as you search for all the bees. Replayable You can restore a small number of bees back into a painting so you can find them again! It’s much harder when there are only a few bees left (especially randomly). You can also use up to 3 save slots so you can replay without progress loss. Alternatively, you can reset your progress for the entire game if you’d like to start over.
row.short_description: Play for free! I paid artists to hide bees in 10 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

row.name: Missing Hiker
row.detailed_description: Missing Hiker is a short indie horror game, where your brother Ethan went missing while hiking and you try to find him. The weather is very cold, so you need to find him quickly, otherwise he could succumb to the elements. Key features: A short creepy horror experience VHS aesthetics Atmospheric ambience Immersive sound design Volumetric lighting
row.short_description: Missing Hiker is a short indie horror game, where your brother Ethan went missing while hiking and you need to find him.

row.name: Dead Pedal
row.detailed_description: You are John D. Pedal, a man who lived a normal life. He had a nice job, had a nice house, and had a goldfish, named Ted. One day, aliens struck from another world! The great worm drained the world from all of its water, and Ted was captured. Set in the Mojave, several bounties have been placed against the great worm. Several factions have gathered to destroy the worm, and claim their prize. John D. Pedal is a lone wolf in this world, and only cares about finding his goldfish, Ted. Driving and Shooting Dead Pedal is all about driving and shooting. You'll have the ability to quickly zoom around the world at fast speeds. You will have 2 weapons to choose from, including a mini-gun, and laser cannon. Your goal is to destroy everything in your way, including enemy cars, faction bases, and the great worm. Your weapons can become stronger as you destroy new faction bases, increasing your chance to destroy the big worm. Open World You are free to explore whatever you can see in Dead Pedal. Drive up hills, discover faction bases, and find the great worm. The desert is vast, and there is lots to explore. Whether you travel on the roads, or go on the dunes, there's lots to discover. The Great Worm The great worm is a dangerous threat in the world. You may challenge the worm at any point, but if you're not well prepared, you'll find it troublesome to defeat. The great worm sits in its home, dormant unless it is approached. Good luck! The Garage You can customize your car as much as you'd like! These do not affect any kind of statistics for your car, so you can stroll out into the desert how you want to be seen!
row.short_description: Dead Pedal is a 3rd person, action, open world driving game set in a fictional version of the Mojave desert, where your goal is to cause as much chaos and destruction as possible. Go out and explore the world's threats to get revenge for your fallen friend, Ted.

row.name: Office Mayhem
row.detailed_description: When a man named Matthew Jarvis realizes that he has had enough of putting up with his BS job at Macro Hard Motors, He decides to finally resign from his livelihood in a rather unprofessional manner. Matthew assassinate his shmuck of a boss MR. Grumble with a stapler gun and proceeds to inflict absolute unmerciful chaos and mayhem upon his coworkers. Play as Matthew as he psychotically destroys office furniture, eliminates coworkers, fights security guards and battles his managers to the death! Explore the Macro Hard Motors corporate office building and experience all sorts of weird and whacky scenarios with your ex colleagues. As you progress, you will be able to acquire a wide variety of destructive weapons to inflict immense damage upon your environment such as a stapler, scissors, toilet plunger, an axe, etc. Score as much mayhem points as you possibly can in order to unlock new descending floors and to eventually free yourself from this monotonous hellhole for good. Once you've played through the main story, there will be other new fun and whacky game modes to try out as well. :)
row.short_description: A third person action game where you are sick and tired of working your BS job for your BS boss. You have officially lost your mind and are ready to cause absolute mayhem and chaos in your workplace. Turn ordinary office supplies into weapons of mass destruction and destroy your colleagues!
row.notes: This product contains strong language, drug references, violence, sexual acts and themes, use of firearms, explosives, fire and cartoonish blood.

row.name: Back 4 More
row.detailed_description: Back for more is a third person strategy survival game. Teams Compete through turn-based rounds to gain the most influence over the desert! Starts with resource gathering, exchange resources for gold, more wealth = more influence. Features: Turn-Based Clan Warfare: Engage in turn-based battles against rival clans. Resource Management: Secure your influence through the accumulation of gold, stock and shares in critical resources such as Petrol, Water, Electricity, and Ammunition. Dynamic Gameplay: Experience random in-game events after each round. Side Hustle: Side missions like bird hunts and loot discoveries. Economic Strategy: Acquire gold by harvesting scattered resources like wood, metal, and fabric, then invest in items, upgrades, stocks and shares to propel your clan to victory. Strategic Depth: Make tactical decisions even outside your turn, balancing personal actions like building and gathering Back 4 more was developed by a solo developer under a year to test the concept of the game
row.short_description: Third person strategy survival game, teams Compete through turn-based rounds to gain the most influence over the desert!

row.name: SkyStrikers
row.detailed_description: SkyStrikers is a fast-paced, high-skill VR competition where every move counts. With physics-driven mechanics and real-time positioning, you'll need precision and teamwork to succeed. Choose from unique suit classes, each with special abilities designed for offense, defense, or control, and work with your team to dominate the arena. Whether rocket-jumping across the field or timing the perfect strike, Sky Strikers delivers the intensity of real-world sports in a thrilling virtual experience!   Immersive VR Sports Action : Experience the intensity of competitive aerial sports in virtual reality, where every play requires precision and skill. Social Hub for Multiplayer Fun : Meet up with friends in the Sky Strikers Social Hub, where up to 10 players can participate in casual games like Volleyball, The Floor is Lava, and HollowHoops. Ranked 3v3 Matchmaking : Test your skills in Skyball matches inside The Dome . Climb the leaderboards, earn your spot in the Hall of Heroes , and be immortalized as a top player. Unique Classes & Abilities : Choose from different suit classes, each offering distinct abilities like rocket boosters and game-changing moves to help your team win. Strategic Team Play : Work together with your teammates, combining class abilities and tactics to outmaneuver your opponents. Aerial Maneuvers : Master gravity-defying moves, soaring through the air to make the perfect play.   Join our community on Discord , or follow us on YouTube to get the latest news about the game.   Chamber 8 Studio is a VR game development studio dedicated to creating immersive and high-quality virtual reality experiences. With a passion for innovative gameplay and pushing the boundaries of VR, Chamber 8 Studio brings competitive sports to life with Sky Strikers, a game designed to challenge players and redefine what it means to compete in virtual reality.
row.short_description: SkyStrikers is a fast-paced, high-skill VR competition where every move counts. With physics-driven mechanics and real-time positioning, you'll need precision and teamwork to succeed.

row.name: TeamPunk
row.detailed_description: We must protect the Convoy. Radical advances in steam and coal technology changed the way of life in the Kingdom. This brought about prosperity and progress in society, however this progress also brought about radical climate change, destroying the flora and fauna of the country, devastating food and other resources. Convoys are sent full of resources to the smaller towns in order for them to survive. However, since raiders pose a threat to the Convoy, the Convoy is protected by Guardsmen (The Players). They need to kill these raiders, in order to protect the Convoy and to ensure the small settlements can survive. Features: Teamwork is key. Work together as a team to defend the Convoy by killing enemies and collect resources to fuel the Convoy. Choose your poison. Use different kinds of powerups to defend your teammates and the Convoy. Raiders be raidin’. Different kinds of enemies form a dangerous threat. A threat you have to stop. Fuel the Convoy or yourself. Fallen enemies drop fuel. This fuel can be used to fuel the Convoy or heal yourself. Will you sacrifice yourself for the Convoy or will you take the risk by using them on yourself? Singleplayer requires either a mouse and keyboard or a controller to play. In order to play local multiplayer, controllers are mandatory (with support up to 4 controllers). TeamPunk is a student project created by AstroDutch Studio as part of the Game Design & Development minor course at the Rotterdam University of Applied Sciences.
row.short_description: A steampunk twinstick shooter where you and your team need to work together to protect the Convoy.

row.name: Sylvio And The Mountain Giants
row.detailed_description: Play as Sylvio and explore a new world to protect. Through different passages your skill and thinking abilities will be put to the test. Gameplay This open world platformer offers a vast world to discover with many passages to unlock and monsters to avoid or face. Synopsis The lands of Yahouna had been spreading peacefully for several millennia. Born from a single seed, the forest had grown out of a desert land and made a once hostile world, welcoming. But these new riches attracted greedy explorers who had no interest in plundering them. Fortunately, the spirit of the forest was once powerful and was able to fight off these invaders by summoning the Mountain Giants. Unfortunately, the Mountain Giants disappeared little by little once their mission was completed. Alas, a new evil has come to disturb the fragile balance of the land of Yahouna. Only a clever and pure being can save them all...
row.short_description: An unknow evil has come to disturb the fragile balance of the land of Yahouna. Only a clever and pure being can save them all...

row.name: Sylvio And The Mountains Giants Playtest
Cruise Ship Manager: Prologue - Maiden Voyage
row.detailed_description: Cruise Ship Manager: Prologue - Maiden Voyage is a free version of Cruise Ship Manager. It has limited features but is just as fun! If you want to try the full version, check below! Fulfill your dreams of watching over a beautiful vessel, a large crew, and all sorts of passengers in Cruise Ship Manager! Take cruises to a next level in this unique management game. Choose how you want your cruise ship to be built, make sure everything runs smoothly, set the prices for the passengers, and become a legend of the high seas! Choosing the layout of the ship is up to you! Decide on the layout, where to place a club for your passengers, and where 5-star restaurants should be. Does a casino strike your fancy or maybe an open pool? And don't forget about rooms for your passengers! Make sure everything is well connected and that you keep enough money for food or fuel. Pick your crew wisely. Their skills will lead to your success or failure. Once you leave the dock, you're stuck with the people you chose so make sure you don't regret hiring an untested rookie over an experienced veteran. Once you settle on the amenities and prepare the necessary equipment, you can finally search for passengers to invite onto your ship. But there's a catch - it's not up to you who buys your tickets. So price your tickets accordingly. You might charge a premium if you do, your passengers will feel entitled to the best service there is and it won't be easy to satisfy them. On the other hand, you could sell the tickets at a low price and improve your budget through other means. For instance, by charging extra for fancy cocktails. As your renown grows, more people will want to experience the thrill of signing up for your cruise. Build your brand and reach a point where people will pay any amount of money, just to say they were on your cruise ship! You have the power to choose the route your cruise ship shall take. Would you rather make some quick cash on a routine, 1-day cruise? Or maybe a long journey through the Mediterranean is what strikes your fancy? You might be paid more for trips to exotic places but beware of the storms. Lives could be at stake if a fire breaks out or engines malfunction. It will be your task to end such a crisis - before it's too late. Features: A cruise ship of your own Resource management Variety of unique passengers with different expectations and behaviors Crew members that have their own needs Route selection Many unique rooms to add to your ship
row.short_description: Have a taste of managing your own Cruise Ship in this free version of Cruise Ship Manager! Maintain your vessel and sell tickets to the wealthiest of passengers. Issue orders to your crew and keep their morale high. Choose the layout of your ship and the kind of amenities you want to offer.

row.name: Crunch Time! Beat the Clock
row.detailed_description: A short dissertation project, please enjoy for what it is. Crunch Time! Beat The Clock is a third-person action platformer. Jump, Fight and Blast your way through a variety of levels in order to beat the clock once and for all! Time is finite, though you can regain it at the exchange of your health, so be careful where you step.
row.short_description: Crunch Time! Beat The Clock is a fantasy third-person action platformer. Jump, Fight and Blast your way through a variety of levels in order to beat the clock once and for all!

row.name: Subtension
row.detailed_description: Outfit, crew and command your submarine to save what's left of humanity beneath the seas of a ruined earth. Man your sub's systems and take aim in this real-time strategy epic! Inspired by FTL, this subnautic student project serves as our first 2-semester release. In Subtension, YOU get to man the helm and run your own submarine through missions in deep waters. Do you have what it takes? It won't be easy, as you come across all sorts of different problems requiring different solutions. Defeat enemy vessels and upgrade your sub. Your choices dictate your path in this story-focused experience with multiple endings. Will you be able to reach port? It's all up to what kind of captain you'll be. With this 'submarine simulation roguelike-like', you can do it all with your submarine and crew and you traverse the deep sea. Key Features: - Ship Customization. Not every ship floats the same, and reflect your captain capabilities by designing a ship fit for the job! - Over 20 fully unique ship systems - A fully voice acted, deep engaging story with twists, turns, and surprises. - Think you've figured it out? Try again with different choices to experience multiple endings to the story - Fully integrated achievements - Rich gameplay experience and atmosphere - Steam remote cloud Subtension was created by 40 people across two teams at the University of Michigan's WolverineSoft Studio, a student games studio undertaking semester long projects. It is an educational case study of Subset Game's FTL: Faster Than Light, and takes inspiration from its game mechanics as well as other games in the genre. Work on this project took place between May and December 2022. This project represents the studio's first 2-semester long project, the prototype produced by the Summer team can be found here on our steam page.
row.short_description: Outfit, crew and command your submarine to save what's left of humanity beneath the seas of a ruined earth. Man your sub's systems and take aim in this real-time strategy epic! Inspired by FTL, this subnautic student project serves as our first 2-semester release.

row.name: At the dream end
row.detailed_description: Attention: This game contains graphics that may cause discomfort and are unsuitable for younger audiences. Unlike others, we have a gift. To know what life is and to understand what makes us alive. But, like everything else, we decided to destroy that gift too. We started changing life as we see fit, and the energy that gives us life, we corrupted it and destroyed it... The question remains, Is it too late for our salvation? ABOUT THE GAME After the life energy transfer into a body of a young wolf, you set out to stop a person on the verge of destroying the planet. A person addressed as Butcher. Gameplay: Horror adventure game Theme: Fantasy, Sci-fi, Dark fairytale, Horror Languages: English Developed in: RPG Maker MZ Platform: Windows 'At the dream end' is a sci-fi story about a young wolf and a scientist involved in terrible biological experiments. It is a 2D interactive horror story made in RPG Maker MZ. Gameplay: Explore stages and solve puzzles. A bonus part of the story awaits anyone who thoroughly explores 'At the dream end' world. FEATURES Lore-rich world Multiple endings Head-scratching puzzles Immersive atmosphere Incredible sci-fi and fantasy digital art A reward for players who love to explore
row.short_description: After mind transfer into a body of a young wolf-human hybrid, you set out to stop a person on the verge of destroying our planet. A person addressed as Butcher.
row.notes: Some scenes (not very often) have blood and animal cruelty in them.

row.name: PunchMan Online
row.detailed_description: Punch, kick, bombard, and lead your team to victory or be the last one standing! Meet opponents worldwide, compete, and prove that you're the champion! PunchMan Online is a multiplayer battle arena that supports cross-platform-play and cross-progression via your PunchMan Online Account. ■ Featuring - Multiple game modes - Random, custom, and private match - Tons of customizable items - Multiple tournaments and challenges - In-game communication (chat, message) - In-game friend features etc. Keep battling, respect each other, and remember to keep fun! Enjoy! *)Items shown may require separate purchases from the in-game store and are subject to availability. Contains in-game purchases.

PunchMan Online is a multiplayer battle arena that supports cross-platform-play and cross-progression via your PunchMan Online Account.

row.name: Third
row.detailed_description: Note This game is a student project in Fall 2022, EAE 3720, University of Utah. About the Game You wake up in a room. A man talks through the speaker welcomes you and invites you to participate in an experimental game. However, the game is not what you thought, and you seem to be intentionally trapped. You must try to solve puzzles to escape while the creator of the game attempts to fool you. As you get deeper into the experiment, you realize that something else is wrong... Inspired by The Witness , The Stanley Parable , and The Pervert's Guide to Ideology , Third is an 2D top-down adventure game. Explore the endless cycle and discover the deepest secret of the evil experiment.
row.short_description: An experimental serious meta game.

row.name: KoreanWarMemorial
row.detailed_description: 'Thanks to the veterans for their service' The Korean War Memorial is a metaverse memorial hall that discovers and informs the battles that have not been noticed and forgotten in history for various reasons during the Korean War. Korean War Memorial is a first-person game, not a dynamic game, but a game where you visit and tour the memorial. Since it is a memorial hall, calm and calm content is the main focus. It will be added free of charge whenever additional content is completed in the future.
row.short_description: A country that has been at war for over 70 years, Korea. There are countless battles that the country has fought, some famous, but others forgotten. The Korean War Memorial is a metaverse memorial hall established to publicize forgotten battles and forgotten battles.

row.name: Clicker Guardians
row.detailed_description: Community About the Game Join the ranks of the Clicker Guardians in this thrilling idle clicker. Together with warriors, mages and rogues, you’ll embark on an epic journey to save the realm from an ancient evil. You’ll battle hordes of monsters and powerful bosses using a variety of weapons and abilities. It all starts with a single click! Plays Like a Clicker, Feels Like an RPG Amass mountains of gold, resources and experience which can be reinvested in your character and companions. Make use of the free crafting system to get your hands on the rarest of items. You’ll be spoiled for choice on what to upgrade next. Your Unusual Usual Enemies Encounter lots of interesting fantasy monsters, all reimagined in a unique voxel look. Turn them to dust by fighting them yourself or lean back and let your fellow Guardians do the job. Clicker Guardians equally supports active and passive playstyles. Enough Content to Click for a Lifetime Progress through a plethora of stages and ascend the ranks of your guild to fight increasingly powerful bosses. Guardians never sleep, as there is always a new quest around the corner! Unlock Content in Hometown Dive deep into the heart of your hometown as you unlock exciting new content. Craft powerful weapons and armor to become an unstoppable force. Upgrade your skills and enchant your gear in the magical forge to reach new heights of power. Feature Overview Reliable companions Customizable loadouts Craftable equipment Individual skill trees Incremental difficulty levels Seasonal events Special dungeons
row.short_description: A true RPG clicker in which you need to loot, craft and refine your equipment to come out on top. Loyal guild members will help you along your mystical journey to defeat goblins, skeletons and adequately dressed frogs!

row.name: Lesson Learned: Cult of the Elizabeth
row.detailed_description: Help Amelia on her journey through the Renaissance and enter the bizarre world of dreams! Gather resources, build towers, and fend off waves of Elizabeth Bathory's helpers. Face a horde of fanatics who want to help the aristocrat in her nefarious plans. Free your classmates and use their help to get out of this troublesome dream. CLASSIC TOWER DEFENSE Where there are towers there must be waves of enemies! You will meet a bloody countess who has made history on your way! This dreamy world is full of strange and twisted creatures that are her minions. TOWERS, UPGRADES, AND MINIONS Collect resources such as wood and stone to build and upgrade defensive towers. In addition to the slingshot, they will be your main defense against opponents. Use your helpers in battle, assign them simple tasks, and defend your spider base - Jarvis! CO-OP AND SINGLE-PLAYER GAME MODES Embark on this amazing adventure in this crazy world either solo or with a bunch of your best friends in split-screen co-op mode.
row.short_description: Help Amelia defeat Elizabeth Bathory's henchmen in this amazing Tower Defense game. Enter a bizarre daydream world in co-op or solo mode. Gather resources, build defense towers, and manage your classmates. Take up the challenge and defeat the incoming enemies!

row.name: Football Manager 2024
row.detailed_description: Reviews About the Game Step into the shoes of a real boss and write your own football story in Football Manager 2024, the most complete edition in the series yet. Whether you’re a manager who likes to build from the bottom or prefers to chase immediate glory, the perfect challenge awaits. The arrival of the new Meiji Yasuda Insurance Ltd J. League licence unlocks J1 League, J2 League, J3 League for the first time ever, giving you the opportunity to explore new horizons in Japan. Wherever you manage, it's up to you to build a team capable of competing with the world's elite. Game Description Continue your relentless journey to the top of the footballing world by using the new ability to import your existing career from Football Manager 2023. Craft a winning tactical approach, incorporating modern football’s most popular systems and cutting-edge positional innovations to deliver victories on the pitch. Master the transfer market, using new ways to shape your side to cultivate a squad capable of achieving your goals. Level up your players on the training field, developing the mentality and teamwork needed to transform contenders into champions. See your tactical vision come to life on Matchdays, with every game elevated by improvements to ball and player movements. NEW FOR THIS SEASON TRUER FOOTBALL MOTION Enhancements to player animations, ball physics and lighting deliver the most immersive Match Engine in Football Manager history. Move to the cutting edge of football by using the new Inverted Full-Back player role, while more intelligent player rotational movements add more fluidity to every highlight. DOMINATE FROM SET PIECES Make an impact at both ends of the pitch with an overhauled Set Piece Creator. Lean on the expertise of brand-new Set Piece Coaches to develop winning routines in every scenario that will help you to outsmart your rivals. BRACE FOR TRANSFER BATTLES Showcase your squad-building skills in our most refined transfer market yet. You’ll face a trickier battle for talent as your rival opposition managers are now more strategic than ever in their recruitment decision-making. NEW AGENTS TO BUILD A DREAM SQUAD Better shape your perfect squad with the introduction of new Intermediaries that will help you offload surplus players for a cut of the final transfer fee. Additional functionality for existing Agents and the debut of TransferRoom, a football marketplace for transfers in real life, gives you more real-world powered tools than ever to build an elite team and dominate the competition. ELEVATE PERFORMANCES WITH TARGETS Motivate your team to achieve more on and off the field by setting them individual Targets. Whether you’re focusing on goals scored in a season or average training performances, challenge your star players and top prospects to maximise their ability. A HOST MORE ADDITIONS Enjoy greater variety in every career with the arrival of two new game modes. Real World mirrors when players actually joined your club. Your World sets club squads and budgets at the day your career starts, meaning that only players who joined before that date will be in your squad, giving you the opportunity to rewrite your team’s transfer window. Elsewhere, you can look to dominate international management and plan for your country's future with a revamped National Pool that gives you a better overview of the talent at your disposal. Match preparation and briefing meetings deliver you winning insights before each fixture. That’s not all though, with many more changes waiting for you to discover in every career. This version contains information that is still under approval process by rights holders and may contain data that does not, at this time, accurately reflect real world data. For context, some club and player assets may be absent during this version.
row.short_description: Build a world-class team ready to dominate your rivals in football’s most prestigious competitions. Progress never stops when you’re pursuing footballing greatness.

row.name: Quest Master's Realm
row.detailed_description: The Realm Enter the Quest Master's Realm, a Realtime Action based World of Fantasy MMORPG. Adventure aboard the Shell of a Gigantic Turtle, 'Great Crom', as he swims throughout the Etherverse. Open World Single Server - No Instances. Same Character - Different Roles Play one Character, in a variety of Roles. Switch between Skill Sets defining your Abilities and Equipment. Follow Quel or Hel As Followers of Quel, the God of Light, or Hel, Goddess of the Underworld, you have the Gift of Resurrection. 'On the back of Crom we sail' - Youtube Gameplay : Fight Battle Opposing Forces. Fast Paced Melee and Ranged Action Combat. Multiplayer. PvP and PvE. Craft Craft and Discover New Items of increasing Rarity. Level Level up your Skills and Equipment as you prepare to meet the most Mythic of Enemies. Quest Deep Questing Elements lead to new Achievements and Opportunities. Online Server Access Buying this game package entitles you to access our online Multiplayer Game Servers, Normally available 24 / 7 in both Europe and America. Can play from outside these zones, just expect different latencies. Our Discord Our Discord server is quite active. People there will be able to respond to any cries for help, information, or just to chat about the game and anything else. If you are unhappy in any way please try to contact us here before leaving bad reviews. We can likely fix any issues you are experiencing. The game is still in an early state of development and we value any feedback or suggestions you might offer. Requests for new features are warmly received and can, quite possibly, be added to the game relatively quickly. Click below or on discord icon in game login panel to join.
row.short_description: Realtime Action Combat MMORPG. Battle Foes and Complete Quests to Level up your Skills and Equipment. Prepare to face the most Mythic of Enemies. Swap between different Skill Sets whilst playing the Same Character. Craft and Discover New Items of Increasing Rarity. Open World - No Instances.

row.name: BRIGHT TRACER
row.detailed_description: Dash through at the speed of light. ----- This is a high-speed running action game to run through a cyberspace world being invaded by a virus. Dash through the stages at the light speed to quickly get to the viruses’ boss A high-speed running seamless action！ You gradually accelerate by chaining various actions seamlessly, such as wall-run, sliding, and wire-hook. Dash through the stages elegantly at a high-speed by linking a series of actions. Stylish battles to dodge and sweep away enemies！ You perform ''Dodge and Counter-Attack'' by taking actions at the right timing to dodge enemy attacks. By succeeding, you gain further acceleration and bonuses, allowing you to ride at top speed. Actively dodge and sweep away many enemies. Time Attack！ You are ranked by your clear time. Aim to reach your destination faster and achieve an S+ rank. Save the world as fast....ǔ,,~ -$as`-■y-ā-■▮-- This title was developed by our newest developers who planned and carried out the entire process from planning to development, and reached the release by overcoming many challenges, including using the next-generation game engine ''Unreal Engine 5''. This title was created for those who want to play a fast-paced responsive game. Enjoy the responsive dash as you run through stages non-stop with intuitive controls.
row.short_description: ”BRIGHT TRACER' is a high-speed running game to. Dash through a cyberspace world being invaded by a viruse. You stylishly advance through the stages stylishly using various actions such as wall-run and wire-hook. Run, jump, dodge enemies and obstacles through the world to get to the viruses’ boss.

row.name: Terix Survivors
row.detailed_description: Terix Survivors is a time survival game with minimalistic gameplay and roguelite elements. Hell is empty, the devils are here, and there's no place to run or hide. All you can do is survive as long as you can until death inevitably puts an end to your struggles. Gather gold in each run to buy upgrades and help the next survivor. The supernatural indie phenomenon that lets you be the bullet hell!
row.short_description: Mow down thousands of Monsters and survive until dawn! Terix Survivors is a gothic horror casual game With Many Visible Powers . That Help You To Fight where your Character choices can allow you to quickly snowball against the hundreds of monsters that get thrown at Are you a Hero or a Noob! Show Us

row.name: Sim Companies
row.detailed_description: Become a Business Tycoon. Build your own company from the ground up. Start small: Develop your company: Do business in a virtual economy with players all around the world! Gain valuable business skills for free. An advanced, proprietary, Economy simulation model is used to deliver the best gaming experience. Have you ever wondered what it would be like to build your own company, to be a tycoon? Do you want to measure your skills against other players in a virtual economy? Do you want to own a production, retail or research company which pays out the best? It all depends on the current conditions in the virtual economy and how skillful you are in spotting business opportunities. Sim Companies is an extremely versatile browser game that allows you to experiment with various resources and test your skills against other players in the game. Sim Companies is a business simulation strategy game aimed at giving you the fun and experience of managing a company using real world economic principles. The goal of the game is to create a profitable and competitive business. Each player receives a starting capital and few assets. Players' day-to-day tasks consist of managing the resource supply chain, from production to selling in retail, procuring business partners, ensuring financing, etc. For players to prosper, they would have to be able to read market conditions and take some trading shortcuts here and there, maybe buy their input resources on market cheaper than if they produced them or sell them on the market with higher profit than in the retail. When should players invest into research? We thought about what makes company management fun and what makes it tedious. Sim companies' philosophy is to let you take the interesting decisions while building your own business without having to fill in tons of extra settings. We do not want to simulate the real world with all its law and other restrictions, but rather give players the freedom to make decisions that can impact their company finances and value.
row.short_description: Become a Business Tycoon. Build your own company from the ground up. Do business in a virtual economy with players all around the world! Gain valuable business skills for free. An advanced, proprietary, Economy simulation model is used to deliver the best gaming experience.

row.name: Rescue Dash - Management Puzzle
row.detailed_description: It's total chaos in the city: all the animals in the local zoo have escaped! Seals, dogs, rabbits, raccoons—they all need rescuing and returning home! The rescue team, led by the brave Jessica, zooms off to help everyone and restore peace and order in the city. Exciting challenges are waiting! Enjoy the variety of locations and emergencies! Rescuers are always in demand! Get to work in a hotel, supermarket, restaurant, movie studio, on a cruise liner, and a farm. You'll be driving a fire truck, removing trash, rebuilding roads, renovating buildings, and saving animals and feeding them tasty treats. Try your hand as a firefighter, beach lifeguard, and emergency worker! To complete your mission, you'll have to move fast, think smart, and be a team player! Over the course of your quest, you'll need to collect and use resources. Develop your own strategy and complete tasks as efficiently as possible. Use your brain to win! And don't forget about the time limit! Try to solve the puzzles in time!
row.short_description: Rescue Dash is a fascinating city rescue time management game. You'll save pets, restore a hotel, renovate a diner, and keep the city safe! Move through the story and help everyone on this adventure!

row.name: Tribe Dash - Stone Age Time Management
row.detailed_description: Experience the life of a tribal leader from the Stone Age! Hunt, collect resources, trade, scare off wild animals, and search for treasure. Allocate resources Collect essential resources to clear rubble, defend against tiger attacks, and much more. Trade resources with a merchant at favorable rates and distribute responsibilities among fellow tribesmen. Explore the area The game has many exciting levels of varying difficulty. Discover the world of the Stone Age, find food, and defeat enemies as quickly as possible. Get rewards Get bonuses for completing levels quickly. Get chests, diamonds, various boosters, and many other rewards when you complete missions! Take care of the Dinosaur Feed the cute dinosaur in order to get help and survive in the Stone Age.
row.short_description: Tribe Dash is a Stone Age time management simulator! Hunt, collect resources, and search for treasure on lost islands playing as the leader of a Stone Age tribe in this exciting adventure game!

row.name: Project Screwed
row.detailed_description: Note: Project Screwed is designed to be played with Xbox controllers! Attempting to play it on keyboard or other gamepads will work but is not supported. In this stressful 4-player couch coop game you take on the dangerous task of mining for the most rare material in the galaxy; Rareium. To accomplish this task, you will have to work together with your friends to try to survive the waves of enemies wanting to destroy your base as you try to manage both time and resources in order to meet all the requirements of the base. The game takes place in a not so distant galaxy where you play as an elite taskforce sent by the government of Badville on a mission to secure as much Rareium as possible in order to have enough materials to penetrate Goodvilles planet-spanning shield during next years 'throw rocks at Goodville' festival. Defend Your Base Defend your base against waves of angry enemies that seek to destroy your base and disrupt your Rareium acquiring efforts. Use the Cannons to shoot apart any of the multitude of different threats on the hostile alien planets you visit throughout your playthrough. You can also utilize the cannons shield to deflect against enemy attacks, if you manage to aim it in time. Work Together... Or Don't Work together with up to 3 other friends or foes locally to defend and manage all of your bases needs. Man the cannons, refill the ammo storage, fix broken machines, repair the dome, operate the miner and more. Although you all technically are on the same team, that doesn't mean that there isn't any room for screwing over your friends as the chaos ensues. Upgrade Your Base... Through Gambling? As the rounds continue you and your friends will be able to upgrade the different components of your base such that it can withstand the multitude of stronger and stronger waves that will be thrown at you as time progresses. The only downside is that you will have to sacrifice some of your hard earned progress by buying 'upgrade boxes'. Each box contains three different upgrades that you and your friends will have to decide which one to pick in order to better your odds of surviving and earning more Rareium so you can gamble even more (I swear this is a totally necessary gameplay mechanic and not just an excuse for us to add gambling into our game). Progress Through a Vibrant And Distinct Galaxy Journey though a beautifully realized galaxy with unique and original planetary designs as you tear the planets apart and ruin complex and fragile ecosystems in your search for more Rareium to throw at your neighbours. Each of the 30+ planet portrayed with stunning 2D pixel art. Unique Level Mechanics Throughout the games 30+ levels you will have to play around different level mechanics like portals that teleports you across the level, doors that can only be opened one at a time, jumping pads that launch you high into the sky, tubes that transport you around and much more. About Lonely Oni Interactive Lonely Oni Interactive is a small indie studio from Norway with 5 young developers with little to no funding and an aspirations of one day working in the games industry. We really appreciate all the support for our game and hope to deliver the best couch coop experience that we can to the people that chose to put their well earned money on the line to buy our game!
row.short_description: Work together with your friends in this stressful 4-player couch co-op game as you defend against hordes of enemies trying to destroy your base. Manage both your time and your resources in an effort to balance all the needs of your base. Are you and your friends up for the task?

row.name: Total War: PHARAOH - Early Access Weekend
Blacksmith Simulator Prologue
row.detailed_description: Blacksmith Simulator Prologue is a free, short version of Blacksmith Simulator. We want to show you the main mechanics, so in the Prologue you can finish the first 2 hours. Gameplay will be limited to few quests compared to the full game. Story In the uncertain times of the Middle Ages, every town needs its blacksmith! Pick up your hammer and heat the forge as you prepare to keep your customers pleased. From wandering knights-errant to the local butcher, everyone needs your metalworking skill. Use your knowledge to craft the finest weapons and tools around. Upgrade your workshop, expand your business, and get access to even better materials and techniques as you gain more customers. Forging Forging is the core of all metalworking. To excel as a blacksmith, you must master furnace control, heating, hammering, tempering, and more! The interactive environment of Blacksmith Simulator makes forging a game of fast-paced multitasking, skill, and order management. Your forging prowess will affect your business, as better forging produces higher-quality items. Keep your product quality high to grow your business and attract more customers! Materials As your forge grows, so will your selection of materials to forge with. Better weapons can be crafted as access to more exotic materials becomes available. Every day, you can venture to your own ore cave to mine what you need. When you have the money, expand your cave to uncover better ores! Customers Reputation will make or break your blacksmithing career. Keep customers happy and provide high-quality workmanship to raise your reputation and receive more lucrative contracts! Happy customers are the key to success. Upgrade As your business expands, so will your workshop needs. Upgrade your equipment as you progress to support your growing reputation. Better equipment is a must to use exotic ores and to complete more rewarding contracts!
row.short_description: Forge your destiny in the Blacksmith Simulator Prologue! Craft weapons and tools, manage your workshop, and mine for resources. Serve diverse clients, grow your reputation, and master medieval craftsmanship in this free introduction to the full game. Your journey as a blacksmith begins here!

row.name: Squirrel Launcher
row.detailed_description: Hey YOU! Yeah, you there! Come here! Your presence has been requested for this here space program! You are to follow me to the nest! There you will be assigned to R.R. (Researcher Robin) and put in charge of advancing our state-of-the-art squirrel flight technology. Why do you ask? Because! Squirrel Intelligence said so! We are to get to the moon! I’m sure this cannon is enough. Your safety is my number one priority! Now sign this here waiver. And so, it begins. Will you guide the squirrels to the moon? Or will the squirrel space program be doomed to fail? Launch Squirrels You will be tasked with launching squirrels into the atmosphere and upgrading their equipment to get further. Get to the Moon! Go where no squirrel has gone before! The moon is quite far away and squirrels might not understand just how much of a task this is, but with your help, they just might make it.
row.short_description: Launch squirrels into the atmosphere and explore the clouds. Dodge and shoot down obstacles – upgrade your vehicle to make it further and further until you get to the moon!

row.name: We're Party Together!
row.detailed_description: There are two operating keys on the keyboard that you use to move frequently. WASD and arrow keys. What if there is a game that can be played with only these familiar eight keys? This is my first game. This game is a casual game aimed at playing mini-games such as fishing or flipping the card to score points, and eventually setting the ranking, and it can be played alone or by two people. There are 10 mini-games in two ways of playing: collecting a lot of points within a given time or quickly gathering the required points. Let's set own new record! And Please look at my imaginary world. When you achieve certain achievements, you will be given the opportunity to know the characters' information or the names of other characters from the mini-game.
row.short_description: Easy to understand and simple casual game. Let's play 10 mini-games using WASD and arrow keys and run for a new record!

row.name: Paranoia Party
row.detailed_description: An online social deduction party game where you need to find and kill your friends that hide among a group of NPC's. Enhances your abilities on pickup Shorter cooldowns Features An easy built in level editor Can be played with up to 16 players Simple gameplay, complex mechanics Quickly host a game for your friends to join
row.short_description: An online social deduction party game for 2-16 players where you need to find and kill your friends that hide among a group of NPC's.

row.name: The Starving Tournament
row.detailed_description: The Starving Tournament will be a Multiplayer Survival Game, loosely based on the 'The Hunger Games' movies. The open alpha version is already available for public access. Try our open alpha, report bugs or give us your ideas to make it the best game it can be. About the project Being fascinated of the 'Hunger Games' arena idea and for the lack of a real game for the movies / books we wanted to start our own 'Hunger Games' fan project. So we started 'The Starving Tournament' - a tournament where 20 players will be put into differently designed arenas with traps, monsters and other dangers. But the biggest dangers are the other players and the HUNGER Will you be the last one standing and win the Starving Tournament? We are aware of the fact, that there have been other 'Hunger Games' like games before, but we want to go a step further and take more features from the actual 'Hunger Games' movie into our Game 'The Starving Tournament'. You can help us to achieve this goal, by downloading and playing the alpha version of the game, report us bugs, give us Feedback and help us to build an amazing GAME!! Feel free to share your ideas, wishes etc. in the comments or write a message. Implemented Features so far (In-Development Alpha Version): - survival/FPS Basics (fall damage, healing, swimming, hunger / thirst, stamina, energy) - melee and range weapons (bow & arrow, spear, sword, throw-knifes, dropping weapons) - medikit 'gifts' - multiplayer (via PUN 2) - chat / statistics - minimap - HUD - day/night Cycle - statistics panel for Kill/Death/Ping - bots (with prototype 'AI') - spectator mode (spectator will act as sponsor) - climbable trees - food / drink from water - energy / sleep - different damages if feet / arms / head are hit - slowed down fighting or running if arm or feet are wounded - choose between round based / unlimited - mines planned features for Beta and Later: - more arenas - random arena - more traps and other dangers - more gifts from sponsors - betting/ sponsoring System - different characters with different characteristics/attributes - weather - more weapons - gamemaker mode Controls: Normal Mode: WASD/Arrow Keys + Mouse – Move Shift – run Cmd - Crouch Space - jump E – use / take / eat F –flashligh M – minimap C – Toggle 3-rd Person/First Person Camera T – Chat TAB - statistics 1 – Weapon slot 1 (melee) 2 – Weapon slot 2 (range) Mouse 1 – fire weapon / hit Mouse 2 – fire weapon / aim MouseWheel – change weapon Esc – Pause Menu / Close Pause Menu Spectator Mode: WASD/Arrow Keys + Mouse – Move Shift – move / fly faster E – Buy Menu F – Cinematic Mode (Prototype) T – Chat TAB - statistics Mouse 1 – Place object (when selected in buy menu)
row.short_description: The Starving Tournament will be a Multiplayer Survival Game, loosely based on the 'The Hunger Games' movies. The open alpha version is already available for public access. Try our open alpha, report bugs or give us your ideas to make it the best game it can be.
row.notes: The game might end in violent fighting scenes with stylized blood. The blood and fighting is not very realistic though.

row.name: IOUA
row.detailed_description: 'Good luck down there, Spelunker. You're going to need it.' A modern RPG MAKER nightmare set in a desolate landscape of a crumbling software. Solve oblique and confusing puzzles inside the remnants of forgotten games. Discover and decrypt their strange way of living and religion. Ascend, it's all they want you to do anyways. Communicate with it's disfunctional residents, who are unimaginable creatures who take the form of common household items and furniture. They're also British (Gross!). 2 hour - 9999 hour playtime
row.short_description: An endless torture game set in the distorted remnants of forgotten RPGMaker puzzles.
row.notes: HInt to physcial harm, and abuse. Lots of threatening. Archaic influence.

row.name: Regenesis
row.detailed_description: The game Years ago an alien plant scattered spores through all the planet. This has caused the flora and fauna to mutate. Years have passed and the remaining survivors have gotten used to the new world. Follow the story of Isak, Kaeo and Ola, members of a group of survivors settled on the underground of a city. Regenesis is a tactical rpg game. You, the player, have control over three diferent and customizable units. You will need to gear up in your base and equip your units with a variety of equipment. When you feel that you are ready, choose a mission and start the hunt! When you get into the mission you will fight against powerful mutated animals. Each hunt will be diferent, adaptation is the key if you want to survive. To top it all, Regenesis uses a dynamic timeline system to decide the order of turns. When the turn of a hunter starts you will have to choose your actions wisely. At the end of a turn the unit goes back to the start of the timeline and starts moving at diferent speeds. The speed will change depending on the number and the actions it has performed. What makes Regenesis unique? There are not rigid turns, instead turns are ordered dynamically in the timeline. Fight against powerful mutated creatures to survive. Customize your hunters to fit your playstyle. Project made for the B.A. in Interactive Product Design, B.F.A. in Animation and B.F.A. in Digital Design degrees of U-tad, University of Technology, Arts and Design.
row.short_description: Guide a group of survivors trying to strive in this alien yet familiar environment. Fight against mutated creatures and use their parts to craft and upgrade your weapons.

row.name: Taxi Copter
row.detailed_description: Taxi Copter is a precise platform game that will test your dexterity in a pixel art style. Relax with retro beat music in a modern form, prepared especially for you. Avoid the pigeons. Remember that every collision, hard landing or passenger push results in the loss of points and irreparable damage to the helicopter! Let's go, a big city full of passengers awaits! Transport everyone!
row.short_description: Take on the role of a Taxi Copter driver. Pick up passengers and drive them to their destination, avoid pigeons, earn money, get stars and unlock more levels. Fight against the gravity, be gentle, it's a helicopter, not a tank! A city full of passengers (and pigeons!) is waiting for you!

row.name: Sorcerers Summit
row.detailed_description: An army of contraptions swarm the skies, and it is up to you, a lone sorcerer to defend the castle wall. LET NONE PASS! Move quickly, dash quicker, and bam, boom, blast them out of the sky with your magic. See how long you can last in this simple and stylish score attack game. Easy to learn controls for young acolytes to ancient sorcerers. Leaderboards to compete against your foes and friends. 2 game modes: Endless and Timed. Endless - Keep playing until a contraption escapes. Timed - 45 seconds of mayhem. Dash in, have fun!
row.short_description: An army of contraptions swarm the skies, and it is up to you, a lone sorcerer to defend the castle wall. LET NONE PASS! Move quickly, dash quicker, and bam, boom, blast them out of the skies with your magic. See how long you can last in this simple and stylish score attack game.

row.name: Parts Unknown
row.detailed_description: ---This game was revamped on 1\18\2025--- Parts Unknown is an online fighting game aiming to recapture the spirit of old fighting games with a unique style. It gives the player different fighting styles to master. If you loved games like Def Jam Vendetta, Street Fighter, Ready 2 Rumble Boxing, or The Warriors, then you are sure to love this game. Inspired by classic street fighting games like Def Jam Fight For NY, Parts Unknown combines stylish in depth fighting styles, beautiful music, and an online experience to keep you engaged. Parts Unknown is a third person fighting game innovating ReadyPlayerMe technology to create a metaverse experience. The game in its current state features 2 open worlds, a gym to workout, different fighting styles, and autosave. Online Multiplayer is now available.
row.short_description: Parts Unknown is an online fighting game aiming to recapture the spirit of old fighting platformers with a unique twist.

row.name: Dark Days : Devil Hunt Prologue
row.detailed_description: Many years ago, demons, monsters, goblins and dragons had invaded the world. Many creatures, from where and how they came, were killing the people and reigning in the lands they occupied. Until a very talented wizard shows up. This sorcerer sealed the main demon Azazil and all creatures with a spell called the death spell and imprisoned him in a pandora's box in a room of a vast mountain. And the price was the death of the mage. And the world was at peace again. Centuries have passed and no one, except for very rare people, was even aware of the existence of these creatures. Until a treasure hunter discovers the hidden cave and opens Pandora's box.. Ares is a warrior medieval people, his wife died many years ago, lives with a son and has no magic abilities. He carries the holy spirit of the sorcerer whose son died many years ago,and no one knows about it. Ares is injured when demons attack their village during a walk with his son, and his son is kidnapped by a demon. Azazil is aware of this soul and learns from the diamond ball that this soul is in a child, but he does not know who it is. If the child dies, Azazil dies at the same time. The magic of the wizard who imprisoned him in Pandora's box circulates in his blood. The devils are gathering all the children in the villages. Azazil wants to detect the child with his own magic and neutralize this spell. Then, a creature that takes Ares' son to the temple is shot by an archer and the child falls into the middle of a mountain, lonely and helpless. Ares seeks the help of a most talented and knowledgeable wizard to find his son and avenge all that has happened. and he goes on this way, his magic ability develops over time Will Ares find his son? Will he save the world? What will happen to other peoples? Is he alone? Different scenarios for each different nationality with shield and flag selection and customizable at start. Many side quests outside the main story such as fishing, riding horses, helping a villager, digging a field. 87 different melee weapons such as Ax, Sword, Halberd, Bardiche, Bilhook, Dagger, Shield, Heavy Sword, Mace, Messer, Partisan, Angled Axe, Sax, Spear, Voulge, Warhammer and Zweihander More than 50 magic abilities such as Ice and Death Rain Strike A beautiful and realistic world with the best graphics and many views Collectable Collectibles (gold, parchment, memories, diaries, etc.) With the Advanced Crafting System, the system of producing elixirs from collectible mushrooms and gaining life Climbable walls, many accessible houses
row.short_description: Fight with many demon goblin golems that invaded all over the Middle Ages Use your special powers.

row.name: Max Massacre
row.detailed_description: Max Massacre is a Visual Novel with a single choice to determine the ending. In a world filled with monsters, demons, and other inhuman creatures, mankind is no longer the dominant race. Humans are nothing more than cattle, fed on by more powerful entities and hunted down for sport. Humans in general are weak, not even a match for the children of those who hunt them, and they know it. The human race is steadily declining, and before long, mankind will exist no longer. As a child born into such a world, Max aspires to become a hero. A mighty warrior who will save the human race from the cusp of extinction, wielding strength unheard of for a boy on the brink of adulthood. He is already the strongest fighter in his village in hand to hand combat, and he has killed his fair share of low-level monsters. At seventeen years of age, he is well on his way to becoming the hero he aspires to be, and no matter how much his fellow villagers hate and scorn him for his demonic aura, Max wishes to save every one of them. Forever by Max's side is his childhood friend and love interest, Celeste. Like Max, she possesses incredible strength, and is by far the strongest sorceress in the village. She is knowledgeable, intelligent, well-liked, and quite attractive; a truly fortunate young woman in almost every way imaginable. However, beneath this amiable exterior is a mind far more cynical and unforgiving. She does not share Max's outlook on life, nor does she condone his desire to become a hero, or to protect those who harm him. To her, humans are no better than the demons oppressing them, and she would happily leave their village in flames, if only Max would go with her. As Max and Celeste go about their routine lives in the small village they call home, their differing views on the world clash every day, with each one trying to convince the other to see the light. But with the other villagers all living in fear and contempt of Max, and not hesitating for a moment to show how they feel, Celeste has a clear advantage. She believes it's only a matter of time before Max realizes what a fool he has been, and with the level of malice being directed towards Max increasing day by day, she might be right. Will Max manage to convince Celeste that the human race is worth protecting? Or will Celeste prove to Max once and for all that his enemy is not demonkind, but the familiar faces of those who deny his humanity?
row.short_description: A visual novel set in a monster-filled fantasy world
row.notes: Contains fantasy violence, crude language and mild sexual themes

row.name: Survive Now
row.detailed_description: Survive Now is a top-down stylized survival game with roguelite elements. Each level lasts for 40 minutes, and while surviving until the end may seem easy, but no one can complete any level in a single try Supports mouse, keyboard controller support will come in the next update Features & Quick tips Dozens of skill available to learn and upgrade Collect energy to learn new skills and upgrade exising skills Maximum 7 weapon skill you can use at once
row.short_description: In this thrilling top-down roguelite survival game, you'll face off against hordes of creatures in a desperate battle for survival. You'll need to collect energy to unlock new skills and upgrade existing ones, and every moment counts as you fight your way through waves of monsters.

row.name: Bad Friends Shooter
row.detailed_description: Fight against your friends on one device Obtain stronger weapons that are spawned on the levels Each level offers different experience, fight in the desert, on top of castle, in hell etc. BEWARE no Solo mode so far, you need at least one other player to play the game on your device! The game is meant for 2 – 4 players on one physical device. They try to kill each other in 3 different modes. You can choose from several playable levels, with each of them being different with unique design and mechanics. You can also pick up randomly spawned weapons to gain competitive edge above your foes. Game Modes: Classic Deathmatch – game ends when one of the players reaches goal score, thus winning the match. Timed Deathmatch – match lasts given amount of time, after the time limit is out players are ranked by the amount of players they killed. Last Man Standing – each player has set amount of health points. As soon as the player is killed, one of his health points is lost. As soon as he reaches 0 health points he is out of the game and match continues until there is only one player left.
row.short_description: Play against your friends on one device in this action packed game! Available for up to 4 players on one device.

row.name: Stinky and Loof in Wonderland Playtest
Lichtreich: Willa
row.detailed_description: Lichtreich Universe ✬✬✬✬✬ Lichtreich. The only island where mutants can live peacefully among people. Fear which ordinary people abroad feel forces mutants to find a better place. There are only few mutants, most of them are from military, other are result of the experiments and abductions. Most of them have special magical skills and the most dangerous are - Yokai. Only fraction of mutants can be called Yokai, They're at the top of hierarchy. My father was one of them, that's why he became detective. He did that to help all the people and mutants on the island. I want to be just like him - to be able to change the world! Unfortunately, he died on my hands while saving lives. I have a dream to be just like him, so I followed his footsteps. My name is Alex and I'm detective on the Lichtreich island! About Game ✬✬✬✬✬ 2D horror game with strong story focus. As a detective which dealt the most with infamous 'Viper', Alex is the best choice to check his mansion. You have to find out if there any people alive? There is no time to waste, you have to check it! This game highly emphatises with careful exploration. You have to be sure to make your choices wise. All of your steps in the game matter. Features ✬✬✬✬✬ Unique story! Lichtreich island story told for the first time! Your choices matter! Game story adjust to your choices! Test your skills! Complete quests wisely with help of you in game log! Challenge yourself! QTE, mysteries and challenges waits for you in the mansion!
row.short_description: Detective Alex got the case to check Viper mansion. When her owner was alive he kept there ordinary people to mutate them. Can you find out how many alive people you can find? Be sure to check every corner!
row.notes: Exorcism, mutation, kidnapping, death, suicide, blood.

row.name: Ecto
row.detailed_description: Ecto is a highly-randomized nature world that doesn't take itself too seriously. Your goal is to collect the star fragments which are scattered throughout the level... but that's not the main point of this game. Along the way, you can click almost everything in the level for some sort of whimsical reaction. Collect coins to buy peculiar trinkets from Froggieman's shop to mess around with. You can even compete with yourself (or your friends) to set record speedrunning times between randomly placed islands. ROADMAP: [X] Started Development of Ecto (October 2022) [X] Prototype Version 1.0 (October 6th 2023) [X] Prototype Version 2.0 (January 12th 2024 [X] Prototype Version 3.0 (April 4th 2024) [X] Steam Prototype Release (April 30th 2024) [X] Pre-Alpha 1.0 | Boss and Progression Update (November 11th 2024) [X] Pre-Alpha 2.0 | BIG UPDATE / Scavenger Hunt Update (March 13th 2025) [X] Pre-Alpha 3.0 | Polishing / Content update (June 1st 2025) [X] Pre-Alpha 4.0 | Content update (August 30th 2025) [X] Alpha 5.0 | Scope Reduction + New World (December 14th 2025) [  ] Beta [  ] Full Release Leave feedback or just come say hi! discord . gg / yYhGzY2dZF (Steam doesn't allow links anymore so I had to separate it with spaces)
row.short_description: Ecto is a goofy lil game about fast movement, chill atmospheres and strange interactions. Play solo or multiplayer up to 8 players.

row.name: STACK & the Grumblepuff from Above
row.detailed_description: Play as Stack – a tower of buddies just trying to take a nap – when mysterious grumbles start falling from the sky! Dodge them, weave them, and swerve to grab some coins. Develop a healthy addiction to coins as you find the source of your sleeping debacle… from above. Maybe grab a friend (or seven) along the way. There are many ways to play, the game supports WASD, arrow keys, controller, mouse and touchscreen. There’s also a range of options to tweak so that the game can run more smoothly on different devices. Players without fast reaction time can also benefit from the assist modes, that allow you to play the regular game, but without any finicky button inputs. You can also play with between 2 and 7 other players for local co-op or party modes. Play through eight different levels as you find the source of these mysterious falling grumbles. Each level has a unique gimmick which will change up how you must approach it.  Play with a buddy and work through the story mode together or play locally with up to seven friends to battle it out for a victor! There are 7 unique powerups to fight with. Got a spare minute? Rounds are fast and can be played for short periods. And between the achievements, coin goals and high scores, you’ll be kept busy! Change settings in MENU>OPTIONS, including audio, visual, system and accessibility options. There are also Settings Presets to quickly make adjustments. Program and modify the game with Datapackles. Perform commands in the in-game console, and create Datapackles which have functionality for custom levels, and other shenanigans. See the documentation to learn more. Updates to STACK & the Gumblepuff from Above . See MENU>INFO in-game for a complete summary. 1.13.2 July 2025 1.13.1 May 2025 1.13 April 2024 // Quality of Life Update 1.12.1 January 2025 // New Music 1.12 December 2024 // Multiplayer 1.11.1 November 2024 // Datapackles 1.11 October 2024 // Story Update 1.10.4 September 2024 // The Grumblepuff, Atmosphere & Bugs Update 1.10.3.1 August 2024 // Initial Cutscene Bug 1.10.3 August 2024 // Later Levels & Bugs Update 1.10.2 June 2024 // Massive Performance Improvements & Updated Animations Update 1.10.1 April 2024 // Story Mode Improvements Update 1.10.0 February 2024 // Story Mode Update 1.9.1 January 2024 // Fonts Update 1.9.0 December 2023 // Initial Story Mode Update 1.8.2 July 2023 // Bug Fixes 1.8.0 July 2023 // Miscellaneous Update 1.7.2 April 2023 // Bug Fixes 1.7.1 January 2023 // Critical Save File Bug Fix 1.7.0 January 2023 // Bug Fixes Update 1.6.0 November 2022 // GUI & Bug Fixes Update 1.4.0 July 2022 // Achievements, PVP & Hats Update 1.3.0 April 2022 // Trails and Game Modes Update
row.short_description: Stack just wanted to take a nap – when grumbles start falling from the sky! … Dodge them, weave them, and swerve to grab some coins as you find the source of your sleeping debacle.

row.name: Metal Glove: Exodus
row.detailed_description: Metal Glove: Exodus is a single-player top-down dungeon crawler. Venture into the dungeon, facing off with hordes of enemies along the way. Continue to push deeper, surpassing puzzles, hazards, and more enemies as you make your way to finishing the quest you set out to complete, defeating the troll! Key Features include; - Hack-and-Slash combat - Player abilities - Multiple enemy types - Environmental hazards & puzzles - Boss fight
row.short_description: Metal Glove: Exodus is a top-down dungeon crawler inspired by the classics. Hack and slash your way through the dungeon on your journey to defeat the evil Rock Troll within!

row.name: モリシューター！のぞみ Playtest
Sacred Earth - Alternative
row.detailed_description: Overview Sacred Earth - Alternative is a short hybrid visual novel/RPG proof of concept that tells the beginning of a story about a broken world and the people left behind on it. Play as a lone girl who has awoken after a long slumber, and travel to learn and remember just what happened here, and where all of your friends have gone. Gameplay consists of visual novel story presentation, along with node-based tabletop inspired map travel, and fast paced RPG battles. Main Features - Node Based Travel: Rather than walk around like a traditional RPG, players will traverse webs of nodes where many events happen one after the other. Manage your TP for the smoothest dungeon experience. - Fast Paced Turn Based Combat: Combat is fast and furious.
