Placing emphasis on managing resources and utilizing your skills many beneficial effects to come out on top. - Elemental Superiority: Take control of the battle with Field Elements, and unleash Elemental Arts to pile on massive amounts of damage against your foes - Voice Acting: Bring the story to life with character lines voiced in many scenes.
row.short_description: As a lone girl who has awoken after a long slumber, travel through a broken world to remember just what happened, and where all of your friends have gone in this short, post-apocalyptic fantasy Visual Novel/JRPG with tabletop inspired elements.

row.name: Controller
row.detailed_description: In Controller you take on the role of a Tower Controller at increasing complex and eccentric Airports. Controller distils the complexity of the role of a Tower Controller into an accessible light Simulation game. You’ll make use of a simplified instruction system to quickly manage movements of planes around an Airfield. We'll start you off working a simple bush strip in the Australian outback. Despite the local farm animals getting the way you can quickly get promoted up to larger and busier Airports. Before long you'll find yourself handling aircraft in vast international airports from the UK to Japan. Clear runways for landing planes, hold for the 18:45 railway service that's cutting across your taxi-way, and keep out the of the way of a bad tempered Reindeer. Controller features 15 challenging and diverse levels that will put your planning skills to the test.
row.short_description: Controller is a light Tower Control simulator. Use a simplified instruction system to manage movements of planes around an Airfield. Dynamic hazards will keep on you your toes and force you to alter your plans on the fly. Do you have what it takes to manage the busiest airports in the world?

row.name: Project Zero
row.detailed_description: Project Zero is a fast-paced tactical FPS focused on skill, precision, and movement. It features multiple maps, diverse weapons, and classic competitive modes like Bomb and Elimination. Key Features Multiple game modes – Team Deathmatch, Free For All, Capture the Flag, Gun Game and Elimination. Variety of maps – Choose from six unique battlegrounds, from industrial zones to castles and market streets. Join or create sessions – Play with friends or open your session to others in your region. Private matches can be password-protected. Bots available – Practice alone or warm up against AI opponents before heading into multiplayer. Smooth, classic FPS movement – Run, jump, crouch, and take cover with responsive controls. Whether you’re looking for a quick match or a longer session with friends, Project Zero keeps the action fast, fun, and easy to jump into. Early Access Notice Project Zero is in active development. This Early Access version already offers multiple maps, modes, and playable content. Some features are still being added, and occasional bugs may occur. Your feedback helps shape the game as development continues.
row.short_description: A fast-paced tactical FPS where precision and movement decide every fight. Choose your weapons, master multiple maps and modes, and challenge bots or other players in competitive, skill-based matches.
row.notes: Includes intense violence and blood.

row.name: Exorsite
row.detailed_description: Use the aerial perspective to control your units, you must accommodate them so that the objective is met, placing them in the most convenient place possible You can also give the order to attack an enemy, follow a unit, place selected units in defensive or offensive mode, and even sequence a list of points through which said selected units can visit. You can also use the map to quickly go to a point or point your teammates to a point to perform an action There are different types of units and they vary in movement speed, resistance to damage, type of weaponry and have a special ability integrated into their suit. For more control over a specific unit, you can possess them You are a person (of the avatar type) who learns to master astral travel and who leaves his body in automatic sleepwalking mode while devoting his attention to a strategy that can lead your squad to victory. The avatar type can be all types of units, for example: You can edit your avatar previously, this character editor allows you to edit gender, height, age, muscles, fatness, skin, hair, clothing, clothing color, facial features, and beard length, among others. All gameplay characters are randomly generated with the same characteristics
row.short_description: TPS/RTS You are an avatar whose soul can leave the body on a mission to resolve a conflict shrouded in mystery. Discover your purpose as you fight the enemy with 2 perspectives and different units at your disposal in a human war created by specters and demons.

row.name: Gridlocke
row.detailed_description: Gridlocke is a roguelike deckbuilder tactics game. Assume the role of a hired tactician and side with one of three different factions each with unique decks, abilities, and upgrade options as you progress throughout the campaign. Guiding your chosen faction to victory against the enemy's armies will require a combination of careful deckbuilding, strategic placement, and resource management. Features: 3 factions with unique playstyles Randomly generated upgrade options for each faction, allowing players to make interesting deckbuilding decisions Over 60 unique playable cards 25 different enemy types customizable difficulty options retro fantasy pixel art short runs and lots of replayability!
row.short_description: Gridlocke is a roguelike deckbuilder tactics game. Choose a faction and guide them to victory against the enemy's armies using a combination of careful deckbuilding, strategical placement, and resource management.

row.name: Tower Defense: Infinite War
row.detailed_description: Hold Your Defense! In the far future, people build a base on a strange planet they don't know about to protect their limited resources. Aliens from the planet are constantly attacking your base, and you have to protect it by making defenses against them. Your mission is to deal with different enemies by figuring out their weak spots and good ways to defend yourself. You won't be able to beat enemies that are getting stronger, faster, and more numerous if you don't. In all but a few stages, enemies will come in along a set path, and you'll need to put your towers correctly to stop them. Resources are added to your inventory whenever you defeat your enemies and use these resources to build or upgrade towers that will block stronger enemies. Play this for tactical and challenging fun. TACTIC AND MIND GAME, THE CORE FUN OF TOWER DEFENSE Over 40 colorful maps spread out over 5 different alien worlds, and swarms of over 10 strange monsters with different abilities and traits based on their height and other factors attack the base. You need to build and improve defense towers that can keep waves of monsters away. A good plan is only half the battle. Aim for the perfect time and test your limits while fighting against the enemies. VARIOUS GAME MODES There are different types of tests in each stage, such as defense, survival, gathering, and boss attacks. There are 40+ stages in all, and each one has three difficulty levels. There are only so many special weapons that can be used in each stage, which makes the planning harder. You can also play against other users in a challenge stage that is set up just for you, and there is an infinite mode where you can fight an endless number of enemies. ADORABLE TOWERS AND MONSTERS There are eight differ ent kinds of towers that protect the base from different enemies. You may notice these enemies look cute from time to time. Even at twice the speed, the crazy battle between towers and monsters has a unique and dangerous charm. Take a deep breath and attack! PROVEN GAME ELEMENTS AND FUN The mobile version of was the number one strategy game in 86 countries. It was also the number one app overall in the UK, Australia, France, China, Austria, Sweden, and Denmark. On your PC, you can have the same great fun that people from all over the world have.
row.short_description: In the far future, people build a base on a strange planet they don't know about to protect their limited resources. Protect your base from the incessant invasion of extraterrestrial beings!

row.name: Crawlspace 2
row.detailed_description: does not support WMR(reverb g2), HTC VIVE headsets. you saw an ad about someone needing help fixing their ventilation system. it sounded easy, but this job was much different then the usual work that you were used to. your job will be to fix fans that have lost power by crawling into the ventilation system and restarting fans using your battery. be careful not to run out of power while trapped in the vents. ---- Main Objective: Stay alive through the nights and complete your week of work. -7 increasingly difficult nights -Complete randomized puzzles -Relax at your home and enjoy some TV
row.short_description: You saw an ad about someone needing help fixing their ventilation system. it sounded easy, but this job was much different then then usual work that you were used to.

row.name: NOTHING TO LOSE
row.detailed_description: NOTHING TO LOSE is a retro horror and adventure game. Mask was infected with the virus when he was attacked by zombies during his mission. The time left for Mask is only the last 60 minutes! Either find the antidote, or mutate into a zombie! In the game, players will operate the brave Mask to fight fiercely in a world full of zombies and monsters. At the same time, Mask has to face various puzzles and find guns and supplies in order to survive.
row.short_description: A retro horror and adventure game.
row.notes: Violence and gore.

row.name: Xanadu Land
row.detailed_description: Key Features Xanadu land is a fast-paced massively multiplayer bullet hell game that brings you to the arcade gameplay. In the nonstop BOSS battle, your death is just the beginning，accumulate experience, acquire equipment, and fight side by side with other players to knockdown all the BOSSes! Arcade style gameplay A fast-paced, arcade-like gameplay, you can jump in and out of the game anytime you want, easy to learn but challenging. Together with dozens of players, you will face hundreds of bosses and elite monsters with unique combat methods, defeat them, collect legendary loot, or be defeated... Diversification Progression and cross-platform The heroes of Xanadu Land will grow with you, their death will make you stronger, up to hundreds kinds of equipments, as well as a wealth of skills, talents, fellows, can be formed into different builds, PC players and even mobile players together to achieve legend. In-app purchase value-added services Paying will not make you stronger, but it will give you a more dignified death, like a bigger tombstone...
row.short_description: Xanadu land is a fast-paced massively multiplayer bullet hell game that brings you to the arcade gameplay. In the nonstop BOSS battle, your death is just the beginning，accumulate experience, acquire equipment, and fight side by side with other players to knockdown all the BOSSes!

row.name: 混沌骑士
row.detailed_description: Chaos Knight is a placement strategy game, with an overhead magic world as the background. In the game, you can recruit heroes from different camps to form your own team. You need to reasonably deploy the lineup, let the team play its strongest strength, and lead the team to the final victory!
row.short_description: The dark power of the devil comes, and the ancient land is in danger! Gather heroes from the five camps, establish the shackles of heroes, build a strong team, and unite allies around the world to march towards the abyss!
developers: 英雄远征，激战传奇竞技！

row.name: Emil: A Hero's Journey - Prologue
row.detailed_description: Thanks for playing the prologue of Emil: A Hero's Journey! STORY After Nazi forces take his father away, 11-year-old Emil must use the only two things he has left—creativity and imagination—as he embarks on a perilous journey to find his father. Inspired by the true coming-of-age story of a Holocaust survivor. GAMEPLAY Emil: A Hero's Journey is a Cinematic 2.5D Puzzle-Platformer that combines intense action, stealth elements and creative puzzle-solving. Play as Emil and Interact with the world to creatively solve puzzles and overcome obstacles. Time your actions such as pulling, pushing, climbing, crawling, hiding and much more to avoid danger and find Olek, Emil's father. A personal note During the midst of Covid, I remember being locked up in my apartment, playing Playdead's masterpiece INSIDE and being blown away by it's art, atmosphere and of course puzzles. After finishing it, I felt a burning inspiration to do something related, but with my personal twist. For some reason, INSIDE's dystopic world, combined with a young boy surviving all on his own, reminded me of something... I didn't know what it was at first but then I understood - It was the survival story of my grandfather, Avraham Hartzook, as a young boy surviving all alone in Europe during WW2, hiding and running from place to place to find shelter. At first, I thought I would be good at creating video games if I was good at playing them. But after a year as a 'one man band' and being part of my finals project at Tel-Aviv University, after doing code, animation and level design my self, I understood it would take me years to create something amazing and dealing with all this alone was very hard emotionally and technically. From there, I luckily and happily paired with Afik Yaari (our Producer), Or Hadir (our Animator/3D artist) and later on Nadav Litver (our Technical Director) who we not only worked together but became close friends and a first circle for learning, guidance and more important, support group when times were tough (and they were). Looking back at the creation process of Emil I can definitely say there were many decisions (game design, production, animation) that could have been done different, and yes there's always place to learn and improve. However, I think, that for our first serious game, I am so proud of us and wouldn't do anything differently if I would go through this journey again. Eventually, Emil: A Hero's Journey the child of a unique mixture of almost two and a half years of sensitive-intensive question asking, the love or video games as a medium for storytelling, thorough research and entrepreneurship. As this is currently a short version of the game, I hope that in the future we will gather all together again to create more emotional-compelling games or even a full length version. I truly hope this game (and maybe this little letter of confession) has touched you in some kind of way and I hope you will all be lucky as I was to pursue your dreams actively with the support of special friends and family. If you read all of this, thank you. Ohad.
row.short_description: As Nazi forces take his father, equipped only with his imagination and creativity, Emil goes on a journey to find him. Emil: A Hero's Journey is a Cinematic Puzzle-Platformer, combining intense action and creative puzzle solving. inspired by actual testimonies that took place during WW2.
row.notes: Although the game takes place during World War 2, the presented content does not explicitly show blood/misshapen bodies or close-ups of gory visuals. Gameplay / Cinematics might involve: 1. Dry hits from one human to another 2. dog biting a human 3. Tense, dramatic situations like a kid running from danger. In specific gameplay events, viewed from the side and from a distance, a human is shot in the torso, but no blood is shown.

row.name: No Questions Asked
row.detailed_description: Day 1, 7:48 You close the drawers and get the car keys off the desk. The first delivery's not far from here - hopefully you won't waste too much time in traffic. Day █, 18:32 Sal pours you another Conviction, as you mentally map out the gathered clues. Visit to █████'s place yielded more questions than answers - who's involved? And why? You shrug, waving away cigarette smoke with your hand. Someone in this damn city knows something about ███'s disappearance... and you won't stop short of finding them. In NQA, the mystery unfolds along your choices. You might follow the story, or simply do your job - as a Courier. The city presents you with several paths: - branching dialogues, - scenes reacting to your actions... and the influence of drugs, - a number of endings and varying ways of reaching them. However, keep in mind that time flies - and different opportunities arise and disappear.  Now, just your signature here: _____________
row.short_description: A neo-noir point&click thriller about a delivery service for illegal goods. Play as a Courier who—after hours—has to solve the mystery of his friend's disappearance. Visit various locations, collect clues, navigate branching dialogue options, and hurry as time is not on your side.
row.notes: This game contains crude language, alcohol and drug use, as well as mentions of violence, animal abuse, and suicide.

row.name: Protos Magos
row.detailed_description: Protos Magos is a Spellcrafting FPS with fast-paced combat. Explore a medieval setting and blast your way through a horde of demons. Combine runes in multiple ways to create custom spells. Each rune gives unique properties that change the behavior of the spell. Depending on the runes combined each spell has a different behavior that suits your unique play style Fireballs. Earth spikes. Toxic pools. Castles. Graveyards. Customizable spells. Demons! Lots and lots of demons. First. Person. Shooter.
row.short_description: Protos Magos is a Spellcrafting FPS with fast-paced combat. Explore a medieval setting and blast your way through a horde of demons. Create custom spells to suit your unique play style.
row.notes: Fantasy violence, blood, and dismemberment of fantastic beasts and demons. Most blood is colored,like blue and green

row.name: The Dreamland：Free
row.detailed_description: [Introduction to the game] ------- You will play a hero who saves the village! Your task is to save all the creatures in this land! Bring them together and peace Lead them to rebuild their new homes! ------ Relevant play methods On the way to save them, you will encounter countless difficulties and dangers. You must keep learning and growing to strengthen yourself Fight: Learn powerful spells to protect yourself. Build a new home for the village name. Planting: In order to survive, you must plant various foods to supplement yourself Breeding: fishing, animal husbandry. and more --- Streamlight dream In the dream, you will enjoy the beauty of different dreams and experience the danger of not being able to dream ---- Note: Depending on the computer hardware, you may need to wait for 10s-120s when entering the game. Please wait quietly for the game to load
row.short_description: This is a role-playing game, which mainly focuses on casual gameplay, such as construction, farming, fishing, and farming, and integrates a variety of combat elements and systems.
row.notes: The game includes the nudity of the character's body, as well as exposed clothing, breast shakes, hip shakes and other body physical effects.

row.name: Meowmunitions Prologue
row.detailed_description: This game gives you a roguelike bullet hell experience where you play as a cat whose eggs were stolen by the birds. Do your best to retrieve the eggs by Picking up Random Crafting components to Customize your gun, and Shoot down the evil birds. Travel through a constantly changing forest, desert, mountain, and volcano to get to a crystal cave full of ancient runes and discover the mystery behind the deeds of the birds. the map is procedurally generated every time you play, giving you a fresh and exciting experience each time. While traveling to retrieve your egg, you are bound to face various birds, from ostrich to penguins and even mythical birds you've never seen before. And at the end of each biome, you have to face the ultimate challenge like the evil mage bird, the king of the sand, or even a big fat owl! Discover and unlock various crafting components that let you customize your gun in every way you like. You can make it a machine gun that fires bubbles, a giant cannon that fires snowballs that also burn and freeze your enemy just because you like to make it that way, or maybe even something as silly as a rainbow laser. It is all up to you to decide how your gun works. If you feel a little lonely traveling alone through the unknown world, you can invite your friends to come over and help you, whether online or local!
row.short_description: This game gives you a roguelike bullet hell experience where you play as a cat whose eggs were stolen by the birds. Do your best to retrieve the eggs by Picking up Crafting components to Customize your own gun, and Shoot down the birds.

row.name: Don't Wake God
row.detailed_description: Don't Wake God is a short 1 hour Roguelite/Survival/Stealth game, with replay value. Key features: - Discover 80 unique objects and creatures, each with their own story and secrets. - Master 21 abilities, choosing which 4 to acquire in each playthrough. - Complete your collection with info on each object, and enjoy endless replay value with randomized elements. - Explore the dreamlike world with stunning, handcrafted watercolor art. - Continue the adventure with the Endless Dream Mode after completing the main game. About the game: You play as Tieface, a character who exists only within the dreams of The Man. Your goal is to prevent The Man from waking up, as Tieface will die if he does. The game is made up of 15 levels, each representing a different dream. As you navigate through the dream world, you must avoid being seen by The Man and manipulate objects and creatures around you to keep the dream looking normal and mundane. However, be prepared for the unexpected, as strange and surreal monsters may appear at any moment. The game is made with hand-painted watercolor artwork by solo game developer Alex Klexber. It is a top-down roguelite game with special abilities, objects and creatures collection, and vibrant, psychedelic art. Don't Wake God is a unique and challenging game that will keep you on your toes as you try to keep The Man asleep and Tieface alive.
row.short_description: Take on the role of Tieface - a dream figment, whose goal is to prevent his dreamer from waking up - if he wakes up, you die! Acquire abilities, outsmart your enemies, and most importantly... Don't Wake God.

row.name: Street Corners of the World Playtest
Soundscape XR: 2024
row.detailed_description: The Soundscape journey began in 2014 with the creation of hyper-immersive virtual spaces to enjoy the music that moves you; in VR and on PC. A decade later, we're opening the doors to a freeform, cutting-edge hybrid reality, powered by the latest technologies like UE5 and Lumen.   Soundscape is about exploring new connections within music & visual arts. We're in the teleportation business empowering individuals with tools to connect and flow from anywhere. The collective of artists behind the project have made the incredible choice of offering Soundscape as a gift.  Experience the magic from their fingertips to your mind. - Take flight and explore worlds brought to life by music, Sonic AI powers a unique experience every time. - Customize your Soundskin avatar and dance into another dimension to meet up with friends and fans in an artistic musical metaverse experience. - Bring the music you love, or get lost in sound within audiovisual experiments and collaborations with artists like Deadmau5, Goose, Slash, FISHER, and Chris Lake. - Crossplay between PC & VR, both unique experiences working together in harmony to enhance your own.  Soundscape XR: 2024 supports all major legacy HMDs and motion controllers from 2014-2025.  For those looking to experience our most advanced features, including new native Steam Frame support, you'll want to purchase Soundscape 2026.  For ten years, our collective of artists have been putting their love into building the purest virtual destination for the enjoyment of music with no ads, no data tracking, no microtransactions, no DRM, and no corporate BS. Its our honor and privilege to share with you our art and creations. It's taken a lot to build this into something that we've dreamed about, and we're so grateful for your support. Join us on our journey to an advanced audiovisual future.
row.short_description: Exploratory musical metaverse hybrid reality warp world.

row.name: King of Light
row.detailed_description: 剧情简介 帝国——作为神秘与魔法起源地的君主制大国，因为一场由贵族发起的叛乱而面临分裂的危机。 短时间内，国王去世、王位继承人相继遭到暗害……就在人们以为帝国的历史即将宣告终结之时，一支名为“光明军”的势力出现了。这支由王子洛林带领的军队，打出“光复王权”的旗号，向叛军发起挑战，决心将濒临崩溃的帝国重新统一。 我们的故事，将从洛林和他的光明军开始讲起。 玩法简介 《光明王传说》是单人独立创作的 策略推理剧情向RPG游戏 ，游戏内容分为“战役”与“推理”两部分。 “战役”类似回合制战棋，需要玩家在了解规则的基础上选择最为合适的行动策略，通常以击退敌方将领为胜利条件。 “推理”类似逆转裁判，需要玩家选择合适的线索来解答现有的疑问，最后推理出事件的真相或找出解决问题的方法。 游戏难度较低， 全程只做选择题 （游戏攻略在手册中）。
row.short_description: 这是一部描绘战争与权谋的奇幻史诗——古老的魔法帝国因贵族叛乱而分崩离析，一位无法使用魔法的王子成为了这个国家最后的希望。你将扮演王子洛林，在「战役」中运筹决胜，在「推理」中破解迷局，在乱世中走出一条用善良与智慧铸就的王者之道。

row.name: Baalzebub
row.detailed_description: You do not remember how this happened or who you are. All of a sudden you found yourself in Hell and you want to get out. The only way seems to lead through the 14 levels of Hell. Each level except for the first one is ruled by a boss holding the exit portal key. Since you are in Hell, the level bosses happen to be the Hell's most important fallen angels such as Lucifer, Mammon, Dantalion, Furcas, Zagan, Belphegor or Asmodeus. They are very strong, yet each of them possess a vulnerability you might want to discover. Make your way out through all of the levels of randomly generated infernal dungeon, get the keys, food, weapons and other items from dead monsters, overcome bosses and escape that horror! Try to beat the high score in the global Hall of Fame. This is a survival turn-based dungeon crawler game resembling the rogue-like classics from decades ago. Game controls Use arrow keys, WASD keys or a game controller to move your hero and attack nearby enemy creatures. Click locations to set spell cast target or to shoot arrows (with a bow equipped and some arrows in your backpack). You can equip armor items to your hero's body. The equipped items wear when used. The backpack weight does matter. It affects the stamina and health params significantly. Make sure you watch the health and stamina all the time, because with zero health your hero will die forever. When entering a new level (also the first level), some items are hidden by default. This is especially true for the level map and the exit portal. You need to find the red scroll to uncover the hidden properties of the level. Such a scroll is unique and it is in possession of a random opponent. Game features Permadeath (if your character dies, the game is over) Turn-based gameplay with an intuitive interface Procedural level generation Limited inventory where the weight matters a lot Hidden items and traps You must hunt for food to survive More than a hundred of different creatures Enemies can steal your inventory items Attack and shooting accuracy based on weapon condition and luck Weapon wear and repair Stamina, mana and health recover by using potions, scrolls and food only Retro styling with a smooth camera movement No tutorials, no guides, no hand-holding Your global rank is shown throughout the game Game progress is saved automatically and also manually - from the menu.
row.short_description: A turn-based infernal dungeon crawler.

row.name: Offroad Mechanic Simulator: Prologue - First Job
row.detailed_description: Offroad Mechanic Simulator: Prologue - First Job is a free version of Offroad Mechanic Simulator. With a large slice through the gameplay, it provides a good taste of the full game and a fun experience on its own! If you want to try the full version, check below! Enter the world of off-road vehicles! Have you ever seen an off-road beast of a car and thought that working on this vehicle as a mechanic must be a ton of fun? Offroad Mechanic Simulator provides you with an experience as close as possible to modifying real off-road rides to face immensely rough terrain. Get your very own garage, full of equipment and tools of the trade. Shop for the best parts on the market and mount them to make the cars far exceed their original capabilities. Repair, restore, modify – but mind the budget, you’re on contract after all! However, no work is done without testing it! Jump behind the well and see how your modifications perform against cliffs, deep sand, running rivers, thick mud, and any kind of harsh obstacles you can stumble upon off the beaten path. You might need to bring in some specialized equipment to face some of the hardest tasks! Offroad Mechanic Simulator: Prologue – First Job shows off the definite experience, far evolved from the previous demonstrations. This is a great occasion to discover the game anew and prepare for the full release. Players can enjoy features such as: Improved physics, car models, and handling Entirely new UI Three new cars to dismantle and re-assemble Repair, Washing, Tuning, and Adjustment commissions A new Forest map to conquer New garage rooms, parts, and options New perks and skills Wide access to nearly all skills available in the full game Possibility of achieving up to level 4 of experience
row.short_description: Start your career in servicing off-road vehicles in the free Prologue for Offroad Mechanic Simulator. Repair, modify, and upgrade three different cars. Use professional tools, parts from the shop, and unlockable perks and skills. Test your work driving through the scenic forest.

row.name: Swarm Horror
row.detailed_description: You wake up in an unknown place. You attempt to escape. As you continue your search, you encounter a swarm of insects. This is their feeding ground. Will you be able to escape? Game Features First-person perspective Explore and solve tricks Use melee weapons to kill insects as you progress. Controls Move with WASD TAB to check your belongings Use the mouse to move the viewpoint and check your belongings. CTRL to crouch SHIFT to run. Play time . About 1-2 hours.
row.short_description: Swarm Horror is a survival horror game in which the player must progress while defeating insects. The goal of the game is to escape from the feeding ground of the insects you have wandered into. The insects call their friends to feed on you.
row.notes: This game contains language not intended for all ages. There are violent and gore expressions.

row.name: Midnight Dash
row.detailed_description: Story! The game tells you a story about Sean who gets lost from home and tries to find hes way back. While trying to find a way back Sean meets a magical light source Piu who agrees to help you but on one condition.. You help him to find something that he had lost. Help Sean and Piu to reach their goals in this difficult adventure! Cool stuff • A intensive single-player adventure, with a lot of cool characters and difficult levels. • Game of hardcore platforming challenges and amazing secrets. • Brutal Bonus levels that can be accessed from the main menu. Built for the hardcore gamers. • Fun and catchy music. • Inbuilt speedrun timer and death counter. • Local co-op levels. The controls are simple and easy to understand. You can jump, air-dash, slide, attack and even fly! Also Piu will help you light up the path in some levels. Have fun helping Sean and Piu in this difficult adventure!
row.short_description: Midnight Dash is an difficult 2D platformer. It tells the story about Sean and Piu the light source.

row.name: What is snowman made of?
row.detailed_description: An atmospheric mini game that let's you explore a snowcapped yard. A yard in which you can find various things to build your very own snowman. Game features - build your own snowman with objects found in the world - simple controls - atmospheric stylized graphics
row.short_description: An atmospheric mini game that let's you explore a snowcapped yard in which you build your very own snowman.

row.name: Kill Pill
row.detailed_description: All you need to do is kill the pills. Shoot your way to a new high score while collecting powerups to shake things up. Kill Pill is a simple arena shooter game where you shoot pills that randomly spawn around the map. There are six types of powerups you can get: speed (red), jump (blue), automatic firing (green), collateral damage (purple), shotgun (orange), and freezing time (white). Two modes are in the game. Classic mode only has red pills which run toward you. Arcade mode has 4 types of pills: red ones, orange ones which split in two when you shoot them, blue ones which jump with you, and green ones which are faster than you. Each kill is one point added to your score. High scores are saved between each session. How high can you go?
row.short_description: All you need to do is kill the pills. Shoot your way to a new high score while collecting powerups to shake things up.

row.name: exp!A
row.detailed_description: This is a game building an amusement park with 'Ashe'. Tell him the idea you came up with and Ashe will build an amusement park based on that idea. You may be asked for a lot of EXP when you build something or get to know someone. But there is more EXP. Don't worry. You can learn the words in the game and chat with Ashe. Enjoy interacting with him. (He seems to think you are someone else...?) There is no action or fighting. You are safe. The story is light and peaceful with a little bit of anxiety mixed in for spice. Make Ashe's dream utopia. If you can make it to the end, go beyond with Ashe. Welcome to the other side of a happy ending. This is a story for 'you' , played the hero.
row.short_description: For 'you' , played the hero.
row.notes: To the extent not depicted in the main storyline, violence may be implied.

row.name: Shoot! VR
row.detailed_description: Shoot! VR is a first-person shooter simulation game. The game simulates the environment of an indoor shooting range. The game has different modes and offers a choice of different weapons. In time mode, the player tries to get the best score possible within the time limit. Random targets will be generated in the scene. Players must shoot as many targets as possible during the countdown to get a higher score. When the player shoots, there is a virtual sign on the side in front of him/her indicating the score obtained and the time left to remind the player. When the time is up, the player quits the game and the page displays the score. In level mode, the difficulty of the level changes from easy to hard over time. Each level has a preset score and players must achieve a score greater than or equal to the preset score before the countdown ends before entering the next level. As the player progresses through the level, the difficulty becomes higher and higher. The difficulty of the level is determined by the speed at which the target disappears and the score that must be achieved to advance to the next level. If the score obtained by the player before the end of the time is lower than the predefined score, the game is over and the virtual screen (panel) will display the final score obtained by the player. In training mode, players can shoot freely with different weapons. This mode is the default mode when a player enters a scene, i.e. the player does not choose to start a game in time or level mode. Players have no time or score limit, they can shoot freely. Players can also choose the difficulty they want, which means the different time interval between the appearance and disappearance of targets.
row.short_description: Shoot! VR is a first-person shooter simulation game using virtual reality. The game simulates the environment of an indoor shooting range. The game has different modes and offers a choice of different weapons.

row.name: ST World
row.detailed_description: Update Notes This free package includes all Riftwalkers' Adventure Demo, all community content, and ST World's level editor! All previously paid early access users will have access to all future paid Riftwalkers content. ⚠️ Beta Advisory Notice The software is fully working but not well optimized, especially with PCs with less than 16 GB of RAM or Mac. Please wait patiently for future patches. There are vast spaces of optimization and our team is working very hard to make it work on more computers. About the Game Dive into a World of Limitless Imagination with the ST World! ST World is the next-generation game engine specializing in voxel world-building and AI-assisted creation. With advanced algorithm design and state-of-the-art machine learning capabilities, creative input in the 3D world is more accessible than ever. Unleash Your Creativity with Game-Changing Tools Our Console AI and Material AI tools transform the creative process, making world-building more accessible and effortless. Create realistic environments, tweak the weather, and modify the time of the day, all with natural language input. Experience the Power of Effortless Open World Creation At the core of ST World is our innovative sparse voxel engine, providing high-resolution voxel rendering and efficient performance across devices. It empowers you to bring your visions to life without complex modding or extensive development knowledge. Join a Thriving Community of Creative Visionaries Connect with fellow creators in the upcoming asset and map marketplace, sharing your masterpieces and discovering unique creations from others. We foster a supportive community that inspires and helps each other grow. Your Journey Starts Here Become a part of the ST World community, and let's build worlds together! Wishlist and embark on the adventure that awaits as you unlock the full potential of your imagination. ST Engine: Current Features Cutting-edge sparse-voxel level editor with 16 times more cubic resolution than Minecraft. Brush, Volume, Freeform, and Smoother tools, enabling rapid creation and editing of intricate, high-resolution voxel environments. A vibrant map community to find, download, share, and showcase your creations and games. Material AI features unlimited block creation with natural language input, sparking endless creativity and innovation. Console AI features allow you to create natural environments and change sky weather and time of the day with natural language input. Anticipated Future Features Voxel Terminal: An extension of the full engine that quickly import and export creation from and to Minecraft and Schematics mods. AI Upscaler: Import your low-resolution Minecraft world, filling details with smaller blocks with AI. Riftwalkers Storyline and Open World gameplay: A dual-era adventure with rich exploration between the ancient and modern world. Liquid and Transparent Material: Better glasses, liquid simulation, and shading. Weapon and Enemy: Moddable combat system, with several kinds of enemy and spawning options. Multiplayer: Collaborative building and gameplay with the multiplayer server. Character Customization: more your look, clothes, and equipment selection. Follow us on social media for updates and glimpses into the development of Riftwalkers, our signature open-world game, and be the first to know about new features and enhancements!
row.short_description: Discover ST World - the next-generation voxel world! Build stunning high-resolution sandbox worlds with easy-to-use tools and AI features. Explore Riftwalkers' open-world adventures and join a thriving community.

row.name: Dummy Pirates: Ocean Tales
row.detailed_description: To win the team deathmatch, team-up with your friends to compete in a 3v3 multiplayer game. Gold will be awarded for every kill, use it on items to enhance your crew's abilities and powers. Burn your enemies with heatwaves as the Black Flames Crew, infect them with vital viruses as the Germ Pirates Crew, or kill them with acid rain as the Poisonous Grum Crew. Unleash each crew's immersive abilities. Explore the rewards that the powerful curses of the Ocean Tales have to offer and gather them all, chests and potions for all crews to assemble. Earn additional gold by finding and defeating the monsters, but be careful, they bite! Each crew has a dummy captain, customize with the unique props you gather from all your victories. Keep your victories and level up to be worthy of the biggest title of all!
row.short_description: From the Planet Chromatica, the first 3D TPS sailing MOBA game! Become the King-of-Dummies by competing and winning in deadly matches, while exploring the wonders of the Ocean Tales.

row.name: Missing Stars
row.detailed_description: Missing Stars is a visual novel that aims to depict mental disorders and the people who live with them in a realistic, but sensitive and respectful light. After an accident that left him traumatized, Erik Wilhelm transfers in to Privatgymnasium St. Dymphna, a special Viennese boarding school for teenagers and young adults struggling with their mental health. There, he meets a colorful cast of characters that will turn his formerly uneventful life upside down. As he settles into his new school, Erik will learn more about mental health and how to best approach it. Somewhere along the way, he might just find companionship, too... Featuring: Five unique routes with fun, endearing characters. With over 230,000 words, that leaves you with about 14 hours of readable content! Original Soundtrack Gallery/Music Room Accessibility Options Steam Achievements This visual novel contains sensitive themes, including fictional depictions of psychological issues and trauma. All characters depicted are the age of 18 or older.
row.short_description: Missing Stars is a visual novel that aims to depict mental disorders and the people who live with them in a realistic, but sensitive and respectful light.

row.name: Precision
row.detailed_description: This is a 2D simple puzzle game where the player follows the mouse and you cannot touch any obstacles or you will have to restart the level. You will have obstacles in your way to make the levels more difficult like spinners, chasing blocks, disappearing blocks and more. You will collect coins along the way and try to be as precise as possible to get through small passage ways and openings. Being simple to learn, this game is for everyone. Challenge yourself to speed through each level as fast as possible. Try your best to get through them all! More levels will be added with new obstacles for you to have to create new strategies to get around. This game can be very triggering but when you complete a level it feels good!
row.short_description: This is a simple 2d follow the mouse game where you have to get to the end to win! This game can be annoying and hard to get through levels but can be very fun! If you touch anything red you will die.

row.name: Find the Whales
row.detailed_description: Find the Whales is a free-to-play educational game for all ages about ocean conservation. Players travel to simulated places on the globe to find whales, fish, and other marine animals. They also do simulated conservation quests to help the animals. The locations featured are Hawaii and the Mesoamerican Reef. In this 2D side-scroller, players walk, snorkel, and SCUBA dive to find crabs, whales, fish, dolphins and other animals. Quests include planting mangrove seedlings, stopping illegal fishing, slowing down speeding boats, cleaning polluted water, farming seaweed and listening for whales with a hydrophone. Players collect points for finding species. They can also take photos to store in the simulated photo album. Points are used to purchase quest-related tools in the simulated stores at each location. Players also collect information cards. The more times they find the same species, the more information is added to these cards - text, photos and videos about these species.
row.short_description: Find the Whales is a free-to-play educational game for all ages about ocean conservation. Find marine animals and do conservation quests to help protect them & their habitats!

row.name: Altered Algorithm
row.detailed_description: Altered Algorithm: Episode 1 is a free VR experience introducing you back to a time of gaming simplicity and the excitement of unique experiences. This project has been in development for only 6 months by a small team of developers (including me, Nick DePalo), a community of amazing artists, and a group of filmmaking partners. We hope to build on this foundational endeavor of episodic adventures with your support. Our goal is to introduce new, interesting, and unique experiences to the world. Welcome to an alternate LA, set in a futuristic 1983. You're either a militant or mercenary. Jeremiah, our main protagonist lives in an alternate past where technology has already flourished for decades causing ALL risk to be mitigated. He's a hired 'Field Adjuster' who's job is to hunt down any threats to make the world 'SAFE' through the use of the most advanced AI Predictive software and Threat Analytics ever created with a new government program called... CASSI. ​CASSI, a ' C entralized A I S afety S urveillance I nfrastructure' is designed to serve, mitigate, and protect everyone and everything. ​When the A.I. Threat Algorithm Jeremiah relies on is infiltrated by Kenji Kimora, an infamous underground gang leader, an altered simulation unfolds, and it causes a system city lockdown beyond repair. These events lead Jeremiah to embark on a journey within the simulation to explore the deep city slums of gangs, freewill, and the chaos of choice to discover the altered algorithm of who he truly is and needs to become. There, Jeremiah is presented with the greatest risk ever encountered.... himself . Action-thriller set in an altered futuristic timeline of 1983 LA, where advanced technology has already flourished for decades​ Unique FMV (Full Motion Video) environments and characters that allow dynamic interaction within the real-time 3D world ​ 'Natural Narrative' driven pacing is at the heart of our experience. The choices you make will dynamically unfold the story you drive forward. SEARCH, SOLVE, or SURVIVE... the choice is yours.​ Environmental puzzles that involve the player to use their detective tools, the sandbox world, or weapons on hand to manipulate and solve the world's mysteries Players assume the first-person perspective of a fully playable character in VR known as Jeremiah, who can interact within a world of FMV (Full Motion Video) characters and elements by solving environmental puzzles and options for ranged combat, which reveals your story's journey.
row.short_description: Altered Algorithm is an action-thriller VR experience blending the craft of film and games in a new way. In this story-driven game set in a futuristic 1983 LA, your playground will be detective work, head-to-head combat, and the ability to DYNAMICALLY interact with full motion video characters.
row.notes: This game depicts cartoon violence and potential players may have a sensitivity to and would like to be aware of such as depictions of guns and violence.

row.name: ROSE
row.detailed_description: ROSE is a violent arena shooter with rogue-like elements. Create your own builds by sacrificing parts of your body or reversing the sacrifices to gain boost and new abilities. Unlock new weapons, enhance them with powerful upgrades. Progress through randomized arenas, defeat demented enemies and vanquish titanic bosses to uncover the dark story. What are you willing to sacrifice to save your lost daughter Rose? Sacrifice your flesh and blood After each arena has been cleared you can choose from several sacrifices. Sacrifices will increase the complexity and difficulty of the game. Each body part sacrificed will add new mechanics and will change the game in a meaningful way. Each sacrifice will increase your stress level, with enough stress you can reverse a sacrifice to gain a new ability instead. Ever-changing arenas Arenas are randomly selected from dozens of pre-made layouts. Traps, enemies and other objects are procedurally spawned. Each arena can spawn multiple waves of enemies. In some arenas you can figh for additional rewards. In such cases, enemies will spawn with a special rule-set, forcing you to strategize and change your play style to complete the rule objective. Not all the arenas are created equal, some may offer special mid-run upgrades or present you with an additional challenge in the form of a mini-boss. Weapons and abilities Each weapon provides a unique gameplay experience, some can even alter the maps themselves. The gun selection ranges from a simple revolver to a demented gun which consumes your blood for ammo and punishes you each time you miss. Unlock new weapons, upgrade them every time you die, then jump into battle once more! Enemies and bosses Enemies spawn in waves. After you clear a certain number of waves, the sacrificial altar will unlock, and you will move to a new arena. Some arenas may spawn bosses instead of regular enemies. Story Rose tells a story about life, death and hope. You will find out more about the story by progressing through the arenas, special encounters, defeating bosses and dying. Features: Sacrifice your flesh and blood to progress Reverse sacrifices to gain boosts instead Unlock and upgrade unique weapons Slaughter waves of demented enemies Defeat titanic bosses Progress through the randomized arenas to uncover the dark story Avoid traps and other procedurally placed obstacles
row.short_description: ROSE is a violent rogue-lite arena shooter where you sacrifice your body parts to progress and gain new weapons and abilities. Slaughter waves of monstrous enemies and defeat titanic bosses in randomized arenas or die trying!
row.notes: The game includes blood splats and blood splashes on the screen when enemies are damaged and when stabbing sacrifice cards. References to self harm and suicide.

row.name: Elle: Portal
row.detailed_description: Elle About the Game A free spin-off of Elle (puzzle platformer). Collect coins while avoiding the maze keepers. Easy to understand game mechanics 36 exciting levels 3 types of enemies The game is executed in the original 8-color palette
row.short_description: A free spin-off of Elle (puzzle platformer). Collect coins while avoiding the maze keepers.

row.name: Pineapple on pizza
row.detailed_description: Eating a pizza is like holding a party in your mouth, but what would that party feel like if the pizza had pineapple on it? Pineapple on pizza is a short game about exploring an island full of dancing people, finding a way to ruin the party, and unexpectedly enjoying it. We strongly encourage you to stop reading and just play it. Surprise does enhance the flavor. Features: About 10 minutes of gameplay. An island full of people dancing. Cool music. Dark, yet very bright humor. Unexpected emotions you might not have experienced before. A volcano you can jump into when you get tired of exploring. If you liked the game, consider supporting us by buying the soundtrack on Steam.
row.short_description: Can a video game convey a flavor?
row.reviews: “I guess it is a successful depiction of pineapples on pizza” Rock Paper Shotgun

row.name: A Song Of Sunlight
row.detailed_description: Arem has lived his life surrounded by ocean waves and fields of dying grass . Upon his small island lies The Settlement , a community of just three thousand: the children of the sun. Passing the long years in prayer and simple work, the blessed people of the Island live and die by their traditions. Arem, like all young men and women of The Settlement, knows well the laws of his people: perform one's obligation for the greater good, and never enter The Well - a passage leading deep into the unknown earth below.  Raised as a Woundbearer, Arem greatly desires to come of age and do his part in improving the lives of his community- none more so than Sachita, the burning girl, shunned by The Settlement but whom he loves dearly.  Yet, when Arem is suddenly given the responsibilities he always dreamed of, he finds his certainty shattered by the truth of the horror held at The Settlement’s close reach. Now doubting the only life he's ever known, Arem embarks on a secret mission to save his people and unravel the true nature of his world.     Descending into the Well and desperately searching for answers, Arem comes to understand just how much he truly has to lose. A Song of Sunlight features a novel pseudo-turn-based combat system that challenges players to fight for their lives against horrifying enemies. Make split-second calculated decisions, then attack, block, evade, and look for openings in real-time against multiple targets in thrilling combat encounters. By day, carry out your duties to the Settlement and interact with its inhabitants to obtain resources and learn more about the world. By night, explore desolate megastructures filled with mystery and danger, discover weapons and equipment lost to humanity, and customize your build to suit many distinct play styles. A tightly woven intersection of gameplay and narrative, players will interact with the game world and characters in depth.
row.short_description: An RPG set in a distant, lonely future. Follow Arem, a young man lured from his small island community to explore the desolate megastructure beneath it: “The Well.” With the simple goal of finding the exit, Arem will burden himself with something more terrible than he ever thought possible.
row.notes: Contains depictions of violence, blood, and themes of self harm.

row.name: House of Shadow
row.detailed_description: House of Shadow is an action-adventure metroidvania. Explore, traverse obstacles, evade monsters, slay fearsome bosses, and claim the Shadow Throne! You are a young sorcerer, wielding shadow powers against legions of light in an attempt to claim the Shadow Throne and correct the catastrophic imbalance between light and darkness. Features As indie as it gets: Developed entirely by one person Multiple areas and bosses Precise platforming Challenging combat Rewarding upgrades to make your character more powerful 2-3 hours in length
row.short_description: House of Shadow is an action-adventure metroidvania wherein you wield the powers of darkness! Explore, traverse obstacles, battle monsters born of light, slay fearsome bosses, and claim the Shadow Throne!

row.name: Touch the Color
row.detailed_description: Take your reflexes and aim to the next level with Touch the Color, the arcade-style reaction and accuracy game that’s easy to pick up but hard to put down. In Touch the Color, you’re given a matrix of colors but only one is your target. All you need to do is click on the correct color as fast as possible to ramp up your score. If its simplicity is reminding you of time-waster games, think again. Touch the Color is an arcade reaction time game that’ll work your mouse aim and take it to new heights. The faster and more accurately you click, the sharper your brain and skills become. Fast-paced color switching means you’ll be challenged at every turn. And as the pace increases, so does your drive to keep improving your score. It’s a reflex challenge that’s both addictive and beneficial yet can also be as calm or as tryhard as you want it to be. Chill by focusing on improving your own score or take it to the online stage by climbing the leaderboard ranks. Fast-paced Gameplay Touch the Color’s gameplay only requires a single click of the mouse, making it easy to pick up. Focus on your speed and accuracy for optimal gains. Customize Your Experience Touch the Color features tons of unlockable themes, each with its own personality. Ramp up your score to earn stars to make the experience your own. Ranking System - Challenge yourself further by ranking up. Touch the Color features a worldwide ranking leaderboard where you can beat the scores of others including your friends.
row.short_description: Take your reflexes and aim to the next level with Touch the Color, the arcade-style reaction and accuracy game that’s easy to pick up but hard to put down.

row.name: Manabaz
row.detailed_description: Minimalist Arena Brawler Each side has a warrior and an archer. Kill your enemies to win. Intelligent Bots Bots are using neural networks . They are trained with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) . Features Local-Multiplayer up to 4 players Can also play alone with a bot teammate Play with keyboard/mouse Or play with a controller
row.short_description: Minimalist Arena Brawler - play against neural network controlled bots

row.name: Dot
row.detailed_description: Dot is a peaceful game about traversal of worlds. The purpose of Dot is to ascend to the next world in the least number of actions possible. You can play as a dot, heart, cat or penguin. Enjoy this game as a free experience. Relax and calmly navigate this unique space. Use the mouse to direct the dot in a direction of travel and click to move the dot. The dot continues to travel until it reaches a rest point, or falls off the platform. Navigate platforms and rest points to reach the ascension location and progress to the next world. Activate buttons and avoid darkness to reach the game's unknown conclusion. This is an open ended experience where the player chooses when to complete or end the game, there are no right or inright, correct or incorrect, affirmative or confirmative solutions. Please enjoy. With Love, Little Sky Studios.
row.short_description: The purpose of Dot is to ascend to the next world in the least number of actions possible. You can play as a dot, heart, cat, penguin or union. Enjoy this game as a free experience. Relax and calmly navigate these worlds.

row.name: Nightly Trash
row.detailed_description: Game Description You play as a 17 year old boy who was desperate to get a job and finds himself an awful adventure . As your job you work as a cook at a local diner , and you as the player have to take out the trash in every night to finish up your shift. Each night has a different event as you play through the game. As each night goes on you'll eventually discover something from the sewers, and will uncover the secrets of the diner. What will you discover from these horrid times? Key Features: In game tutorial for new players A very basic gameplay mechanic but also fun A small interesting story And very short game About Me I am a individual who is trying to achieve their dreams, and I have successfully achieved one out of many. I have always wanted to make video games ever since I was a kid, but during that time you had to either work at; a AAA studio or be a very smart, and skilled person in order to make games. As technology advanced and still does to this day everyone around the world has made things to help with the lack of knowledge on how to either: Programming, 3D Modeling, Sound Effects, and etc! This doesn't mean me as a game developer is using this as a clutch to make games, but rather a jump start on my adventure to become better at this, and be more skilled in the near future.
row.short_description: You're an average-joe in a 1950's like aesthetic, working at a diner while taking out the trash. Each night has different events as you play through, so keep your eyes open for anything... off...
row.notes: References of Violence Mild Language

row.name: Diesel The Pug Warrior
row.detailed_description: In this new adventure RPG, you will be playing as Diesel. Trouble in the Kingdom of Everlyn has called the King to ask Diesel and his best friend Fred to join the army to fight off the evil Luna. Help Diesel fight off Luna and her forces and become the best warrior in all of Everlyn! This game is designed to be an adventure RPG packed with story and comedy. This game also contains lots of easter eggs! Fight all types of enemies and use different items to shape your Pug Warrior Adventure. This Game Features: A Big Boss Fight An Original Story Original Soundtrack Original Art that is Pixel Art
row.short_description: Help Diesel as he joins forces with his best friend Fred, as they try to save the Kingdom of Everlyn from the evil Luna and bring peace to the land once more in this adventure RPG!

row.name: Find the Whales: Español
row.detailed_description: A Spanish language version of Find the Whales, a free-to-play educational game about ocean conservation. Players choose a location from the simulated globe. Game features several areas and habitats in the Mesoamerican Reef region of Honduras, Mexico, Guatemala and Belize. Players then travel by boat to each place and try and find local, endangered species such as the Rainbow parrotfish and Whale shark. They can take photos of these species and themselves exploring, to put in their simulated album. Local conservation non-player characters teach the players about the conservation work being done and ask players to complete simulated conservation quests. For doing these, players get points, which they use to exchange for tools in the simulated store. Players also get points for finding species. They can also collect information cards about each species. The more times they find each species, the more content is added to these cards: photos, videos, and text.
row.short_description: A Spanish version of Find the Whales, an educational game about ocean conservation. Find simulated marine animals & learn how to help protect them from extinction!

row.name: MISTROGUE ミストと生けるダンジョン Playtest
丧尸世界-经典策略卡牌养成
row.detailed_description: [Place the battle without operation] Recruit survivors, and the strongest survival team will defend the homeland! row.reviews: “‘Modules’ is submersive; taking body and mind through an 11-room network of space-age staircases, ledges, lifts and corridors, navigated by pinching your (real-world) fingers. row.name: finland corruption simulator
row.detailed_description: - gameplay is totally about walking - you can watch over to left and right with A and D keys - this game runs with java so you need to have java to run this game - game resolution is 640x480 - you can move forward and backwards with W and S keys - you can open stats and messages from pressing I key in keyboard - you can send message from pressing 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, - you can use car from pressing N in keyboard - you can open controls window section from pressing C in keyboard - cool review i found '  This game blew my mind. I didn't think that there were any games that could top the classics compared to finland corruption simulator. It's very kind of the creator noobius to not charge any money for this game because it will truly blow you away when you play it. And may I just take a moment to talk about that amazing description text on the store page. When I first read this description, I shed several tears. The story of this game is just so fricking beautiful. There are four life changing modes in this game each one better than the other. The first mode is the dlc launcher, now I haven't played any of the dlc because I didn't want to give myself a heart attack from experiencing such a beautiful game, so I unfortunately skipped it, but I wouldn't be surprised if the dlc was as amazing if not even more amazing as the base game. Next there's mode 2 which is the low 64 bit mode. In this mode you play as the iconic god knows what character and you're apparently crippled since you move at the same pace as a snail. Unless you press the 'n' key in which case you become sonic and move at the speed of light. The world building in this mode is nothing but true art. It's a white world with a black sky with a bunch of squares everywhere. And I really love the story in this mode: You start the game. I also live that in this mode you don't use your mouse to look around, but you have to use the arrow keys and I think that this is just such a well thought out decision because who really uses a mouse to look around in a game these days? I also love that you are unable to look up or down and that just filled me with so much emotion such as me smashing my keyboard into my screen and me crying because my girlfriend was cheating on me again, oh wait that was just a dream I forgot, I don't have a girlfriend. I really resonate with the message that this mode is trying to tell me. If the message wasn't clear to you already, it is clearly trying to convey that you need to give up on your dreams and fricking suffer in a mental institute. And that is just so inspiring because it is. Mode 3 is the stuff of legends. This is the VR mode. Now I don't own a VR headset so I unfortunately couldn't experience this mode properly, but I booted it up anyway. And when I did, I got the most amazing pop ups consisting of 'Unable to init VR runtime: Installation path could not be located (110)' which I think we can all relate to and ofcourse the classic: 'Composistor initialization failed.' which is and always will be one of the most powerful messages ever said by anything in history. The gameplay was incredible and just so unique from all the other modes. It is the exact same thing as mode 2, except there are more cubes. The message that this mode is trying to tell you is clearly that we shouldn't take finland corruption simulator for granted. There will be a time when this game will be taken off Steam and when it does, we will have taken this game for granted, because there's nothing in this world that brings me more disappointment than this game. The last mode is the classic mode and to say that it is a divine experience would be a severe understatement. I couldn't believe it when I booted up this mode, because this mode is filled with the most passion, love, depression, adventure, friendship, the cold hard reality of life as a bellhop, and chihuahua's out of any game I have seen in 15 minutes. All this mode is is an error message saying: 'This application requires a Java runtime environment'. When I experienced the gameplay, I had to jack off for 5 hours before I could press ok. My room is now covered in semen. I think the message that this mode is trying to convey is pretty clear, but for your dumb dumbs out there I'll explain it for you. The message that it's trying to convey is that we shouldn't try to fix problems and that we should just say ok and be depressed. Such a powerful message. This game is nothing short of a masterpiece. The game not only conveys a powerful message in 3 of its modes (and possibly the dlc as well), but it's also very accurate as it's obviously based on a true story. I've been to Finland's capital Stockholm and I can tell you that out of all 4 modes, mode 4 is the most realistic and accurately represents Stockholm perfectly out of all of them. I 100% recommend this game if you wanna experience the beauty that is Finalnd, but don't wanna leave your room because of your depression. I'm now gonna cry myself to sleep. row.name: Rhythm Taichi XR
row.detailed_description: Rhythm Taichi XR is a physical dancing mixed reality rhythm game that turns your smartphone into a motion camera. It is compatible with most custom songs on beatsaver, and requires no specialized hardware. It is also available as a second screen for your phone or as a standalone VR game. 3D Rhythm, reinvented Rhythm Taichi takes a fresh new approach to 3D rhythm games. Slide your fingers gracefully along the paths traced on the screen, following the beats of the music - it's like practicing Taichi with your fingers! Swipe with style, swipe with ease Rhythm Taichi is built from the ground up, optimized for touch input. A carefully crafted pathing algorithm provides a comfortable yet challenging amount of finger travel for each hand. We've also ruthlessly optimized the game's graphics and networking pipeline to ensure that the game responds quickly and smoothly to your actions. Looks good, feels good too The new touch tracking algorithm is more precise then ever - and with the innovative 'rainfall' style timing effects, you get instant feedback on your synchronization performance. Finishing a song is just the beginning - compete against players around the world by perfecting your runs and submitting your scores on the leaderboard! Thousands of supported songs Rhythm Taichi maintains compatibility with the beat saver song format, and provides an in-game integration with the beat saver API for thousands of supported songs. If you don't wish your songs to be indexed within the game, specify that in the description of your song on beatsaver and send us an email with the link. You can also download songs from beatsaver yourself and install them by using the 'import' function from within the game menu or extract directly to the following directory: C:\Users[Your username]\AppData\LocalLow\Tempstudio, LLC\Rhythm Taichi\savedsongs It's time to dance in XR Rhythm Taichi's 2.0 update features XR mode support on PC. Powered by the latest advancement in artificial intelligence and machine learning, XR mode turns your phone into a high speed motion camera, without needing any specialized hardware. If you have trouble getting started, make sure to read the manual. Virtual Reality Supported Rhythm Taichi supports desktop VR setups (on Windows). Controller phone is not required, but can be used to sign in to submit scores to the leaderboard. Adjust the in-game height with the settings on the left part of the menu if your position is uncomfortable.

PNGTubers became increasingly popularized throughout 2021 and early 2022. What is PNGTuber Maker? PngTuber Maker is a free pngtuber software that can help everyone become pngtuber with few easy steps. You can make a pngtuber avatar by uploading several PNG format pictures of avatar emotions, and PngTuber Maker will detect the surrounding sounds to switch different emotion picture, it makes the virtual avatar is talking. We also provide other features, such as backgrounds, avatar accessories, switching animation, virtual camera, desktop mascot etc. We use sound detection technology to control the opening or closing of the avatar's mouth. You can also try our 3D vtuber software developed by Yimeta How to use PngTuber Maker? 1. Firstly you must upload two png images that contain different expressions of avatar at least. 2. Secondly you need a microphone at least, set the sound threshold, and test the picture effect of speaking. 3. If you need a more realistic effect, add more avatar state pictures to optimize the speaking effect. 4. Then you can set the picture background, avatar dress up to play your endless creativity. 5. Lastly export avatar to desktop or use virtual camera to apply avatar animation to video stream. Sound Detection 2. PNGTuber Avatar Animation 3. Emotion Switch Animation 4. Avatar Accessories 5. Virtual Camera 6. Desktop Mascot

row.name: Xploquest 3
row.detailed_description: The XPLOQUEST saga continues with this third episode. What is XPLOQUEST? It's a turn-based, square-by-square role-playing game. In the world of XPLOQUEST, everyone wants you dead or your money. Things to know: No loot, only gold: In XPLOQUEST enemies and chests don't give you equipment, just gold to spend in towns. Backup only in town: You don't decide when you save the game. It happens automatically when entering and leaving a town. So when you leave a city, make sure you have what it takes. Fights and quests, it's all the way: You cannot flee a fight or stop a quest in progress. Quick fight: When you keep the attack button pressed, the fight takes place automatically. Remember to watch your life. The food: Each move on the map uses a food ration. Don't forget to buy some. Controls: The game is played with the gamepad or the keyboard. You can change the configuration of keyboard controls.

Our studio specializes in scary games, and we often use Japanese folklore and mythology as a source of inspiration. At Kanashi Studio we study the price, and we set an affordable one for all players, 'giving is receiving'.
row.short_description: MITE is a horror game, with some difficulty, in which you play a hiker who has lost his family in a cursed forest... find your family and escape, while strange creatures from Japanese folklore chase you, orient yourself .
row.notes: This game contains gore scenes.

row.name: Keyboard Warrior: Dreamstate Prologue

Upgrade your character(s) with round-based and meta progression systems to mix and match load-outs. Battle through swarms of hungry geometry to emerge victorious.
row.short_description: Movement-based horde-escape madness. Weave through hungry geometry and blast away with dual-wield primary and secondary weapons. Deal damage to charge up your special meter and unleash havoc. Multiple different characters to choose from.

row.name: AmazeVR Megan Thee Stallion VR Concert
row.detailed_description: NOTICE: Due to the 8k video used in this experience, AMD graphics cards are unfortunately not compatible. We apologize for any inconvenience. Embark on a journey into the Hottieverse, the most innovative and high-tech music experience in the world. You’ll be front and center at a private performance by Megan Thee Stallion, with every beat and lyric amplified in stunning virtual reality. Imagine being at an exclusive VIP concert, but with the added thrill of diving into a fully-realized digital world. Not everyone can enter. The gateway is guarded against intruders who might try to break in. Only those with the skill to hack through the security will find themselves face-to-face with Megan Thee Stallion. The stage is larger than life. Experiencing her live-action performance just inches away makes the music seem louder, the beats stronger, and the excitement palpable. Don't miss out on the most high-quality VR concert ever made. Step into the world of Megan Thee Stallion and let the music take over. The free trial offers a preview of one interactive stage. The full ‘Enter Thee Hottieverse’ VR Concert can be purchased in the app and includes behind the scenes footage and shareable highlights. Megan Thee Stallion is the first of many artists to be featured by AmazeVR. Be on the lookout for more VR Concerts this summer.

You’ll be front and center at a private performance by Megan Thee Stallion, with every beat and lyric amplified in stunning virtual reality. Imagine being at an exclusive VIP concert, but with the added thrill of diving into a fully-realized digital world.
