row.name: Eye 4 Eye
row.detailed_description: Eye 4 Eye is a first-person detective adventure puzzle game with retro graphics. It takes place in a futuristic dystopia where everyone has a brain chip installed for the betterment of society. You play as Hazel, a struggling detective, tasked with solving a mysterious missing daughter case in a Victorian mansion inside of a high-tech company complex. Employ your cutting-edge bionic eye and use tools like the search engine, history vision, and item examination to journey down your investigative path. Engage your inner sleuth and challenge yourself with thought-provoking puzzles and enigmatic mysteries as you uncover the truth behind the missing girl. As you unveil the company's dark secrets, experience the thrill of piecing together an intricate mystery in a futuristic world brought to life in a captivating 90s retro aesthetic. Playtime is around 30 - 60 minutes depending on your playstyle. Features: High-Tech Detective Tools - Utilize the search engine to gather clues and piece together the mystery at hand. Puzzle Packed - Put your problem-solving skills to the test as you work to unravel the truth. Can you solve the mystery on your own? Unravel a Dark Conspiracy - Embark on a journey to uncover the truth behind the mysterious disappearance of a young girl. Step into the Future - Immerse yourself in the world of 2073 and unravel the wrongdoing of the powerful high-tech company TempleTech.
row.short_description: Embark on a mission to unveil the truth behind a missing daughter case. Utilize the search engine to gather clues and uncover the dark secrets of TempleTech. Experience a suspenseful journey through the eyes of Hazel.

row.name: Metal March: Beginner Experience
row.detailed_description: Metal March: Beginner Experience is a free playable preview game of Metal March. This version game is includes 1 race and 1 region, a total of 2-3 hours of playable time. You'll see the overall flow of the game, the initial strategy, etc. The full game includes the following! CHESS-inspired turn-based strategy game mixed with card collection genres. (Based on our current updates) Select your troops from 5 races Race-themed areas 7 types of unique troops and 10 types of unique magic powers per race More than 10 types of troops and 20 types of magic shared among troops More than 40 kinds of relics The world has turned into complete chaos. The fragile peace between races has shattered and trust is in short supply. As tensions rise and old alliances crumble, all the races are now preparing for an expedition to the World's Roof. Which one of the races will be the first to reach the Roof? Only YOU will be the one to know. Get ready for an epic adventure to claim the powerful relics atop the World's Roof! Remember, you must be the first to take over the relics at the World's Roof before others. But beware, time is running out. You must be the first to reach the relics before others. With the help of the Wandering Wizard, you can briefly monitor the battlefield and control your troops. You can identify each of your troops with tin dolls with different appearances. All troops have their own movement / attack patterns. In addition to the attributes and characteristics of the troop's powers, these movement and attack patterns are also essential factors that you need to consider in strategy. Thoroughly plan your strategy and win. Effectively win the battle by moving troops where the enemy can't counter-attack and quickly retreating to a position the enemy cannot follow. Strategies like this will matter. MAGIC can be a key that completes your strategy. With Magic, you can either protect or strengthen your team. You can also choose a strategy that destroys enemies with magic attacks. Your magic combination also plays a vital role in the battle. Even within the same collaboration of troops, strategies vary depending on which magic spells you cast and in what order. There are 4 races that you can select for your troops. Each race has its own strengths and weaknesses. You can overcome the weaknesses of your race with the skills and magics of other races. To succeed at the beginning of the expedition, some races need to focus on using their unique strengths while others need to work on overcoming their weaknesses. There is another way to strengthen your troops and magic skills... RELICS! RELICS provide special effects and synergies in ways that can't be obtained from other sources. With relics, you can increase your income during the expedition, add beneficial effects before starting a battle, strengthen certain types of troops & magic powers, and weaken your enemies. You can only activate a limited number of relics, but you can replace them at any time except during battle. Choose and use relics according to your needs and circumstances!
row.short_description: Metal March, is the ultimate fusion of CHESS-inspired turn-based strategy and card game mechanics (CCG)! Create a force that fits your strategy & style and generate powerful synergies by using cards and relics to complete your expedition! Gather your troops and get ready to March your Metals!

row.name: Flood Escape
row.detailed_description: A first person shooter where players see who can survive to be the last one alive as the flood below them rises. Players are pitted against each other in a research lab with a helicopter pad on top in which players can go from one level to another leading to one fire fight to the next in this fast paced combat FPS Battle Royale. There can only be one survivor. Additional Game Modes Present.
row.short_description: A first person shooter where players see who can survive to be the last one alive as the flood below them rises.
row.notes: gun gameplay

row.name: 메스가키 영애님!
row.detailed_description: ♠ Synopsis 'Twenty questions party with Young-ae!' A high school boy who hates chaebol misses his childhood friend Lee Ga-young, who broke up in elementary school. As a timid elementary school student, however, she returned to Young-ae, an active talker Lee Ga-young, who became a conglomerate's hero, offers him 20 questions full of falsehood with opposite personalities... - 20 questions with Young-ae. - 'Mesugaki Young-ae!' Let's start! ♠ Game play - 20 questions! → Mesugaki Young-ae is playing twenty questions. The player will ask 20 questions and must enter the final correct answer. → Three questions are presented randomly at a turn, and the player can choose one question. → The answers to the questions are 'positive', 'negative', and 'neutral', and the user must infer the correct answer. → Young-ae sometimes gives a wrong answer with saying she doesn't know. Users can argue with the correct answer, but there is a limit to the number of times. → You can complete 20 questions, or you can guess the answer during the question. If you get it wrong, the user loses, but if you get it right, you win. → If correct, the user can select various enhancements. You can proceed with 20 questions that are more powerful while strengthening. ♠ Game Play - Date! → At the end of each of the three twenty questions, the user starts a dating event. → A total of four dating events will be held, leading to the final ending at the last event. → Users can choose a variety of ending choices, which can also lead to another story. ♠ Game Play - Extra Stage! → Players who have viewed the True Ending will enter the Extra Stage. → If you clear the extra stage of guessing Eugene Games' characters, the player can cancel the special ending. ♠ Game Information → Genre: Visual Nobel, Miyeon-si → Play method: Proceed with mouse click and fast forward with keyboard key → Play time: 1~2 hours (based on all clear) → Character Illustration: Chapter 3 → Ending: Seven
row.short_description: 'Twenty questions party with Young-ae!'

row.name: 风与鸟 - Wind and Bird
row.detailed_description: 关于我们 玩家反馈群： 183635438 游戏开发者微博： @Yuyering 发行主页： 点击这里进入我们的主页， 关注我们，即可获取更多后续游戏相关消息哦~ 剧情扩展包&原画设定集 欢迎购入剧情扩展包&原画设定集，体验更多内容~ About the Game 《风与鸟》是一款奇幻题材、横版剧情向rpg游戏。 内容以剧情演出为主，也有选项和简单的qte要素穿插在游戏流程中。 长耳族的吟游诗人学徒蒂娜正在跟随着成熟的导师基德进行着周游大陆的探寻之旅。但在一场酒馆演出中，蒂娜却表现出了相当青涩的演出水平。 震惊的师父开始反思自己的教育方针，并决定对蒂娜进行吟游诗人特训！ 刚成为学徒不久的蒂娜就要面对谜语人师父设下的重重考验，她能否顺利成长为合格的吟游诗人？ 经历一路的风景和人文体验，蒂娜游历了充满故事的高塔小镇、穿过了矗立巨石的青色草原，心中的故事页数也在逐渐增加，脱笼的鸟儿正要展翅翱翔。 然而成长之旅绝非一帆风顺。 不平凡的旅途开头，也将对应着不一般的旅途结尾…… 蒂娜 青涩的吟游诗人学徒，跟随师父修行中。 不善交流，但在一点点地学习。 『师父，教教我——』 师父 成熟的吟游诗人大师，精通演出与讲故事。 平日开朗健谈，偶尔也会脱线。 『故事就在你眼前。去吧，蒂娜。』 艾莉娜 高塔之城的新晋管理者，隶属于务实的大地一派。 年纪轻轻便肩负重任。 春菊 路过的活泼吟游诗人。 将吟游诗人大师「蒲公英」视为偶像。 有趣的剧情-观察师徒演出前后的趣味对话，陪伴蒂娜一起旅行，一同吐槽师父的奇思妙想。 清新的画面-游戏中的多个场景拥有令人舒适的吟游诗人主题色，贴近自然的森林绿和天空蓝。 优秀的音乐-故事全流程拥有精心挑选的音乐加持，参与叙事的曲子将给您留下深刻的印象。 巧妙的剧本-插叙与叙事主题的巧妙结合，将故事的全貌留到了最后一刻揭晓！ 「游戏时长」 30分钟-60分钟 「结局数量」 单结局 通关后将在标题界面解锁特典房间 「操作方式」 方向键←→：进行移动 Z/空格/Enter：对话/调查物品 X/ESC：取消/打开菜单 Shift+←→： 跑步 制作人、剧本：摇曳铃 美术：芝秋白，ONE，百合子，雅弥，广廿尺，摇曳铃 UI协力：黛惠 发行：梦结界工作室
row.short_description: 长耳族的学徒蒂娜，跟随着吟游诗人的师父，开始了传颂故事的探寻之旅。带着心爱的吊坠，二人游历过草原，高塔，小镇与森林。然而，在故事的起点和终点，却似乎另有隐情……

row.name: Bloodhound: First day in hell
row.detailed_description: Take the role of a skilled and determined warrior tasked with stopping the malevolent cult of Astaroth. These sinister individuals have called upon the forces of Hell to aid them in their quest for power, and it's up to you to put an end to their nefarious plans. With your trusty firearms at the ready, you'll need to fight your way through hordes of cultists and demons, all while working to prevent Astaroth from making its way to Earth. Do you have what it takes to save the world from certain doom? Dive in a thrilling introduction to the game's action-packed world. In 'First Day in Hell' you'll get a taste of what's to come as you begin your quest to stop the cult of Astaroth. From the first moment, you'll be thrown into the thick of the battle, facing off against waves of enemies as you work to make your way through the demonic realm. With intense, fast-paced gameplay and a hauntingly atmospheric setting. As you journey through the depths of Hell, you'll have access to an impressive arsenal of weapons to aid you in your quest. In 'First Day in Hell' you'll get a taste of what's to come as you wield weapons like the Machete, Revolver, Pump Action Shotgun, Double Barreled Shotgun with Harpoon, and Assault Rifle AG043. Each weapon has its own unique strengths and weaknesses, allowing you to tailor your approach to each encounter. Whether you prefer to get up close and personal with the Machete or take out enemies from a distance with the powerful AG043, Bloodhound's arsenal has something for every playstyle. So gear up, lock and load, and get ready to take the fight to the cult of Astaroth in this adrenaline-fueled shooter.
row.short_description: Crush the cult of Astaroth and vanquish her hellspawn, make them squeal and hide where they came from. Enjoy a Fresh Look & Old Fun in this arcade horror FPS game inspired by the legends of the 90s.
row.notes: Violence, Gore and Nudity. In the game some characters by inflicting large injuries dismember themselves.Some characters have exposed breasts these options are protected by censorship which can be turned off in the menu

row.name: Wobbles
row.detailed_description: A Message From The Developers Wobbles was originally released on August 27th, 2013 for iOS and Android. This is the exact same game released then, just recompiled for PC. As the game was originally built for mobile devices, there may be some terminology such as 'tap' or 'pinch to zoom' that can be be replaced by left clicking with your mouse, or scrolling with your mouse wheel. As this game has not been updated since 2013 and was intended to be a mobile game, there is a possibility that not all features will work as intended. Just something to keep in mind. About the Game Play as a godly figure, guiding a line of adorable creatures called Wobbles across a landscape that you manipulate using various gadgets. As players do this, they are progressing the Wobbles civilization through the eras and advancing their technology, ultimately unlocking new gadgets for you to use. Wobbles features six different eras for players to play through, each with their own unique gadget that modifies the environment around them. Each era features ten levels for you to play in, leaving the player with 60 levels to play. Key Features Progressing Civilization - As players progress the Wobbles civilization, they feel rewarded and like they are making an impact on the Wobbles society. Adorable Creatures - Wobbles are adorable little creatures that everyone will love. Wobbles will have different costumes in each era, adding a lot of variety to the game! Tons of levels - Wobbles has 6 eras for you to progress through, each with 10 levels bringing you 60 levels to play. Unique mechanics and levels - Each world features it’s own unique mechanics combined with the ones unlocked from previous levels. This leads into fun and interesting puzzles that can be solved in many different ways. Awards Wobbles is a winner of the “Best Entertainment Game” award from the Mass DiGI Game Challenge in March 2013, hosted at the Microsoft New England Research and Development Center. A Quick Note Before You Play Wobbles was originally released on August 27th, 2013 for iOS and Android. This is the exact same game released then, just recompiled for PC. As the game was originally built for mobile devices, there may be some terminology such as 'tap' or 'pinch to zoom' that can be be replaced by left clicking with your mouse, or scrolling with your mouse wheel. As this game has not been updated since 2013 and was intended to be a mobile game, there is a possibility that not all features will work as intended. Just something to keep in mind.
row.short_description: Play as a godly figure, guiding a line of adorable creatures called Wobbles across a landscape that you manipulate using various gadgets. As you do this, you progress the Wobbles civilization through the eras and advancing their technology, ultimately unlocking new gadgets for you to use.

row.name: Artovya
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the Wild World of Artovya! As Sir Typhil of Creulor trekked through the kingdom of Artovya and beyond, he met many strange and unusual characters from far off places. Now a vast interdimensional war has broken out in the once peaceful realm. Dive more deeply into the bizarre land of Artovya in a thrilling CCG. Embark on an extraordinary strategic journey where fantasy clashes with futuristic dystopias, strange alien beings, interdimensional chaos, and spine-chilling horror. Each deck you create is a gateway to a new world of possibilities. Welcome to the adventure that seamlessly blends complexity, visual brilliance, and accessible gameplay dynamics. Explore Five Unique Factions: Fantasy: Step into a land of knights, dragons, and ancient magic. Build your strength through healing, summon mighty creatures, and unleash devastating spells upon your adversaries. Alien: Command uncanny alien species with unique abilities and unpredictable strategies. Utilize their biological superiority to outpace and outsmart your enemy. Futuristic: Navigate through a neon-lit dystopian future where technology reigns supreme. Engage in espionage, hack your opponent's deck, and manipulate outcomes with cutting-edge tech. Horror: Delve into the macabre with necromancy and control frightening monstrosities. Paralyze your opponents with fear, and turn the tides by bringing creatures back from the beyond. Interdimensional: Manipulate space, time, and reality at your whim. Warp the very fabric of the game with cards that alter the state of play and disrupt the conventional rules of engagement. Game Features: In-Game Interactive Tutorial: Play through the tutorial levels to learn the mechanics and play styles of the game. Receive five free decks upon completion, so you can start playing right away! Dual-Realm Game Board: Each player commands their own realm. This spatial aspect requires strategic positioning and movement of cards across the board, adding a layer of tactical depth. Master the art of maneuvering your forces to outwit your opponent. Diverse Strategic Approaches: Instead of limiting players to predefined archetypes, Artovya provides a toolbox of versatile and diverse card options, encouraging players to explore their own style of play. Whether you lean towards aggressive assaults, defensive stands, or cunning tactical plays, you'll find the cards to support your strategy. Strategically Paced Gameplay: Gameplay supports more calculated thinking. Artovya invites players to deeply engage with the mechanics and explore creative deck building. This pacing ensures that even non-meta, experimental decks can find their place and succeed, giving players the freedom to try new and unconventional strategies without dying in the first 3 turns or suddenly losing out of nowhere. Regular Updates: The game will be added to with new, interesting features and cards regularly, keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting. Community and Multiplayer Focus: Engage with a vibrant community and challenge players from around the world. Build your decks, share strategies, and make friends. Whether you’re a tactical thinker or a lore enthusiast, this game offers something for everyone. Unleash your creativity, plan your strategies, and rise to become the ultimate master of Artovya. Ready your deck and prepare for battle — the realms await!
row.short_description: Dive into the bizarre land of Artovya in a thrilling CCG! Master five distinct factions—Fantasy, Alien, Futuristic, Horror, and Interdimensional. Forge your strategy with unique mechanics and thrilling battles across fantastical realms. Unleash your creativity, build your deck, and dominate!
row.notes: Due to the ever-evolving nature of the game, the specific content may vary. While we do not plan to add extremely explicit content, content could include: tame nudity, mild drug references (usually fictional or legal drugs), depictions of violent or cruel acts, depictions of undesirable situations or living conditions.

row.name: Farmburgh
row.detailed_description: Farmburgh is a re-imagining of the classic browser point and click idle farming games (you know which ones I'm talking about). Many of those games have since fizzled out or have been converted to mobile cash grabs. Farmburgh dares to be a breath of fresh air on the genre. You can decorate your farm, plant many various crops, raise (sometimes wacky) animals and craft trade goods to sell for a profit. Farmburgh has a little for everyone, from the hardcore optimizer, squeezing every last drop of profit out of their farm to the artistic person, creating a beautiful home for their animals. Whatever your style, come on down to Farmburgh and become the virtual farmer you were always meant to be. What would a farming game be without farming? Plow your fields and plant your crops with just a couple of clicks. Each plant takes a designated real life time to grow, from minutes to hours. Plant a few rows of corn on your lunch break and come back after work to harvest them. All the plants are always in season in Farmburgh, so you have many to choose from. Each one with their own advantages and disadvantages. Be sure to check in often, especially around holidays. The store is known to stock up on special crops during those times. Animals have their place on the farm too! Don't worry though, Farmburgh is a strictly no-kill district. That means you have to come up with some creative ways to gather resources from your animals. We won't tell you what those are yet...that's up to you to see for yourself! Animal's produce a resource every few minutes to every few hours once they reach adulthood. This game never takes itself too seriously. So you may have some exotic animals along side your cows and sheep. Now you've got plenty of produce and plenty of animal products, so now what? You could sell them like that or combine your different resources to make even more money. Some buildings have an option to purchase crafting stations in them. These crafting stations allow you to combine resources to make food, alcohol, textiles and other trade good. Once you set recipe, it'll continue crafting until you tell it to stop or it runs out of ingredients. Just like crop and animals, crafting takes a designated amount of real life time to do. This may take longer than selling directly, but I promise the payoff will be worth it! After all that hard work, it's time to get paid. You're able to sell your goods to various marketplaces. Each marketplace requires a one time purchase in order to use them. They each also have products that sell at a higher or lower price than normal. For instance, you can't sell your homemade vodka at a school bake sale and your knitted sweater wouldn't do well at a winery. You start off with your roadside stand, making minimal profits. Eventually you can work your way up! So you've got tons of cash now, what's next? Decorate your farm with tons of decorations from the catalog. Fences, benches, flags, trees and so much more. New decor is being added all the time. (Protip, the haybales are really good for pixel art!). There's so much more to discover and even more to come! Weekly requests, level system and animal storage top list!
row.short_description: Farmburgh is a point-and-click idle farming sim game that offers a fresh take on the classic genre. Grow crops, raise animals, craft goods, and decorate your farm. Suitable for hardcore optimizers and casual fans alike. Become the ultimate virtual farmer in Farmburgh!

row.name: Speedway Ringer
row.detailed_description: Overview Speedway Ringer is a top-down racer inspired by American stock car oval racing and the real-life challenges of Motorsports. Drivers will need a balance of aggression and patience to perfect their technique and succeed in a chaotic online multiplayer environment. Whether you're a seasoned racer or just a gamer looking for a new challenge, Speedway Ringer is a quick, fun way to race with your friends. Tracks Speedway Ringer features 7 short tracks, each with its own unique characteristics and challenges. The tracks are inspired by real-life American stock car racing circuits. Additional track types are currently in development. Drivers must tune their car to find the right balance of speed and control to achieve the best lap times. In addition to the standard tracks, the game will also feature special event tracks throughout the year that provide unique challenges. Dynamic Track System Driving lines themselves affect the track grip, making every race a unique and challenging experience. As drivers take a line through the turns, they can affect the grip of the track in that area, creating a dynamic optimal line. This means that players must not only focus on their driving skills but also adapt to the changing conditions. This system is tuned to be extremely sensitive and adds to the chaos. Paint Schemes Set your favorite paint scheme and race it online against your friends! For a limited time, join our Discord to submit your own scheme and have it added to the game! Indie Developer Speedway Ringer was primarily developed by one person. Join our Discord to submit feedback and get help from the community. By supporting our first title, you're helping us improve our netcode, physics model, implementing AI, as well as creating the foundation for more racing games in the future!
row.short_description: Speedway Ringer is a top-down racer inspired by American stock car oval racing and the real-life challenges of Motorsports. Drivers will need a balance of aggression and patience to perfect their technique and succeed in a chaotic online multiplayer environment.

row.name: Dead On Your Lawn
row.detailed_description: Prepare for intense action, heart-pounding combat, and a fight for survival where every corner of the dungeon could be your last. Will you have what it takes to reclaim your lawn from the clutches of these parasitic fiends? The challenge is set, and the lawn is yours to protect! In Dead on Your Lawn, you step into a fast-paced world where the dungeon isn't just any dungeon—it's your 'lawn.' The inhabitants of this dark, twisted place refer to their dangerous home as their lawn, and it's up to you to defend it. You'll face off against gruesome monsters—parasite-controlled corpses that want nothing more than to destroy you and your team. The story kicks off with your character on the brink of death, only to be rescued by the Strong Warriors of Reclamation Division (S.W.O.R.D). Now, as a member of this elite team, you must fight to reclaim your lawn from the horrors that infest it. Your mission is clear: eliminate the infection, protect your territory, and ensure that the monsters stay dead on your lawn.
row.short_description: Prepare for intense action, heart-pounding combat, and a fight for survival where every corner of the dungeon could be your last. Will you have what it takes to reclaim your lawn from the clutches of these parasitic fiends? The challenge is set, and the lawn is yours to protect!

row.name: 《蜀山：初章》网络版
row.detailed_description: 《蜀山：初章》网络版是一款由重楼工作室研发的最新国产端游。故事以还珠楼主的《蜀山剑侠传》为大背景，发生在其之后千年灵气复苏之时，包含有：无缝地图、特色修仙、大型社交、领土国战、飞行贸易、肉鸽搭配等诸多开放好玩的国风元素 下载进入《蜀山：初章》网络版后，玩家将面临两种游戏模式： 买断版：一次付费，畅玩《蜀山：初章》PVE模式，极限数值体验 网络版（即将于4月6号发售）：大型MMORPG玩法 《蜀山：初章》网络版与买断版的差异性 【蜀山：初章2023年版本计划及资料片安排】 【联系我们】 游戏特色： 【修仙世界 上天入海】 1.当前可以御剑横空、瞬息千里； 2.当前可以水底探索、也可以在浅水、水面等区域战斗； 3.后续资料片将开放空战、水战，包括：北海陷空岛、东海紫云宫等大型资料片玩法 【肉鸽搭配 百炼千仙】 1.【仙道灵根】：五行或雷、冰；天灵根或伪灵根；什么是你走上仙道巅峰的凭依 2.【奇遇天赋】：初生不凡，探索大千中去搭配独有天赋 3.【飞升境界】：凡人修仙，渡劫筑基，一步一重天 4.【绝世功法】：以功法为核心Build你唯一仙途 5.【神兵词条】：不卖数值不氪金！神兵词条全靠刷刷刷！数百Build体系 6.【自由传承】：十大流派，上千技能！专精或博采众长，随心而定！（当前已开放四大流派300多可收集切换技能） 7.【法宝神通】：独有Build倾向，可瞬时改变战局！也是炼妖飞行的本命核心 【修仙百艺 身份玩法】 1.在蜀山的大世界里，道友可以自由的研究身份玩法：丹、兵、器、宝、物、阵法师、驯兽师、垂钓者、等身份玩法； 2.当前已开放炼丹、炼宝等玩法相关； 【自由贸易 互通有无】 1.寄卖行； 2.摆摊； 3.红袖坊； 【无缝地图 畅爽PK】 1.告别传统日常、副本网游，还原2005年前端游的感动 2.野外族群、野外首领；占地刷怪，包场BOSS 3.从小规模遭遇战到大规模宗族门派约战 【宗族位面 建造征伐】 1.以宗族为核心探索、踏上《蜀山：初章》修仙之旅 2.开辟自己的独有的宗族位面，一起收集、建设自己独一无二的领土 3.诸天征伐，掠夺资源，走上光耀之路 【门派争锋 峨眉斗剑】 1.已开放峨眉、五台两大门派体系 2.统率诸多宗族、斗法争锋 3.势力分布、领地割据：将大世界涂抹成你宗族的颜色
row.short_description: 这是一款东方特色修仙类开放世界游戏；虚幻4制作、7056平方公里无缝大地图、海陆空战斗冒险探索、高自由度角色养成、大地图据点占领门派经营等等；版本里同时包括单人模式及多人在线模式等玩法。（付费点卡）

row.name: Danger Cliff
row.detailed_description: Danger Cliff is a 2D Collectathon Platformer that harkens back to the golden age of internet browser games. You play as Clifford--an overwhelmingly positive young adventurer--followed by his best friend Boxer. One day while the duo was out exploring a set of mysterious sky ruins, Boxer's home starship was blown out of the sky! With no one more competent willing to help, Clifford and Boxer volunteer to explore several huge zones in search of the ship's missing parts before whoever shot it down can get their hands on them. Gameplay: In classic Collectathon style, you start off in a hub world with access to only one level containing several collectables. The more collectables you get, the more new levels you unlock! Eventually, you'll unlock a super-tough boss course which, upon completion, will grant you access to the next set of levels! Cone Rush: Clifford's signature move! When activated, he'll transform into a drill and fly in the direction held. This can be done once horizontally and once upward before needing to recharge by landing. Many of the game's challenges are too large to tackle with a standard jump, so mastery of the Cone Rush is critical! On top of that, there are additional moves such the Air Dash and Power Jump which are not required to beat the game, but allow skillful players to pull off some crazy tricks! Content: The game contains 19 main courses, each with multiple objectives. There are also several extra levels, including dedicated final boss and secret final boss levels, 7 endless challenge rush stages, harder rematches against 6 major bosses, unlockable challenge modes, and more! With a high level of skill, players can beat the final boss after around 2.5 hours of gameplay, while completing the game by getting all 100 collectables will take around 5 hours (First time playthroughs will likely take much longer).
row.short_description: It's a 2D Collectathon! Run, jump and drill your way through huge levels with crazy mechanics and unique visual style to find collectables in whatever order you want!

row.name: Studio 5
row.detailed_description: Experience real-world live performances in unique virtual venues with Studio 5 , powered by Condense. How it works Live events will run at selected dates and times posted on our Discord server. When an event is live, you'll get to select an avatar. Then you'll land in one of Studio 5's virtual venues. You’ll be able to move around, explore the venue and interact with other avatars using your keyboard and mouse. Get ready for a live performance like no other! The performance Powered by video 3.0 technology, you'll experience a real-world live performance captured as 3D video and beamed straight into a virtual venue. Nothing is pre-recorded. The artist can see everyone when they're performing, so be sure to put on your best dance moves and you might even get a shout out! You can send messages directly to the artist during the performance on our Discord too. Become part of our community At Condense, we want to bring the world's live events to virtual spaces, and we want to hear from you. Tell us what you thought about your Studio 5 experience by joining our Discord community.
row.short_description: Experience real-world live performances in unique virtual venues with Studio 5, powered by Condense. Attend live events as an avatar and interact with performers and other fans in-game.

row.name: PROTOTYPE原型
row.detailed_description: Hong Kong, nearest future. Socio-economic crises have not been exhausted, and political contradictions are only getting sharper. However, even against such a background, detached human minds learn to artificially recreate their likeness. Techno-demo about itself, about self-reflection of the unfinished and artificial. My attempt to convey the voice of those who are dismissed and forgotten in the stream of indifferent progress. Novel features: - fully animated graphics in retro style. - different forms of psychological and physical violence. - hard electronic soundtrack. - an intricate plot that requires careful reading.
row.short_description: A cinematic techno-thriller about the fate of the intermediate links of progress.
row.notes: this game contains violent scenes and scenes of smoking

row.name: Enkate
row.detailed_description: Enkate is an action rpg rogue like where death is final. Only wings persist after death, rare and precious items which improve as the player progresses. 3 playable classes : - Savage : tank/support - Mercenary : dps - Veterinary heal /support It is necessary to compose balanced teams to defeat the most terrible enemies, and to equip yourself with the best objects found on enemies, or crafted with resources. story Writings handed down for several generations recount the event that radically changed the organization of human society on Earth, destroying its structure and breaking it up into hundreds of thousands of “lands” floating like a cloudy star in space. The earth would have been the battleground of several extra-terrestrial people, and armed with extremely powerful technology, their clashes would have reduced the planet to a heap of floating debris. We don't know for certain how much time has passed since the ultra-bang, given the little temporal indication since the disorganization of the solar system. Days and nights follow each other chaotically in a world where the calendar and the seasons no longer exist. High engineers still estimate that we are currently between 2269 and 2286. On Enkate, the last human institutions organize themselves to ensure their survival. The only hope is the reappropriation of the different lands floating in the form of piles of residues in the universe to exploit the resources still present there. The Enkatonian high engineers have developed a process to open a portal to these different lands, where soldiers are transported in order to acquire information and establish a lasting colony if possible. The portal must nevertheless be set up by a team of explorers to allow the teleportation of the rest of the soldiers, but its lifespan cannot exceed thirty minutes.
row.short_description: An action-rpg multiplayer with rogue-like influences, in a post-apocalyptic world.

row.name: The Secret of Darkwoods
row.detailed_description: Open-word illustrated text-based RPG The Secret of Darkwoods is an open-world, procedural, text-based RPG that allows players to explore a vast and dangerous world filled with secrets and treasures to discover. The game is set in the mythical land of Emeyralia, a dark and foreboding place where ancient magic and mythical creatures still exist. Players take on the role of a brave adventurer who must journey through the treacherous forests, swamps, and dungeons of Emeyralia in order to uncover the secrets of the land and become a true hero. As they explore the world, players will encounter a wide variety of enemies and obstacles, from fierce beasts and powerful warriors to treacherous traps and hidden dangers. Choose your fate in this non-linear fantasy gamebook. Key Features 800+ Unique Text Pages With Variations 350+ Generated Illustrations Play the main quest (3 to 5 hours), or randomly explore and start side quests Explore villages, cities, dungeons, swamps, caves, forests, cemeteries and temples Music by Dungeon Synth Artists: Percidae, Hjartans, Bounce castle, Alloch Nathir, Kasriel, Erang, Black Rose Tomes, Infernal Symphony, Rap2h In order to survive the dangers of Emeyralia, players will need to use their cunning, strength, and dexterity to overcome their enemies and progress through the game. They can choose from a variety of weapons, armors, and abilities to help them in their quest, and they can also collect valuable treasures and artifacts to aid them on their journey. The game features stunning ai-generated visuals, and its atmospheric soundtrack is composed by seven talented dungeon synth composers. Inspired by Daggerfall and Fighting Fantasy gamebooks, The Secret of Darkwoods is an original RPG experience that will keep players coming back for more. Visit more than 25 towns, villages, and cities. Explore cemeteries, swamps, caves, dungeons, forests, and temples. Talk with people in taverns, in shops, or in the streets, and ask them for scripted quests or procedurally generated ones. Fight deadly monsters.
row.short_description: Open-world illustrated text-based RPG. Inspired by classic role-playing video games and fantasy gamebooks, the secret of darkwoods is a free game, a non-linear standalone adventure with side quests in a vast world.

row.name: Boba Boyz
row.detailed_description: This one-player visual novel features seven unique musical numbers, a cute cafe shop, and a plot that will keep you on your toes! Boba Boyz centers around a bubble tea shop that serves literal happiness in a cup! The boba is irresistible and never fails to brighten customers' days. When you need a summer job, you get to know the four charming baristas running the joint: Aero, Berkeley, Carmen, and Diego. Be careful though, once you've been serenaded and wrapped up in these boys' minigames, boba won't be the only thing bringing a smile to your face.
row.short_description: This all-new video game musical centers around a bubble tea shop with a secret: their boba actually brings happiness to its customers! When the boys need a new employee after their last crew member mysteriously disappears, boba won't be the only thing you fall in love with.
row.notes: Content includes depictions of suicide, depression, and murder.

row.name: ADT Pilot 01
row.detailed_description: Due to some unwanted circumstances, worlds are on the brink of demise. It is now up to you to determine the fate of the two dimensions. After getting the information you need from the auxiliary Artificial Intelligence, please make the decision you believe is the most justice. Gameplay In this interactive fiction, you get to play as the pilot of a critical mission, and by choosing dialogue branches and making decisions that will pose impacts on the two alternative dimensions, you would become the hero who saves humanity. Your participation in the operation is very much appreciated.
row.short_description: Confront the moral dilemma, and then become the hero that saves the world.
row.notes: This game contains strong language and disturbing scenes.

row.name: Homebound: New Beginnings
row.detailed_description: Hunting the past of your ancestry you find yourself washed up on the lands of Solaria. You can feel the magic flowing through the land and the many creatures living alongside one another but there is a tear in the land, the creatures are at ends, there is distrust among the people, can an outsider heal the damage that was done many years ago and discover the secrets of the Solarian Islands. Survive - Build - Thrive (The below describes the planned versions of these features that are being worked towards, while in Early Access these features will exist in simpler forms and grow along the way.) Survive Landing astray you need to get your bearings. Farm, fish, cook and fight to survive in the wilderness of a magic land. Your ancestors journal will come in handy but not everything in this land is edible be ready for wild magic, will the herbs let you fly or put you to sleep for the day? Better do your research. Build Build complex structures to attract companions to join you and your budding townships, with enough time you'll be able to grow prosperous towns all over Solarian that feed into one another. On the island of the Grave you could build a place of prayer, blessing your towns with the inspiration of the dead, or maybe you're a combatant who prefers to sacrifice demons at the Gravelands to earn your blessing. Thrive You've begun to heal the lands but surviving isn't enough, you can have a wood axe but without proper technique you can't craft a Master-grade tool, perfect your crafts and learn from the neighbours to evolve into the territory of thriving. The islands of Solaria are waiting so get on the ship before it's too late.
row.short_description: Explore, craft, build and thrive in the magical lands of Solaria. Discover the curse that destroyed these lands and your connection to the past as you grow relationships between clans of magic and monsters, but maybe not all is as it seems?

row.name: Death Gunfire - Kill the Zombie
row.detailed_description: An oasis island originally rich in resources, due to the attack of the virus, everyone was infected with the mutated virus, and the whole island was full of the breath of death... How do you defeat these zombies when you are the only survivor on the dead island? Can you survive? You will play as the only survivor on the Dead Island, use your weapons, or shoot the gasoline tanks to kill these zombies. Now put on your haptic vest and VR headset, pick up your VR joystick, and defeat these zombies! Death Gunfire - Kill the Zombie is a zombie shooting game that combines VR and a haptic vest to allow you to go deeper into the environment and shock your senses. The thrill of shooting zombies and the vibration of the haptic vest will swarm as the zombie’s attack, allowing you to have a more incredible gaming experience when playing the game alone. • Addictive single player. • The vibrations from the haptic vest swarm your senses when a zombie attack or a gas tank explodes. • Get up close and personal with zombies to enhance your sense of terror.
row.short_description: An oasis island originally rich in resources, due to the attack of the virus, everyone was infected with the mutated virus, and the whole island was full of the breath of death... How do you defeat these zombies when you are the only survivor on the dead island? Can you survive?...

row.name: Aashaa
row.detailed_description: Soon to be crowned, royal princess Aashaa is betrayed by her jealousy-filled brother, Bakwas, and cast down into the depths of the kingdom's dungeon. Untouched for over hundreds of years, the dungeon is a force to be reckoned with. In order to fight for her spot as Queen, Aashaa must brave every floor of the dungeon and find her way out before Bakwas can take the throne. Controller Support: Supported for all gamepad types (Xbox, PS, Valve, etc) Speedrunning: An intuitive speedrunning system is built into the game including a smart timer integrated into the interface and a stats reveal that is shown when the game is completed. This mechanic allows for a more intense gaming experience and encourages the player to find shortcuts. Controls: WASD or Arrows or Left Joystick to Move M or Gamepad Shoulder Buttons to Mute K or Right Click or Gamepad Trigger Buttons to Dash R or Gamepad North Button to Self Destruct Space or Gamepad East Button or Gamepad West Button to Interact Escape or Gamepad Start Button or Gamepad Select Button to Exit to Main Menu
row.short_description: A quick atmospheric 2D precision platformer taking place in Medieval India where the player must take back the throne. Repeatedly dying and finding game breaking exploits is heavily encouraged in this short indie title.

row.name: Kristal Mağara
row.detailed_description: Kristallari topladığımız bu oyunda amacımız platformdan aşağıya düşmeden ve top mermilerine hedef olmadan bölümü tamamlamaktır.Basit eğlence türündeki kristal mağara el ve göz koordinasyonuna çok iyi bir şekilde hakim olan oyuncular için bile zorlayıcı bir platform oynudur.Toplam 5 level'den oluşan oyunda iyi vakit geçirip eğlenmeniz dileğiyle T.E GAMES
row.short_description: Kısa bir platform oyunu tüm kristalleri toplayıp bir sonraki seviyeye geçiyoruz oyun toplam 5 seviyeden oluşuyor

row.name: Colourblind
row.detailed_description: Join our discord! About the Game Made entirely by A 15-Year-Old Aspiring Game Developer, Step into a futuristic, colourless world as a robotic protagonist . Unleash your mastery over machines and the power of COLOURS to unravel mind-bending puzzles . Are you ready to bend reality ? Combine Colours to form new Colours! Split Colours into their Constituents! Solve mind-bending puzzles in an expansive post-apocalyptic world Meet many funny and charming robot characters! Uncover the dark truth behind a dystopian world of dead robots 5 Chapters, 5 Locations , 5 Characters, 1 Journey, are you ready?
row.short_description: Solve mind-bending puzzles using COLOURS of Coreium and Innovative Mechanics... and discover a terrible truth... Made by a 15-Year-Old aspiring Game Developer

row.name: Thief Simulator 2: Prologue
row.detailed_description: You and a buddy robbed a mob. You lived a nice life until assassins burst into your house. They found you. You have to find the hidden contact with your friend and together somehow get out of trouble. Go wild in a typical American town. 4 houses are available for theft, all with different loot. Who knows what you'll find? More than 5 missions to complete (from robberies to planting suspicious packages on people, or taking photos for hire). Buy numerous tools of all kinds - use them to help yourself while plunging into others' houses. Crowbars, lockpicks, binoculars, ATM hacking tools etc.
row.short_description: Tired of political exploitation? Join me and let's rebuild our thieving business together! Let's steal cars, radios, and TVs - anything that catches your eye can be yours! Recall what it's like to be a thief in Thief Simulator 2: Prologue!

row.name: Hexagon Puzzle Blocks
row.detailed_description: Hexagon Puzzle Blocks is an isometric puzzle game designed to engage your mind and relax your senses. With every level, you'll encounter a hexagonal grid that changes in shape and layout, challenging you to fit colorful puzzle pieces perfectly within the grid. Each new level brings fresh configurations, ensuring the gameplay stays varied and stimulating. As you progress, you'll develop your spatial reasoning skills, using logic and creativity to place each shape. The game's calming design, intuitive controls, and soothing atmosphere make it an ideal experience for puzzle enthusiasts and casual players alike. Whether you're looking to unwind or seeking a mental challenge, Hexagon Puzzle Blocks offers hours of satisfying gameplay. With dozens of levels to explore and endless strategies to discover, this game is perfect for anyone who enjoys thoughtful, rewarding puzzles. Try your hand at filling the grid and find yourself immersed in a world of relaxing problem-solving. Key Features: Varied hexagonal grids and puzzle shapes in each level Engaging gameplay that encourages creative thinking and spatial awareness Relaxing atmosphere, designed for casual and puzzle fans alike A satisfying blend of challenge and simplicity to suit all skill levels Start playing today and see how far your puzzle-solving skills can take you!
row.short_description: Get ready to challenge your skills with this isometric puzzle game! Each level presents a new hexagon grid and selection of colored shapes to fit together. With a relaxing yet challenging gameplay experience, this game is perfect for puzzle fans of all levels. Exercise your brain and have fun today!

row.name: Spaceminers
row.detailed_description: WHAT IS SPACEMINERS? During this Early Access phase, you enrol in the Spaceminers Academy as a Cadet, launching your adventure with Spaceminers: Gold Runner . This initial game mode presents you with a timed racing obstacle course where you compete against yourself and the global leaderboard to get the best time over the finish line. As autumn approaches, we will introduce Spaceminers: Gold Warrior , an engaging Co-op PVE Arena, and in early 2024, you can eagerly await the release of the ultimate game mode, Spaceminers: Gold Miner , a Gold-Digging training experience. SPACEMINERS: GOLD RUNNER TOURNAMENT We will host regular in-game tournaments where you run the course and compete for a place on the global leaderboard to win Real Gold . The winners of our in-game tournaments will get a digital proof of ownership of the gold they have won, which is physically held in a Swiss vault. SPACEMINERS GAME MECHANIC Master the art of movement and combat with these core features: Double Jump: Soar to new heights with a trusty double jump. Aerial Maneuvers: Pivot and navigate freely through the air, gaining the upper hand. Stamina System: Manage your stamina to sprint faster, jump farther, and outpace your rivals. The Rockbreaker: Unleash this devastating grenade launcher to clear your path and conquer your foes. Jump into the action and experience the thrill of Spaceminers! SPACEMINERS: GOLD RUNNER The course is divided into eight different zones designed to challenge your skills: Burial Chambers : Master the jump and double jump system Vipers' Pit : Evade deadly fireball obstacles Hades' Lair : Quickly find your way out before the room is filled with acid Boulder Dash : Time your jumps perfectly to avoid being crushed by massive boulders Hoodoo Hop : Eliminate as many enemies as you can without sacrificing speed Laser Chase : Run and avoid the colossal spaceship laser beams Sacred Mountain : Run, climb, and kill enemies to reach the Sacred Temple Sacred Temple : Sprint through the hallowed Temple to collect your Gold Nugget COMING SOON The full Spaceminers game is set to launch in 2025. In this final stage, players will employ all the skills they've honed at the Spaceminers Academy to confront the enemy and claim control over the universe's gold.
row.short_description: Spaceminers is a free-to-play game where you can win Real Gold. Spaceminers: Gold Runner is a timed racing obstacle course and is the first of three game modes in our Early Access phase that will be released throughout 2023 and 2024. The full Spaceminers game launches in Spring 2025.

row.name: Mr. Pogo
row.detailed_description: Hide the tears and ignore the pain in this ridiculous game about a Clown on a Pogo stick! -entertain the crowds, do crazy stunts.  -Free base game, if frequently requested, a DLC with more levels will be added.  -Colorful 2D graphics. -skill based game mechanics. -Funny gameplay, to fail is to laugh! -9 levels, free to play.  -5 outfits to unlock.  -Steam achievements. -Steam rankings. -controller support (but not all functions)
row.short_description: Hide the tears and ignore the pain in this ridiculous game about a Clown on a Pogo stick!

row.name: Love Birds
row.detailed_description: Join Our Discord For Beta Testing, New Content, Soundtrack Downloads, And More! Slay the cat population! Cats kill over 2 billion birds a year and it's time to strike back. Kill kitties, kill creatures, get loot, fly around, find weapons, play with your friends, explore our unique open world, free imprisoned birds, craft weapons, play as multiple bird types, lay eggs, create a base, and build a bird army. Make your friends join this revenge story All networking is handled by us, no need for port forwarding or internet to Lan services! Explore the many different biomes on your rampage Forests, Desert, Swamp, Jungle, Arctic Enact advanced weaponry! We intentionally make each weapon type unique Free your bird brethren, have them fight with you! YOU RESPAWN AS THEM Them kitties guard these cages, and you need them! Get killing! SPAWNING You spawn in as a random species of bird in a random spot of the Starter Forest. You're given 2 army members, a frog as a weapon, and 3 random starting items. The immediate area around you is cleared of any enemies. MULTIPLAYER Multiplayer is all handled by us, so no need for port forwarding or internet to Lan services. You can join through Steam, or a room code. CHARACTERS You can play as multiple types of birds, each with separate abilities. The Wren is small and fast, the phoenix poops fire, and the penguin can't fly instead he slides very fast on his lil belly. ENEMIES The kitties on the map defend camps where you'll find imprisoned birds, free them and they'll join your army. Other creatures are defending the imprisoned birds as well, and are ready to take you down. WEAPONS There's many weapon types each with distinct abilities. Stab or throw your spear, draw your bow for a clean one shot headshot, use a frog to instantly eat an enemy, use a magic staff to blow your foes away. Each weapon has infinite ammo yet a durability so prepare to go through many different weapons on your journey. You'll have to personally supply your bird army with said weapons so make sure to have a plethora. CRAFTING Crafting allows you to build the weapons you need on the fly. Place the items on the ground and press your build key over them. In the escape menu you can find the crafting recipes page to help. Crafting items are spawned throughout the world and in chests. THE WORLD This is an open world with lots of different biomes and enemy types to explore. Each biome has unique creatures and kitties to both haunt and destroy you. Have fun! The forest has kitties that shoot hairballs and ones that grab you, the jungle has pixies, the swamp has ogre kitties and sorcerers, the desert has cowboy kitties and mummies, so on and so forth! MUSIC Love Birds also has an awesome soundtrack made by yours truly (Jaxon Hill). With every song made specifically for the game :) Including many battle themes to prevent them from getting repetitive.
row.short_description: Get them cats! Play alone or join your friends to free every last imprisoned bird, but that's not your only goal. All those forest freaks are gonna be out to get you. Explore the many different biomes, and build up your base! Raise a bird army!

row.name: Find the Birds
row.detailed_description: Find the Birds is a free to play educational game about birds and conservation. There are no paid upgrades nor ads. It is a 2D simulated birdwatching experience. Player travel the globe, to places such as Illinois (USA), Japan, Arizona (USA), and British Columbia (Canada). Once there, they explore and try to find local birds, some of which are endangered. For finding them, the receive points. They then use these points in the simulated stores to exchange for tools to do quests to help the birds, such as placing nest boxes. Players can also take photos using the camera tool interface and store them in their simulated album using that interface. Player use such icons and interfaces to play the game.
row.short_description: Find the Birds is a free to play educational game about birds and conservation.

row.name: 鏖战三国

row.name: Music Store Simulator Prologue
row.detailed_description: Join Our Discord Try this About the Game Welcome to the free sample of our game! Music Store Simulator Prologue! In this immersive experience, you get to be the mastermind behind a successful musical instrument manufacturing company. In Music Store Simulator Prologue, you can create, sell, and earn while constantly improving and developing your business. Your customers will come to you with their dream musical instrument requests, and it's up to you to make their dreams a reality. From the assembly work, to painting and configuration, you'll be in charge of the entire process. As you exceed your customers' expectations, your reputation will grow, and more customers will be lining up to place orders with you. With every successful order, you'll earn profits that can be reinvested to buy more advanced tools and unlock additional rooms to expand your atelier. As you improve the quality of your musical instruments, you'll have the opportunity to produce your own unique instruments, add them to your private collection, and even sell them online. In Music Store Simulator Prologue, your success depends on your skill level and experience with different materials and don't forget to keep your warehouse stocked with the parts, paintings, glues, and tools you need to keep production going. Your tools will get old over time, so be sure to invest in better equipment and work tables to speed up procedures and reduce production time. As you grow your brand, you'll have the chance to expand your business by launching advertising campaigns and producing musical instruments in different countries. With the right strategy and financial management, you'll be able to open branches all over the world and become a worldwide musical instruments producer. In the Music Store Simulator Prologue, the possibilities are endless. Are you ready to take on the challenge of building a successful musical instrument manufacturing company? Get started today and unleash your creativity! Features Graphic design and modelling aimed to reproduce accurately all the details of the musical instruments. 2 Electric Guitars to create. More than 50 pieces to use, all customizable in materials and finishing. Production of instruments based on specific orders of customers from all over the world. Typical production steps: joint, screwing, gluing. Realistic timing: painting and glue drying requires different processing times (in the meanwhile will have to progress on other orders). Warehouse management of pieces, paintings, glues and tools. Opportunity to play the musical instruments you created (of course after tuning them!).
row.short_description: With Music Store Simulator Prologue you can lead a musical instruments manufacturing company. Create, sell, earn and reinvest improving and developing your business. Expand your Brand and climb to success in order to become the world's largest manufacturer of musical instruments!

row.name: Postmouse
row.detailed_description: From the students of the Animation Workshop, Postmouse is a third-person single-player puzzle platforming game about a timid mouse who has to go on their first adventure to deliver mail. Having always dreamt of the world beyond their little post-office, Postmouse is emboldened to enter the great unknown. Meet charming animals, solve precarious puzzles and explore ruins of a time long past on your mission to deliver letters to those waiting to hear from their loved ones.  ____________________________________________________________________________  FEATURE LIST:  Run around and explore a vast, ruined landscape situated in the midst of a 19th century abandoned mansion - a lovingly handcrafted, overgrown teslapunk landscape.  Solve environmental puzzles, navigate treacherous climates, and most importantly - deliver the mail on time!  Meet and talk to the many diverse residents of the Yellow Woods on your journey - listen to their worries, and they may even help you on your way. Help Postmouse tackle new, exciting situations on a journey that explores the boundaries of their comfort zone.  Collect stamps for the local collector as you explore to receive beautiful concept art and background story.    ____________________________________________________________________________    STUDIO STORY - who are we?   In an isolated town, in the middle of Denmark, surrounded by fields. In a campus made from old military barracks. You find an education in Animation and Computer Graphics. There, in the dark, lit up only by blue light from computer screens, you will find a large group of students with a lot of creative energy. - Critters Collective! Formed, because we had no other choice. Please, do enjoy. It has been made with blood, sweat, tears and the occasional beer.
row.short_description: Join Postmouse on their very first journey to deliver mail in a treacherous world unfit for a tiny mouse. Explore the ruins, meet charming characters and solve puzzles on your way through an abandoned mansion in this free, student-made adventure - all in one small mouse-sized package!

row.detailed_description: A collection of 191 solitaire variants + 21 puzzles with NSFW pictures. Press Space key in emergency to instantly switch to standard boring cards on a green table.  Win solitaire games and then play puzzles to unlock hundreds of pictures in the gallery. Create your own card sets in an in-built cards editor. Even with animated GIFs or videos! Note: if you don't need the porn, please download Free Solitaire app of mine instead. row.name: Weird and Unfortunate Things Are Happening
row.detailed_description: “THERE IS NO NIGHTMARE IN DAYBREAK. THE CITY IS ABSOLUTELY FINE. PLEASE FORGET THAT IT EVER EXISTED.” Weird and unfortunate things are happening in the city of Daybreak. To the rest of the world, the city seems to have simply vanished, but inside, it has become a playground for mysterious beings who see humans only as hosts for their own amusement. Alicia’s a bit strange. She still likes to wear her old baseball jersey, even though her team disbanded over a year ago. She can see otherworldly creatures that no one else seems to notice. She also has weird powers that she keeps hidden from the rest of the world. But when she receives a call for help from her niece in Daybreak, she’ll do anything to save her. Caught up in the struggle along with Alicia are Miriam, a secretary and gun aficionado who only wants to escape the city, Lamar, an overworked middle school English teacher, and Dottie, Alicia’s niece, who has been captured for some nefarious purpose. Explore what’s left of the ravaged city and find your way through surreal otherworldly areas that connect the broken urban shell. Encounter any other citizens who have survived and make contact with the strange entities that now inhabit this realm. Survive. Or be swallowed up by the city and forgotten forever. Turn-based RPG with a survival edge - scrounge the ruined city for restorative items, money, obols (special currency used to buy skills) and rare collectors items to sell for cash! Exploration is always rewarded with new items, equipment, and secrets around every turn! Meet a wide variety of characters, human and otherwise. Allies, survivors, and power-mad villains await! Enjoy tactical battles where fighting wisely will allow you to decimate foes! Strategize your attacks against the eight different types of foe, and figure out the mysterious Unknowns, whose strengths and weaknesses are hidden from you! Customize your characters' battle style with over fifty unique active and passive skills in the Skill Space. There's much more to this world than meets the eye. Find hidden corridors between realities, puzzle through eldritch languages, and collect bizarre curios to help unravel Daybreak's mysteries. Four difficulty levels allow you to adjust the game to your liking, even in the midst of play! From a walk in the park to a deadly journey through hell, play the way you enjoy the most. Estimated playtime is 15-20 hours. Warnings : Game contains flashing lights and swearing.
row.short_description: Join Alicia as she tries to save her niece from a city warped and twisted by otherworldly beings in this eccentric RPG.

row.name: Under Maintenance
row.detailed_description: After a rough day at work, all you want to do is settle in with your favorite otome game, only to realize it's gone down for maintenance. How will you pass these troubling times? Risk going to a watering hole to drown your sorrows in a beverage of choice? Begrudgingly scroll through a dating app to meet your love for the night? Either way - adventure, shenanigans, and hot singles in your area await! Disclaimer: heartache probable - choose wisely. Features A nameable protagonist with configurable skin and hair tones; Partial voice acting; Four routes with multiple endings; Eight CGs; A floofy cat; In-game texting, including with your nameable BFF; Accessibility options - OpenDyslexic and Atkinson Hyperlegible fonts, two text sizes to choose from, darkmode and lightmode textbox options. Content Warnings Strong language/profanity. Mentions of alcohol and alcohol use. Sexually suggestive content without explicit descriptions or depictions.
row.short_description: An everyday dramedy otome game that asks the tough question: When a game about love goes down for maintenance, can the game of love begin?

When The Devil Takes Hold Playtest
Obsta-Loop
row.detailed_description: Obsta-Loop is a zany, goofy, yet unforgiving 2d platformer in which you must reach an exit while running a formidable obstacle course. You have no weapons... your only chance is to exit the death gauntlet using evasion, agility power-ups and mastering your environment. Don't forget to collect treasure along the way! There are many paths and many solutions, so pay attention to your surroundings and be prepared to try, and try again. Primary Features: Single player or split screen competitive multiplayer (multiplayer is not yet available and will be added later (see roadmap in Early Access section for details)) Multi-path, Non-linear level design Tons of hidden paths and secrets to discover Permadeath! Die and retry in an unforgiving environment where one-hit kills. Various types of treasure Power-ups and modifiers that change gameplay in fun and interesting ways Varied enemies and hazards Player customization with colors and masks Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to reach an exit as quickly and as lucratively as possible with the highest score... and your LIFE!!!
row.short_description: The Spiritual Successor to our NES classic, Exit-Loop. Its the NEW most Fun-Zaniest, Insaneist, Death-Loopiest, Crypt-Pillageist experience ever! Now with power-ups, masks, Multiplayer AND ON PC! (...Multiplayer coming soon!!!)
row.notes: The game contains comically gratuitous pixelated blood and accompanying gore sound effects. The Game also contains juvenile humor like farting.

row.name: Kitchen Chaos - Learn Game Development
row.detailed_description: NOTE: This is a learning project. This is the final game created by following my FREE YouTube course. The customers are hungry, it's up to you to fill them up! Pick up some ingredients, prepare them, put them on a plate and deliver them. Work with the various counters to prepare them. Pick up a full Cheese block, cut it into slices, then cook a Meat Patty (but don't let it burn!), pick them up on a Plate, add some Bread and you have a nice burger! Features: - 7 Ingredients to use - 3 Complete Recipes to create - 6 unique Kitchen Counters to interact with ----------------------------------------------- Watch the full FREE course video to learn how to build this game step-by-step starting completely from scratch over 45 Lectures. If you're a complete Beginner or a more Intermediate user you will learn a lot from following this course. The quality of the code in this course is on the same level as my own games, so you will learn how to make games just like a Professional Indie Game Developer using clean code and good project architecture. You will learn the basics of Unity and C#, how to make a Character Controller and detect Collisions. How to do Physics Raycasts, use C# Interfaces and Events. How to use Scriptable Objects, Shader Graph, build a UI and tons more! Everything we're going to do is going to be focused on writing good easy to understand clean code. Meaning that I will not be teaching you bad practices that some beginner tutorials teach. The code that we're going to write here is production quality code , it is not a throwaway demo. The quality of the code and the structure of the game that we're going to build is on the same level of quality as my own Steam games Like I said this is a completely FREE course but it has the same level of quality as my paid courses. Check it out on my YouTube channel. The FREE Multiplayer Course expansion is out now! Learn how to synchronize data across multiple clients, how to decide on Server Authoritative vs Client Authoritative, learn about RPCs and NetworkVariables, what data should be server-side and what can be client-side, learn how to make a Character Selection scene, Multiplayer Lobbies and connect your players together with Relay. This course starts off exactly from where the singleplayer course left off, you can watch that course to see how we got to the starting point. All the code here was written during the course, there was nothing done off-screen. Just like the singleplayer course, here I will be teaching you how to write good high quality clean code just like I use in my own Steam games. About me: I've been an Indie Game Developer for over 10 years and 5 years ago I started the Code Monkey YouTube channel to share my knowledge to help you learn how to make your own games. Check out my games on Steam and then watch my YouTube channel to see how I made them! For some interactive learning check out my Free Code Monkey App here on Steam
row.short_description: NOTE: This is a learning project, learn how to build this game! - The customers are hungry, it's up to you to fill them up with all kinds of interesting interactions!

row.name: Jump Tale
row.detailed_description: Jump Tale is a simple 2D Platformer with 10 different playable “Characters”. It's your Goal to finish all the 110 Levels with the best possible time and the least possible deaths. Features 11 Different Worlds 10 Different Characters 110 Levels in Total Switches between Characters in Levels Different dangers to dodge Time and Death tracking Can you beat the levels with the least deaths possible? Can you beat your own best times and always get faster? Post your score in the Community hub!
row.short_description: Jump Tail is a simple 2D Platformer with 10 different playable “Characters”. It's your Goal to finish all the 110 Levels with the best possible time and the least possible deaths.

row.name: Eggsplorer
row.detailed_description: This game is a single player game that can be enjoyed offline. The story starts in a mysterious temple. Your goal is to manipulate the egg to capture four unique stages, obtain the owl statue, and open the gate leading to the back of the temple. 'A stage with a gate that grows and shrinks' 'A stage with glass that breaks when dropped using height' 'Staging puzzles offline using a mirror image of yourself' 'A stage that uses a portal to transfer objects' These four stages await you. Solve puzzles to get goal items. One stage can be cleared in about 15 minutes. What awaits after obtaining all the owl statues? Please check it out. Also, find 3 hidden items in each stage and take on the challenge! Trailer BGM scratch record Trailer BGM by HURT RECORD
row.short_description: A game in which you control an egg-shaped player to explore 4 unique levels.

row.name: Midnight彌奈
row.detailed_description: 【雙主線視角，任意探索】 -雙主角路線，相互影響的兩人會激盪出什麼樣的火花？ -無固定、限時主線，隨時遊玩、絕對自主的劇情體驗。 -深化彼此的情感，是否看見他們深藏的另一面？ 【多重結局，百玩不膩】 -不經意的一句話，無心的某個決定，將引致全然不同的命運。 -探索劇情的過程，衍生的人與人的相遇，究竟是巧合，還是不可逃脫的命運？ 【8款獨立小遊戲，彩蛋道具好入手】 -不管是考驗靈活度的手影遊戲，亦或是手眼協調的節奏遊戲，成功通關後將帶來重大發展。 -能不能順利通關，絕對是劇情決策點。每一步都影響後續故事推展，千萬要小心注意喔！ 【沉浸式體驗，即時互動不間斷】 -每個決定、每種互動，以及每次的重大時刻，遊戲內將一一紀錄。 -撥動命運齒輪的一瞬間，社群上又出現什麼樣的變化？

row.name: Monster Tower Quest
row.detailed_description: You play as a hero on a quest to reach the top of a mysterious tower. The tower is filled powerful monsters that stand in your way. To defeat these monsters and progress through the tower, you will need to use your puzzle-solving skills to match 3 or more of the same colored gems together. As you make your way up the tower, you will encounter a variety of different monsters. By matching the correct gems and power ups together, you can unleash powerful attacks that will help you take down even the toughest foes. Each gem you match is kept, and can be used to create more monters. Collect monsters to build up a team of powerful allies to help you on your journey. This game combines the match 3 puzzle gameplay with the fun of collecting monsters!
row.short_description: You play as a hero on a quest to reach the top of a mysterious tower filled powerful monsters. You will need to use your puzzle-solving skills to match 3 or more of the same colored gems together to defeat your enemies as you make your way up the tower.

row.detailed_description: Take part in a number of marksmanship challenges while you explore Bang Bang Land an abandoned theme park designed by a Gun Nut that had to be closed down due to serious Health & Safety concerns and injury claims! Push your self to be the best in over 20 unique Marksmanship challenges with a variety of weapons at your disposal. Enjoy a number of theme park rides including a Roller-coaster, Waltza and some Unique to Bang Bang Land designed to push your balance and coordination to its limits while you try to take out as many targets as possible! **MAY NEED TO SIT DOWN DURING PLAY**
row.short_description: Take part in a number of marksmanship challenges while you explore Bang Bang Land an abandoned theme park designed by a Gun Nut that had to be closed down due to serious Health & Safety concerns! Can you help it to reopen?

row.name: New rule: The game is Playtest
Bangkok Story: A Stray Dog Playtest
Hank: Straightjacket
row.detailed_description: The time-traveling vigilante Hank has been captured by the devious Unraveler. However, before the crime genius gets rid of the hero, he must satisfy his curiosity - How has this pathetic drunk so easily thwarted so many of his plans? Will Hank be able to use the villain's obsessions against him to escape from this grim situation? Hank: Straightjacket is a narrative bite-sized game combining traditional point-and-click gameplay with a time manipulation mechanic. Features Hank - a burnt-out vigilante, entrapped by his own time-traveling superpowers. Time Manipulation - rewind time and use the knowledge of the future to escape with your life. Dynamic Dialog System - talk and interact with the world at the same time and see how your interlocutor reacts to your actions. Comic Book Aesthetics - take an early glimpse of Hank's world. Some time ago we were prototyping a dialog system for our main game - Hank: Drowning on Dry Land. The goal was to allow players to conduct conversations without interrupting the core gameplay and enable NPCs to actively respond to the hero's noteworthy actions. During our experiments we created this little experience. It may not be much, but we really liked it so we decided to release it as a free game. Hope you guys enjoy it!
row.short_description: The time-traveling vigilante Hank has been captured by the devious Unraveler. However, before the crime genius gets rid of the hero, he must satisfy his curiosity - How has this pathetic drunk so easily thwarted so many of his plans?

row.name: Steer Madness
row.detailed_description: Steer Madness is a story-driven casual adventure game where the player takes on the role of Bryce, a walking talking cow, who was recently rescued from the slaughterhouse and is now on a mission to save all his fellow animals. It takes place in the fictional city of Fairview, where the player is free to explore, interact with other characters, and join in various missions including undercover investigations and animal rescues. Features Voice acting for all characters Explore a colourful and detailed urban environment Interact with characters and learn the stories behind the animals that need to be rescued Raise money to fund activism missions Obtain and use dozens of different items Your actions will result in animals being saved and businesses becoming vegan! This indie game was made almost entirely by one person :) Have a peek behind the scenes in this YouTube video:
row.short_description: Save animals in this fun and original game! Play as Bryce the Steer in daring missions which help make the world a better place for all its inhabitants!

row.name: Deck of the Dead
row.detailed_description: Deck of the Dead' is a thrilling roguelike deck builder game set in a dark and eerie world of vampires. Players will embark on an epic journey as a powerful vampire seeking to conquer the land and claim ultimate power. The game is set in a randomly generated world filled with dangerous enemies, mysterious secrets, and powerful treasures. Players will use their deckbuilding skills to create the ultimate deck of vampire abilities and weapons, allowing them to defeat their enemies and progress deeper into the world. Customizable Decks: Build your own custom deck of cards by selecting from a range of powerful abilities, equipment, and allies, and tailor it to your preferred playstyle. Unique Enemies: Battle against a variety of enemies that pose different threats, including undead creatures, hunters, and other supernatural beings. Evolving Gameplay: Over time, new cards and abilities become available, making the gameplay richer and more complex as you progress through the game. Beautiful Artwork: Enjoy stunning artwork that captures the dark and brooding atmosphere of the vampire world, from haunting landscapes to terrifying creatures. Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: The game is easy to learn, but hard to master, making it accessible to players of all skill levels, while still providing a satisfying challenge for experienced players.
row.short_description: 'Deck of the Dead' is a thrilling roguelike deckbuilder game set in a dark, mysterious world of vampires. Players will take on the role of a powerful vampire on a quest for ultimate power as they build their deck, defeat enemies, and explore a randomly generated world filled with danger and secrets.

row.name: Dance Loop
row.detailed_description: Music has disappeared from your world. Travel parallel universes and recollect it together piece by piece. In these different realms you will find special data cells called nodes, which you should punch and break following the rhythm. Move your body in the nodes flow and save the music! Try yourself in 10 game levels to the energetic soundtrack from Yandex Music and Ambidextrous, an electronic musician. Break nodes, hold your hands in the dataflow, avoid the obstacles. Dance Loop VR is an experimental game from the developer Fibrum where fantastic VR realm becomes alive with electronic music. The soundtrack is partly written by AI and partly by a music artist Ambidextrous. Will you feel the difference? Game features: · The rhythm VR game with an original cardio dance moves · Vivid realms inspired by science fiction of 20th century · Unusual movement schemes, which combine gameplay with fitness · Charging electronic soundtrack from Yandex Music
row.short_description: Dance loop VR is a rhythm VR game where you travel fantastic realms and break moving data cells to the energetic soundtrack by Yandex Music.

row.name: Street Sense 2
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Street Sense, an interactive game that teaches some of the skills you need to be a safer driver in real life. In this game, you'll get to drive around on virtual roads and learn important things like how to spot dangerous situations on the road, how to turn safely, and how to share the road with others. Street Sense is for new drivers who are just starting out and for experienced drivers who want to get better at driving. You'll experience different driving situations and learn how to deal with them, just like you would in real life. When you're feeling confident, you can take a test to see how much you've learned in the Street Sense Road Test. So, are you ready to become a great driver? Let's play Street Sense and learn how to drive safely! Explore the newest enhancements to Street Sense, featuring the following updates: - Introducing 17 new Hazard Perception Scenarios to test your skills. - Enjoy a sleek New Enhanced UI for smoother navigation. - Multi-Language Support (English, Farsi, Punjabi, & Simplified Chinese). - Closed Captions available in all supported languages. - Unlock scenarios efficiently with the new Tiered Scenario Unlocking System. - Explore the Extended Rural Area in the 'Practice' mode. - Easily identify hazards from a distance with the new Auto Zoom on Hazard hover feature.
row.short_description: Street Sense 2 is for new drivers who are just starting out and for experienced drivers who want to get better at driving. You'll experience different driving situations and learn how to deal with them, just like you would in real life.
