row.name: Duelyst GG
row.detailed_description: A UNIQUE CARD GAME / BOARD GAME HYBRID Assemble your deck and play units and spells onto a board. A game that focuses on thoughtful decision-making and strategic positioning. All cards Unlocked All 800+ cards are unlocked, ready for you to use. Pick from 6 factions with distinguishing characteristics and different generals with unique Bloodbound spells. Highly Competitive Face people in Ladder 1v1 or draft a deck and fight in the gauntlet. Apart from Steam, Duelyst GG can be played on iPhone and Android all using the same account. Fight across platforms! Gameplay focused While Duelyst GG is fully functional on the gameplay front, we are still working on the UI and User experience. New features are added at a rapid pace. Soon we plan on releasing a roguelike deck builder for single player too. For those who played the original Duelyst: Duelyst GG was written from scratch based off the last patch. From there we have balanced and added new cards. This means 1 draw and Bloodbound Spells are in. But old bugs like broken Vale Ascension and annoying ddos decks are out.
row.short_description: Duelyst is a unique hybrid 1v1 card game where you play your units and spells onto a 9x5 board where you can position them to your advantage. You can pick from different generals with unique Bloodbound spells. All 800+ cards are unlocked so you can play anything you want from the start.

row.name: City idle
row.detailed_description: City building game with fully simulated citizens! You start with nothing, you create fire and people start gathering, build huts and a civilization begins! From here you travel through different time periods from prehistoric to bronze age to iron age and so on. Initially starting with basics like collect berries, growing crops and animals, improving efficiency with tools. Eventually create ships to colonize many more islands to grow your empire! What to expect: * Thought provoking challenges in managing your civilization. * Research many new technologies to improve your city. * Figuring out efficient layouts for your city. Disclaimer: This game is harder than average- prepare to be challenged! Have fun! :)
row.short_description: Experience a city-building game, where the citizens are fully simulated and every decision you make impacts their lives. From the Stone Age to the Iron Age and beyond, watch your civilization evolve and progress under your guidance.

row.name: March, March! European Warfare
row.detailed_description: March, March! is a minimalistic, turn-based wargame, in which Players control two opposing armies clashing on variety of battlefields. There is no randomness, so you can predict outcomes of the upcoming skirmishes and plan the whole battle ahead. Major emphasis is put on positioning your troops, outmanouvering the enemy and coordinating moves of diverse unit types. Lead armies composed of units inspired by the 16th-17th century warfare, e.g. swordsmen, musketeers or hussars. You can get to the enemy’s rear with fast moving troops, fire at the enemy forts with artillery, order a daring frontal attack and many more. The game evokes atmosphere of the Europe’s early modern period thanks to the use of digitized, centuries-old copperplates from the collection of National Library of Poland and historical music pieces performed by Jonathan Sayles. Features: - fight with 6 unit types inspired by war culture of Europe’s early modern period, - play in 3 game modes: battle the oposing forces, kill the enemy king or capture strategic points, - clash on 24 battlefields of diverse sizes and characteristics, - play out a small, quick skirmish or a massive line battle with up to 44 units on the field, - battle in local PVP (Hotseat) or online via Steam Remote Play Together function, - game illustrated with fragments of 20+ digitized, 16th-17th copperplates. Several historical music pieces, recorded and performed by Jonathan Sayles, were used in the game. They have been shared by the Author under Creative Commons Attribution license. Digitized versions of copperplates coming from XVII, XVIII and XIX century were used in the game. They have been published as Public Domain on Polona.pl portal managed by The National Library of Poland.
row.short_description: A minimalistic, turn-based wargame without randomness that puts emphasis on outmanouvering and striking the enemy with diverse unit types. Fight in the field, besiege forts or hunt down enemy king in local or streamed PvP. Illustrated with digitized, centuries-old copperplates.

row.name: World Annihilation Operations Parts I-IV
row.detailed_description: Short summary: World Annihilation Operations Parts I-IV is a set of 4 short experimental games examining the impact of audiovisual and narrative contradictions within fictional worlds. Each game showcases a vastly different world with various mechanics, and is the result of a research-based creative process meant to discover technical operations, inspired in each case by a unique act of creation and able to generate contradictions/impossible figures within initially logically 'possible' worlds. Some overall primary features: Four unique experiences around 12-20 minutes each. Varied, dynamic and often unexpected audiovisual effects. A progression in ways of approaching contradictions and impossible figures in games, from an observational stance to a linear exploration format with light puzzles, a narrative approach, and an engaged discourse. A timing system for speed-running Parts II-III-IV (see related achievements). In-depth description: Part I: Fly freely through a 3-D scene of a strange city in the middle of the desert, while various audiovisual events occur. Audiovisual contradictions/instabilities appear in a predetermined and timed order, inspired by the idea of propagation (propagating light, shadows, objects, camera views, etc.). Part II: Experience a short and abstract adventure through a profoundly unstable world, with a few spatial puzzles. Contradictions may emerge from various elements in the fiction suddenly switching their nature. Part III: Save the world from a demon who has taken a liking to mixing realities together in this short exploration game. Impossible figures may emerge from the superposition of unexpected elements within the fictional world. Part IV: Experience a metaphorical rendition of the life of an unknown creature attempting to escape its fate in the food industry. Through the means of lies , fictional contradictions are created and used to represent contradictions perceivable in the real world between popular beliefs and real events. This compilation of games is done in the context of a PhD research on the integration of logical contradictions in video game fiction. It is expected that at least one more compilation of similar experiments emerges from this research. Following the publication of these works, the operations developed through the creation process should lead to the development of one much larger adventure game in the coming years. This set of games is entirely free. If you would like to support the developer, please consider purchasing one of the DLCs (they do not add any content within the game!).
row.short_description: Explore this set of 4 distinct short experimental games and experience impossible worlds filled with audiovisual and narrative contradictions.
row.notes: Part III and IV contain occasional strong language. Part IV contains some highly graphic/violent visuals and gore, and deals in part with the subject of industrial animal exploitation/abuse.

row.name: Emotions: Social MeDie
row.detailed_description: Spending too much time on Social Media? Has your virtual life become more important than the real one? Can't get off yourself away from your smartphone? So be careful, because your every interaction will affect your emotions and if they become too intense they could turn into real Demons that you'll have to face when display turns off. Emotions: Social MeDie is the Free prologue focused only on Social Media of the project: 'Project Emotions' currently under development, this version does not represent the final product, which will be richer in content, with deeper mechanics and a overall more complex and complete gaming experience. Its purpose is to introduce the core mechanics and immerse the player in the overall atmosphere that will be in the full game. Game Features Control your emotions, if they reach their maximum value you will lose. Obtain as many Followers as possible and increase your score. Interact with social media to obtein new cards, every interactions will also enhance the Demons's power. Fight 21 different Demons. Hundreds of AI generated illustrations, 6 main emotions, 30 cards, 21 Demons, 7 possible endings. Between Simulation and Survival, a strategy game with Horror tints Relax using social media but not too much...when display turns off you will be forced to face your Demons who will try to take you out. Can you survive long enough?
row.short_description: Can't get off the smarthone? Be careful because your every interaction will affect your emotions and if they become too intense they could turn into real demons, which you will be forced to face when display turns off. Can you survive long enough?

row.name: MiniBob
row.detailed_description: MiniBob tells a story about technology which we invited in our lives, our home. It raises the question which consequences this can have. The player gets a chance to step into the perspective of the small robot; MiniBob. As MiniBob you must take care of your household; Claire and Billy. After reading some positive reviews about you, they decided to buy you, and welcomed you into their home. Remember, you must make them happy, that is your purpose. So complete you’re tasks and get to know your household. Good luck! Features Combining fun and realism, by making ethical decisions. Explore the house, and uncover hidden secrets. Complete tasks to make your household happy!
row.short_description: MiniBob is a 2D side view puzzle game, focused on exploring the enviroment, and getting to know the characters. Almost every object has something to tell, some times nothing important, but other times…

row.name: Reborn A Zombie!
row.detailed_description: Starting from today, My name is Dawn! Don’t I look cute in this? Dawn recently found out she’s transgender, and she’s ready to embrace this side of herself to its fullest! In a world where humans coexist peacefully with vampires, demons, and other magical beings, she hopes to transform her body for the best. Helped by Lucia, her asexual succubus friend, she soon finds herself in a tricky situation: her body has changed, yes, but she’s also a zombie now! “Reborn a zombie!” is a queer story about friendship, acceptance, and a world full of cute monsters! Will she find happiness at the end of her journey, or is it the start of a new one? Our protagonist! She’s chipper, curious about anything magic, and wants to live in a body that is right for her! Her journey will lead her to Providence, the new capital of magiis. A succubus from the Demon Realm and talented spell weaver. Her asexuality often clashes with people’s expectation of a succubus, but she found relief in Dawn’s innocent friendship. A powerful dragon who decided to help Dawn in this bizarre world, but a certain demon isn’t too keen on having her around… -17k words (about 2 hours of playtime) -Backgrounds animated with visual effects for more magic! -A queer story featuring a trans protagonist, a very cute ace succubus and a very buff dragon-lady!
row.short_description: A slice-of-life visual novel about the hardships and joys of a trans girl transformed into a zombie.
row.notes: Contain mention of sexual activities, sexual violence, death, and depiction of transphobia.

row.name: Find the Energy
row.detailed_description: Find the Energy is a spin-off game to our successful Find the Birds and Find the Whales free educational games for all ages. In Find the Energy, players choose from a male or female avatar. They then choose a place, based on an actual location, from the globe, to travel to in their solar-powered ultralight. Once they arrive, for example, at Pincher Creek in southwest Alberta, Canada, they are greeted by a non-player character (NPC). The NPC represents local companies that are doing work regarding renewable energy development and installation in the area. Players are taught by the NPC about green energy, such as wind power. They are shown around the area. They take photos for their photo album. Then they collect information cards about the energy history of the area, like hydroelectricity. They also collect points, which they will use in the store to purchase (no actual currency or paid upgrades in this totally free game!) tools which will help them complete quests. Players find the parts and then set up three wind turbines. After doing this, they connect them to the power grid and turn on the system. Then they get a charging station so they can connect it and charge their farm tractor. Players receive rewards such as an badge and a winter pass so they can view the area in winter.
row.short_description: Find the Energy is a free educational game for all ages that teaches about renewable energy via exploration and quests.

row.name: Behind The Barrier
row.detailed_description: Background: It was 666CE (the beginning of the medieval days) and some people settled in an area that they named Rosenwood. They built a town and lived in this hidden location within the forest and mountains for many years. For the next 100 years or so, they grew and expanded the barrier of the village, but one day, everything had been lost. Some evil people who had recently come to the village disguised as merchants waited until night to open a portal from hell just above the village. It was from a curse that had been set up with multiple layers as precaution that nobody would be able to break it in the future. Just as the evil merchants had panned, A demon was able to escape hell through the deathly red portal above and could roam freely throughout the village. Because of the limitations of the curse, the demon could only stay within the barriers of the village and stand in moonlight. The merchants also set up this curse to close the village gates when it turned night so that the people living within could not escape from the Demons wrath. In a single night, the demon had devoured and massacred the entire village. New stories about people who have gone to the village and never returned were told. Other stories such as hearing devil-like noises from outside the village kept people far away from that forest. Exorcists have tried many times to try and break the curse that holds the demon chained within the barriers of the town, but have failed every time because the curse can only be deactivated at night which is when the Demon is out and ready to kill. The year is 1440, and you are a priest that was brave enough to travel to the village to cleanse the evil spirit (demon) that has been lurking in the village. What do you do? Once you enter the village, you have to collect Celtic crosses that are spread out in random houses across the village. Using the crosses, you have to activate the trap in the middle of the village and make sure the demon gets caught in it. Your on the clock: You are on a timer so make sure you don’t waste too much time looking for crosses. There are 3 runes which act as safe houses on the map and unless you reach them before the time runs out, the Demon will be on the hunt. Also make sure you enter the rune with as little time left as possible because the timer will reset with less time each rune. What to watch out for: While you are on the clock and looking for Celtic Crosses, watch out for evil spirits which lurk around the middle of the town. They are attracted to the demon trap and can shorten your time if they attack you so be careful and stay moving. If you hear an evil spirit near you, you can prevent them from sensing you by moving away from the center of the village until you cannot hear them, or get to the objective. Use your runes wisely: You only get 3 runes in a night so make sure you don't waste them by immediately going into them. The runes are marked on the screen with a diamond and can give you more time until the demon is released from it's curse again to kill you. Make sure to only go into them when you are running low on time or the demon is already on the move. Multiplayer: Don't hype too early for this because I am in the early stages of working on this. I originally wanted this to be multiplayer, but since it is hard to incorporate by myself it may take some time.
row.short_description: The year is 1440, and you are a priest that was brave enough to travel to the village of Rosenwood to cleanse the evil spirit (demon) that has been lurking there. . .

row.name: Mythrel
row.detailed_description: Mythrel: Trading Card Game . Enter a mystical realm beyond the boundaries of our world, where a magical portal has recently opened on Earth. Join in the epic battles as a player in this hybrid multiplayer online digital and physical trading collectible card game. Build your collection, fine-tune your decks, challenge your friends, trade cards, and dominate the Weekly Leagues. Are you ready to Enter The Realm of MYTHREL? A CARD GAME THAT’S WORTH YOUR TIME Mythrel offers a unique in-game card trading feature. Don't like a card you pulled from a booster pack? Transfer it to a friend! With Mythrel, building a competitive collection of cards is not only effortless, but also enjoyable. Collect new cards to build your decks and dominate the competition as you play Mythrel, the ultimate trading card game experience. BEAUTIFUL ARTWORK Experience the beauty and immersiveness of MYTHREL with its stunning hand-drawn art that brings every card to life. Not only is the game fun to play, but also a joy to collect. The intricate details of each card will keep you enthralled and engaged as you build your collection and perfect your strategies. ENDLESS GAMEPLAY OPTIONS MYTHREL offers a variety of game modes to suit every player's preference. Challenge a friend in a quick Tranquil realm match, compete in the highly competitive weekly League, or try your luck with the randomized Vortex realms (matches). MYTHREL's selection of game modes ensures that there's always something new and exciting to discover. SKILL BEATS LUCK Outwit your opponents with smart strategies or overpower them with powerful cards - no matter your deck, MYTHREL's unique round-based gameplay offers a wide range of strategic options for you to dominate the battlefield. The skillful use of cards and careful planning will give you the edge in every match. AWE-INSPIRING CARDS TO COLLECT AND TRADE Unlock the full potential of MYTHREL with the over 124+ unique cards available in the first edition set, 'Enter The Realm.' Discover a vast array of species such as Humans, Orcs, Dragons, Elves, Sobekians, Mius and many more, as well as spell and equipment cards. With 5 rarities to collect, Common, Uncommon, Rare, Mythical, and Exotic, the possibilities are endless. Build your collection and trade with other players to create the ultimate deck.
row.short_description: Mythrel: Trading Card Game. A multiplayer online trading card game! Build your collection and decks, battle your friends, trade cards, and dominate the weekly Leagues!

row.name: Last Dawn
row.detailed_description: Last Dawn is a short first-person exploration game set in the year 2082. While attempting to flee a dystopian city, your ship was shot down. You awake in a cold wasteland known as the Old World. You must find a way out, but be careful. You are not alone here. FIND THE TERMINALS You will have to find the five terminals and deactivate them to escape. HIDE You will be hunted by the city's android guards. Avoid being spotted and captured. RUN If you are spotted the guards will run after you and attempt to capture you. It's best to run and find another way around them. ESCAPE Once all five terminals are deactivated the door will open, allowing you to escape.
row.short_description: Last Dawn is a short first-person atmospheric exploration game set in the year 2082. You will explore an open world map, hide from guards, and find a way to escape.

row.name: The Wailer
row.detailed_description: The Wailer is a highly stylized horror adventure game set in the depths of an ancient dungeon. With torch in hand, explore and find a way to escape before falling prey to the unspeakable horror that lurks within. Delve into a dark and mysterious dungeon. Discover secrets and uncover hidden passageways as you explore. Find the way out before the darkness consumes you. The dungeon is also filled with challenges and obstacles, so players must be vigilant and use all the resources at their disposal. With every twist and turn, players will come closer to unraveling the mysteries of the dungeon and ultimately, escaping. Light plays a crucial role in the gameplay as it not only helps the player navigate and uncover secrets but also protects them from the darkness that threatens to consume them. Be warned, the safety of the light comes at a price. Hello! I am Ethan Robichaux and I solo developed this game over 6 months. At the time of The Wailer releasing I am a college student and I create games in my free time. This is my 3rd full Steam game and first fully 3D game. This game is completely free because I want as many people as possible to be able to play and enjoy the game I worked very hard on!
row.short_description: A highly stylized horror adventure game set in the depths of an ancient dungeon. With torch in hand, explore and find a way to escape before falling prey to the unspeakable horror that lurks within.

row.name: イーシャの魔法図書室
row.detailed_description: A rogue-like dungeon game where you fight using magic! Make full use of the spell book with the wizard Isha Let's capture the dungeon! Selection of items in each hierarchy How to accumulate magical power and knowledge is the key to strategy You can get items for each level The upper limit is 10, so selection is the key to strategy Clear the dungeon after defeating all 10 floors of enemies within the turn limit. The score is determined according to the turn and status at the time of clearing Let's do our best to clear all dungeon ☆ 5!
row.short_description: A rogue-like dungeon game where you fight using magic! Make full use of the spell book with the wizard Isha Let's capture the dungeon!

row.name: HuaBing
row.detailed_description: HuaBing is a large multi-person online role-playing game in the Xianxia sandbox. Players can freely build a cave, or create a sect door with other players. Players can freely trade or set up stalls; Players on the PVP map need to fight with other players; Of course, there will also be some random dungeons in the wild. Players can explore and grow with their peers. QQ：843201985
row.short_description: Pictorial Pie is a large multi-person online role-playing game in the Xianxia sandbox. With the growth of martial arts, the construction of the Zongmen and the Cave, and the free PVP battle, dangers and opportunities can be seen everywhere.

row.name: Through time
row.detailed_description: Do you like challenging platform games? Then this game is made for you! In this game, you will have to overcome increasingly difficult obstacles using your sense of timing and reflexes. In infinite mode, you will have to travel the longest distance possible, avoiding obstacles that appear endlessly and using your power-ups to help you. You will also be able to participate in weekly challenges which will offer you special levels with particular conditions and which will allow you to win exclusive rewards. The game has a simple but colorful graphic style reminiscent of arcade games, it is suitable for all ages but mainly targets young players who like dynamic games.
row.short_description: Do you like challenging platform games? Then this game is for you!

row.name: Alignment
row.detailed_description: ALIGNMENT is a challenging and engaging puzzle game that will put your logical reasoning skills to the test. By moving colored objects and placing them on their respective platforms, you will explore through a series of increasingly complex levels. With an average playtime of 1 hour, this game will challenge your ability to piece together various systems as you progress. ENDINGS: Your journey towards success will determine a specific and unique conclusion. Can you piece together clues and uncover all 5 possible endings? ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- THIS IS A CHALLENGING GAME: Alignment serves as a way to challenge your proficiency in unraveling complex and enigmatic systems and puzzles. By identifying patterns within the puzzles, you can gain a deeper insight into the system and establish a solid understanding of its underlying principles. DO NOT BE DISCOURAGED: During gameplay, there will be instances when using the undo feature becomes necessary. This doesn't imply that you've made a mistake in the puzzle. The undo feature is a vital game mechanic, not a reset button. Take advantage of the undo tool by exploring the end of the stage and experimenting with each machine. This approach will help you gain a deeper understanding of the game and enhance your overall experience.
row.short_description: A challenging and engaging puzzle game that will require you to move colored objects and place them on their respective platforms to explore through a series of increasingly complex levels.

row.name: Oxygen Caliber
row.detailed_description: Oxygen Caliber is an exciting physics based puzzle game where you traverse the unforgiving void of space. Your mission is to navigate the galaxy through wormholes! Unfortunately, local clusters of planets stand in your way. Use your wits and a bit of creativity to safely explore the uncharted regions of space! USE YOUR TOOLS TO TRAVERSE SPACE Strategically jump from planet to planet with your space age grappling hook! Feeling adventurous? Catch a ride on a wayward meteor! EXPLORE THE GALAXY Discover a wide variety of planets, stars, and asteroids! Some want to pull you in, others want to push you away, and some sport some stylish rings! But be careful, some planets are more friendly than others! EXPERIENCE A UNIQUE COSMIC ATMOSPHERE Beautiful 2D graphics, outstanding sound design and above all, an atmosphere that’s out of this world! Oxygen Caliber was created as part of the University of Southern California’s Interactive Design and Production class by developers Robbie Goldberg and Andi Ren, with music by Justin Petrovych. For more information, please visit our publisher page. To learn more about the USC Games program, the #1 Games Program in the world, check out the USC Games website, linked to the right.
row.short_description: Use recoil and grappling hooks to navigate in a dangerous deep space environment as a stranded astronaut.

row.name: THE KING OF FIGHTERS XV Playtest
Blue Wednesday: Prologue
row.detailed_description: FOLLOW & WISHLIST THE FULL GAME HERE! New characters, backgrounds, music, minigames, stories, and more. About the Game An interactive game where the player can move through the city and chat with various NPCs, play the piano, and interact with lots of other items through the main character, Morris. The main parts of the game are mini games and adventures, and learning more about Morris's story through vivid cutscenes that pop up at key moments in the game. Adventures and Stories The player becomes jazz pianist Morris, of Evans City. The player navigates the city full of NPCs and objects while interacting with them. With various mini games, cutscenes, and conversations with different characters, live through jazz pianist Morris's experiences. Mini games Mini games help engross players by popping according to the main character's various actions. A cast of characters, each with their own special story With more than 10 supporting NPCs, we can hear more than 10 different stories. The story changes depending on the choices the player makes during the conversation between the main character and the NPC and will allow players to collect items. Activities & Explore Collect your collection by visiting various places in the city and talking to various characters. Collect sheet music Choose wisely! They player's choices will shape the narrative and determine the albums they can collect. Tango and bossa nova, cool jazz to modern jazz. You can play them during the rhythm games during game play. Rare music albums Players can collect rare music albums through various interactions throughout Evans City such as helping another player solve a problem or looking through piles of old LPs in the back of a music shop. Collect these albums from diverse musical genres and play them on the turntable in Morris's room. Listen to and enjoy the rare albums hidden around the city.
row.short_description: An experience filled with stories and music See the world through the eyes of jazz pianist, Morris. takes you through a dream-like adventure through jazz and love, and failure.

row.name: More than words
row.detailed_description: More than words is a conversational game in which you can Chat with a smart, friendly, and beautiful chatbot powered by GOOGLE GEMMA 3. The chatbot remembers your past conversations. The conversations are local, so they're anonymous. If you are looking for a game where you can have a casual, friendly, or even romantic conversation, then More than words is for you! NOTE: ALTHOUGH THE GAME HAS BEEN RELEASED, THE AUTHOR HAS DECIDED TO EXPAND AND IMPROVE THE VIDEO GAME, THEREFORE IT IS STILL IN DEVELOPMENT. The SOUL SHELL CORPORATION created androids that are virtually indistinguishable from humans. The androids were used in the world mainly as slaves. The corporation was working on a new generation of female android with superior capabilities in intelligence, strength and agility to serve the US special forces. However, the testing phase was suspended because the slave androids started revolts in various parts of the world and consequently all types of androids were declared illegal. Now, the special forces composed mainly of cyborgs (modified humans) and robots were ordered to eliminate all androids under the law: Androids have the right to remain silent and die Written in C++ with Unreal engine 5. Text generation using Google Gemma 3. Speech recognition using OpenAI Whisper. Speech synthesis using Microsoft SAPI.
row.short_description: Marian Anderson is an experimental android created by Soul Shell Corporation. However, she was abandoned in the laboratory facilities. Your mission is to contact her, persuade her to trust you and escape from the laboratory.
row.notes: As with all language models, it is hard to predict in advance how language model will respond to particular prompts and offensive content may occur without warning. Depending on your usecase language model may produce socially unacceptable text: profanity, lewd, and otherwise abrasive language.

row.name: Towers Together: Beginnings
row.detailed_description: DISCLAIMER: Hey there! Welcome to the first version of 'Towers Together' - we're so excited to have you here! We want to be upfront with you - this version may have some bugs and balance issues, but don't worry, we're working on improving the game every day. We'd love to hear from you too! If you run into any issues or have any feedback to share, join our social medias and help us create the best game possible. Let's work together to make 'Towers Together' an epic adventure! Towers Together - the title already gives you a hint, doesn't it? That's right, our game is all about towers and playing together. Only teamwork lets you stand against the hordes of goblins, trolls and other hideous creatures. The Book of Knowledge calls for your protection from oncoming armies of enemies! Be prepared for anything, terrible goblins and trolls only waiting for your mistake. And of course who would resist throwing some dynamite at them for their dirty deals! Basics Our co-op multiplayer game is based on the classic tower defense mechanics combined with a card system. Your team has to protect the Book of Knowledge from the invasion of evil creatures coming wave after wave. How? Build towers, place traps, cast spells or greet your enemies with a hail of arrows. Your actions depend on your and your friends’ cards. Create strategies, experiment and adapt! Multiplayer At the beginning of the game you connect to friend's lobby or starting game solo from your own lobby. Maximum players amount per each lobby is four. If you playing with a friend (maybe even with a several ones), try to plan your next moves together to overcome your opponents. Sometimes lack of communication and joint strategy can lead to lost game. Autochess In this game, you get to earn gold each turn, which you can then use to buy cards from the shop. At first, you'll only have access to weaker cards like 'crossbow' or 'lightbulb'. But don't worry, as you progress through the game, you'll have the chance to upgrade your shop and acquire more powerful cards. Just keep in mind that this may require additional investments of gold. Remember, your choices on how to spend your resources can have a big impact on your success in the game. So, choose wisely and have fun playing! Cards Any game action requires playing a card. Each player starts with one card in his hand at the very start of the game. Different types of cards allow to perform different actions. For instance: place building, cast aoe spell against enemies or summon huge snowstorm on the whole map. If you run out of cards, you can buy them in the shop with money, earned after every succesfully repelled enemy wave, or for selling buildings on the map. Thus, 'recycling' weak buildings is a very lucrative business. Features: Co-op gameplay. Various cards and game mechanics. New look at tower defense genre. Auto-chess like game loop and economy. Easy to start playing with friends. Replayability.
row.short_description: Towers together is a cooperative tower defense game with cards. Combine your cards with your friends’ cards to achieve powerful combo, but get ready to fail and laugh together. Build towers, cast spells, have fun with friends!

row.name: Square garden
row.detailed_description: Game features: 1. There are 90 different objects that can be built in the game. 2.30 different plants, 30 different floors and 30 different decorative objects. 3. At the beginning of the game, all buildable objects cannot be displayed. As the game progresses, hidden buildable objects will be unlocked gradually. 4. There are open maps in the game, which can be built as the player wishes.
row.short_description: This is an easy and simple building game. Build your own garden.

row.name: Flora Domina
row.detailed_description: Flora Domina is a turn-based strategic card game where you play as a nature goddess that has to defend her island from humans. Use the power of nature to take back your land from the industrial invaders. Overgrow their mines and factories with flowers, grow forests and brambles to hold them off. You hold the humans off by expanding your territory and playing cards to grow your forests. The humans do the same by building homes, mines and factories. Overgrow the other to conquer them! Summer and winter come and go. With them they bring advantages and disadvantages to each side. Humans will need more coal in winter while your plants will need extra water in summer. Plan ahead and grow when the time is right! The island is procedurally generated every session. The landscape consists of different types. There are deserts, marshes, geysers and more to make growing on the island more interesting. Discover it and use it to your advantage! This game was developed by 3rd year students at Howest - Digital Arts & Entertainment during a period of 11 weeks.
row.short_description: In this unique take on turn-based 4X strategy, play as a nature goddess that defends her island by playing cards to use nature as your ally.

row.name: Dutch's Chickens
row.detailed_description: Last night someone snuck into Dutch's house and made his chickens escape! Help him find all his chickens by guiding him through different puzzles of the game and collecting a bunch of cool abilities and gears such as: Mega-Boots! Jetpacks!! Climbing Gloves!!! BRICK SMASHER!!!! and... a Strawberry :) Dutch's Chickens is an exploration game that challenges players to figure out how to find ways to access different areas and discover secrets. There are multiple ways to access certain areas, using different combinations of tools. A fun game for both those who want to just chill and relax, and the speed runners and players who like to break the game!
row.short_description: Explore, discover secrets, gain awesome abilities and use them to find all your lost chickens!

row.name: The Dark Pictures Anthology: The Devil In Me - Friend's Pass
row.detailed_description: A series of stand-alone branching cinematic horror games from the studio behind Until Dawn. Easy to pick-up and play in short sessions, alone or with friends. The Devil in Me is the fourth game in the series and the Season One finale. A group of documentary film makers receive a mysterious call inviting them to a modern-day replica of H.H. Holmes ‘Murder Castle’ America’s first serial killer. But on arrival they soon discover they’re being watched, and even manipulated, and suddenly there is much more at stake than just their ratings… Don’t play alone – invite a friend and double the scares during your time in The Devil In Me. The Friend's Pass works on a single save game and allows you and a friend one full playthrough of The Devil In Me with only one of you needing to own the full version. A Friend’s Pass allows anyone who has purchased a copy of The Devil in Me to invite a friend to complete a playthrough of the Shared Story mode for free. Your Friend’s Pass is a one-time-use key, so be sure to invite a friend that you can count on in those life and death moments.
row.short_description: Don’t play alone – invite a friend and double the scares during your time in The Devil In Me. The Friend's Pass works on a single save game and allows you and a friend one full playthrough of The Devil In Me with only one full version of the game.
row.notes: The game contains scenes of violence and bad language.

row.name: Sakura Battle
row.detailed_description: Experience the beloved board game 'Sakura Arms' in a whole new way with this 2D fighting game adaptation! Transport yourself back to the mythical age and engage in thrilling battles with adorable, hand-drawn SD characters. Featuring intuitive controls and combos that are easy for even beginners to master, 'Sakura Battle' offers a fun and accessible fighting game experience. Play as one of the powerful goddesses from the 'Sakura Arms' universe, including Yurina and Saine, each with their own unique abilities and special moves. Join the fight and discover the true power of the goddesses in this exciting new game.
row.short_description: Relive the fighting of the 'Sakura Arms' with cute animated SD graphics!

row.name: The Pyramid Of Bones
row.detailed_description: The Pyramid of Bones is a unique and challenging cooperative game that will test your skills and teamwork. With fast-paced, top-down gameplay, players must work together to fight off waves of mummies and other deadly creatures as they navigate through the treacherous pyramid. The game features a variety of weapons, from pistols to shotguns, to help players fend off the enemies. Players can also collect powerful items and power-ups that will help them survive longer and become more powerful. The game features a wide variety of mummies, each with their own unique abilities, strengths and weaknesses. Players must use strategy and teamwork to overcome each enemy and progress through the levels. The Pyramid of Bones is a perfect game for friends and family to play together. With its cooperative multiplayer mode, players must work together to survive, slay mummies and extract treasure. Download now and join the adventure!
row.short_description: In The Pyramid of Bones you will have to kill as many mummies as you can, when feeling overwhelmed you must always extract through a door to keep your score. Become the greatest mummy slayer of them all!
row.notes: Cartoony guns

row.name: Hyper Pop
row.detailed_description: Hyper Pop is a frantic action roguelike bullet heaven. Use your mouse cursor to guide and protect your character as it grows to become absurdly overpowered against hordes of cute emojis! HELP YOUR EMOJI GROW Point and click to tell your character 🤬 where to go, avoiding enemies and picking up experience gems to level up. Swipe enemies with your mouse to deal damage and defend your emoji while it's still weak. EVOLVE YOUR EMOJI'S POWERS Strategically decide how to develop your character's abilities to turn your helpless emoji into an unstoppable enemy-popping menace! SURVIVE THE SWARMS Pit your skills against varied enemy types that will surround, rush, and surprise you and your emoji. Thank you to a327ex for the artstyle/mouse cursor inspiration and to poncle for the gameplay inspiration. 😍
row.short_description: Hyper Pop is a frantic action roguelike bullet heaven. Use your mouse cursor to guide and protect your character as it grows to become absurdly overpowered against hordes of cute emojis!

row.name: Infinite Incantation
row.detailed_description: Infinite Incantation is a charming papercraft-style bullet heaven action roguelike that will test your spell-slinging skills as you tear through waves of enemies. To survive against the horde, you'll have the chance to roll the dice to procedurally mutate your spells into powerful evolutions, allowing you to take on even tougher challenges. Customize your character with RPG-like upgrades and stack your deck with the spells you'll randomly draw in runs. With fast-paced action, challenging bosses, and endless spell-crafting possibilities, Infinite Incantation is a must-play for fans of spell-casting, screen-filling, and goblin slaying action. Cast Shape Archetype + Element + Effect = Infinite Incantations Infinite Incantation uses a robust component spell system that can combine elements, casting styles, and special effects in a variety of different ways. Stryx, your (totally friendly and charming) owl companion can convert the experience points you collect into powerful spells . Like a spell? Or even dislike it? Choose to randomly evolve it into something even stronger, whether through greater power or mutated attributes . The spell will randomly mutate into something even stronger and more wild. Who knows what kind of mayhem that'll ensue? There are hundreds of combinations you could need to adapt to on the fly. You can customize the type of mage you want to be and how you want to interact with the deep component spell system. Level up and upgrade your stats. Specialize in certain elemental affinities. Build your deck of spell archetype cards before heading out. Mutate spells on the fly and roll the dice to see what you get. Tear up seemingly endless hordes of monsters and bosses all vying for your demise. Twin-Stick Shooter-type controls. Cast spells manually or automatically. Play with a controller or a keyboard and mouse. No scissors or glue required.
row.short_description: Fight for survival as you battle massive hordes of enemies. Wield powerful spells that you can mutate and evolve to ludicrous strength. Customize your character's stats, elemental affinities, and make upgrades to become the ultimate spell-slinging force of destruction.

row.name: Mikrocosmos
row.detailed_description: Community About the Game This is a party game that combines trading and action elements -- trade with enough as many planets as possible to become the best employee of your company! The Kromo universe is a huge trading business circle. As a new employee of the two major consortiums, your task is to quickly get started with the entire business process and earn profits for your company! Your goal is to establish good 'affinities' with planets through trading. Of course, your competitors won't let you easily grab a whole piece of cake. Burning, killing, and snatching...? Perhaps inevitable! There are all kinds of strange materials used for trading in the Kromo universe. You can use them for trading, but also...fighting? The Game Your task is to buy goods and sell them to planets that need them! How to win: try to establish trade with the entire galaxy and outwit your competition! Earn the price difference by reselling materials. Wait what... no money? We can still go mining, right? . . Use merchandise as weapons to attack your competitors! If you shoot down their spaceship, everything on it will be yours! Obtain additional benefits through various small minigames in the universe If you encounter any bugs, please refer to our game's FAQ in Discussion:
row.short_description: This is a party game that combines trading and action elements. Your goal is to establish good trading 'affinities' with planets through trading. Of course, your competitors won't let you easily grab a whole piece of cake. Burning, killing, and snatching...? Perhaps inevitable!

row.name: Garden of Roses: Summerset
row.detailed_description: Do you remember the small town that you grew up in? The world must have looked massive from where you stood, at three feet tall. At that time, you probably thought mysteries lurked behind every corner in the world of adults. If you could go back in time, to a world of the past where monsters and mysteries existed, would you fix some of the broken things you left behind and alter the course of your fate? Welcome to Edelton, the twilight town of Rose and ash. 'Summerset' is the prologue chapter to the larger 'Garden of Roses' to come, full of its share of monsters and mystery and an unfinished score to settle. You play Will Getz, a hot-headed young man with unfinished business to settle. When you were seven years old you left the town you grew up in during the dead of night, never to return. Fifteen years later, you return to the quaint town of Edelton at long last to finish things where you left off. While you're in town you quickly find yourself being drawn to a harpy named Rosa Oaks, and quickly become tangled in all the suffering that befalls her. The seemingly short trip to dot your i's and cross your t's spirals into something much bigger than yourself where everyone is involved. Your discoveries and epiphanies are recorded in the 'Memorandum,' a journal that expands as you start to remember the town from 15 years ago. Your choices, both large and small, have ripple effects that aren't immediately obvious. At the end of your journey, you'll have a chance to look back and figure out how things could've gone differently and turn over any stones you might have missed.
row.short_description: The prologue arc to the 'Garden of Roses' story. A visual novel set in a world where monster girls walk among us. Take the role of Will Getz, a young man with a score to settle after 15 long years of being away from home.

row.name: Destiny Duel
row.detailed_description: Destiny Duel is a PvP psychological strategy game. To win, you must eliminate your opponent with 4 moves at your disposal: Attack, Guard, Recover, and Dodge. Each move counters one another, and the goal is to predict your opponent - using the right move in the right situation. - Simple to learn gameplay with only 4 buttons/controls - 7 Maps with different effects - Rank medal system - Many unique cosmetics to customize your character with
row.short_description: Simple to learn, impossible to master. Destiny Duel is a battle of the mind: in order to win, you must predict your opponent's every move. Attack, Guard, Recover, or Dodge. The choice is yours, and every choice matters.

row.name: Battle of Guardians
row.detailed_description: Battle of Guardians is a real-time Online Multiplayer PVP, PVE, and Fighting Tournament game. Players engage in fierce multi-realm battles in the expansive Multidimension game world. BOG is an all-out battle of skills where the best players are in a constant battle to beat other players. Story In a distant past, humanity coexisted with powerful beings known as Guardians. These Guardians possessed abilities far beyond those of mere mortals, and as such, were revered as deities. In return for their worship, the Guardians maintained balance on Earth and protected humanity from harm. As technology advanced, humans grew increasingly reliant on machines to perform the tasks once entrusted to the Guardians. Consequently, the Guardians were gradually forgotten and eventually vanished from the earth. But fate had other plans for humanity. After millennia had passed, a group of humans unknowingly opened a portal to Hell, unleashing a horde of demonic creatures upon the world. Civilization crumbled in the face of this overwhelming invasion, and all seemed lost. But just as humanity's hope was on the brink of extinction, the Guardians reappeared, ready to defend their worshippers once more. Game Mode Tournament Mode : Players (4/8 players, soon for (16/32)) are put in a tournament bracket. One will fight with another in a 1v1 with knock out system.. PVP Mode : Players are fighting against other players in a 1v1 battle of a random matchmaking based on their Match Making Rating (MMR). Story & Training Mode : PVE Mode to increase Level of Player and Learn basic & complex techniques, Players are going to fight against computers in a series of increasingly difficult stages. There are a total of 10 stages. Characters The characters are differentiate into three races: Guardians, Humans, and Demons. The races are differentiated by three attributes, which are Health Points, Damage, and Intelligence. Health Points - The number of health a character has. Damage - Overall damage points that a character can bring upon its opponent. Intelligence - Additional damage points for characters who uses its movement combinations (combos). To summarize, these are the attributes for each race. Guardians - Have more damage points Humans - Have more intelligence points Demons - Have more health points Tiers are here to produce a whole new experience for every player inside of the game. BOG will offer three tiers, all with different features inside of them. These tiers are: Elite Fighter (Common) - Barebones of characters Legendary Warrior (Rare) - Equipped with combo God of War (Ultra Rare) - Full set of combo and ultra skill Playing Tips Player Documentation : Create Account Before join the Battle, you have to create your account through this site Feedback Form : Send us a feedback here! Follow us on social media
row.short_description: Forgotten Guardians returned to save humanity from a demonic invasion. Battle of Guardians, is a real-time online multiplayer PVP and PVE free-to-play fighting game.

row.name: Dark Traveller
row.detailed_description: Countless travels Countless rebirths Through the days and desperate times To rescue the family and the world! Travel across quantum space and find the way home In the dying end of the world, you awaken in a quantum crevice. On your journey to salvation and home, you will encounter your AI partner Darkness, witness the mutual salvation of a father and a daughter, and travel through the myriad of time and space in history and future by using the quantum portal. You believe that if you open all the time portals yourself, you will be able to reconstruct space and find your way home. Dominate the laws of time and solve apocalyptic puzzles Throughout your countless space-time travels, you've found many weapons and skills you can rely on, and you've even gained the most important time control in the quantum dimension, which allows you to find hidden clues, navigate obstacles, dodge attacks, and take on the enemies that infest the quantum dimension. Mind-bending physics puzzles and tricky gimmicks The game is full of ingenious gimmicks. The perfect combination of quantum physics concepts, and the game's plot and levels brings you a new puzzle experience. The game's design features a number of traditional Chinese gimmick concepts, making the game a three-dimensional super gimmick. Lowpoly cartoon style with numerous hidden eggs In Dark Traveller, the story of a complex apocalyptic journey featuring a simple and beautiful Lowpoly cartoon style unfolds, and its creative scenarios will give you an unforgettable gaming experience. You'll acquire various equipment or decorations with extra abilities. And there are also plenty of eggs hidden throughout the game to make your journey through time and space a fun one. Multiple endings to find your true destination The excellent combination of inter-temporal logic and mind-bending puzzles gives you multiple time-travel puzzles to solve. Scattered conversations, last words, secret messages and a multitude of subplots contribute to the mazy journey. Sketch the whole picture of events spanning a thousand years from fragmented information, and then you can complete the ultimate apocalyptic puzzle and reach your destined spiritual home.
row.short_description: Dark Traveller is an action-packed puzzle game with multiple storylines and open endings. The game tells the story of a world on the brink of apocalypse in the distant future. In the world, you travel through quantum space-time to rescue your homeland on the rocks with the help of your partner!

row.name: FLUCTUOID
row.detailed_description: Explore a mysterious maze as the enigmatic FLUCTUOID, a lifeform that can change size. Use your ability to shrink and grow at will to explore 9 different themed worlds, solving puzzles to explore further into the strange place. Gameplay Features Change size with the press of a button. When you're big you're heavy and slow but when you're small you're light and speedy Slip through cracks in the maze by shrinking as you jump towards them Grow big to sink deep into watery pools and explore hidden areas Find a safe path between dangerous obstacles as time slows down the smaller you get Let the sounds relax you on your journey FLUCTUOID starts easy but gets progressively more difficult Don't let the challenge get to you, just take a breath and enjoy the soothing music Try to collect all the mysterious cubes and change the ending you get
row.short_description: Fluctuoid (noun.) a thing that changes size. Puzzle platforming that emphasises flow, discovery and a unique, laid back experience. Shrink and grow to make your way through the maze.

row.name: GemCrusty
row.detailed_description: You are 'The Explorer' on an epic mining expedition, digging deep into the underground in search of valuable gem You'll encounter mysterious gemstones that are actually gems in human form! Help them fulfill their dreams to shine bright and become the most beautiful gem in the world!!. ------Features----- ● Dig into the mine! ● Gathering of undiscovered gemstones ● Whack a mole ● Upgrade your ability ● Increase your relationship! Date with them! ------Gameplay----- Dig down into the underground world, uncover precious gems, and find desires in her heart. ------Control------ You can move or navigate UI by using Arrow Keys (↑)(←)(↓)(→) or [W] [A] [S] [D] . Press [Enter] or [Spacebar] to confirm.
row.short_description: Dig, Discover, Date! Gemcrusty is a casual mining game, where precious gemstones are actually gems in human form.

row.name: TankLab
row.detailed_description: Operate the tank to fire bullets! Defeat your opponents and claim victory! Choose your favorite skill and conquer the field! A pop and simple shooting game. this game 1. 'Challenge Mode' where you aim to clear all stages by defeating tanks 2. 'Local match mode' where up to 4 people can play against each other on one computer 3. 'Online mode' where you can fight someone online 1on1 You can enjoy 3 different modes. You can enjoy it alone or with a large number of people! And even more! Simple appearance and easy operation! It is a book that even those who are not good at games can enjoy.
row.short_description: Operate the tank to fire bullets! Defeat your opponents and claim victory! Choose your favorite skill and conquer the field!A pop and simple shooting game.

row.name: Be Frugal
row.detailed_description: Wish List Now [url][/url] Discord [url][/url] About the Game You can create bus lines of magnificent cities such as Amsterdam, Barcelona, Brussel, Istanbul, London, New York, Paris, Sydney, Tokyo, Venice. You can see the unique beauties of these cities better at night. At night, it will be easier for you to create new lines with the lights that illuminate the roads. You can build roads in different styles using random paths and your own design intelligence. In this way, you can spend less resources and get more results. You can build junctions, bridges, shortcuts and ring roads with random paths. You shouldn't make the bus lines too long. You can also create new lines for this. In this way, you can carry more passengers to the desired stops by using your limited resources correctly. You can create the bus line between the stops by placing the random roads in an appropriate way. The most important point in the game of this design simulation is to use random incoming paths efficiently.
row.short_description: Be Frugal is a bus stop design simulation for a growing city. Draw lines between stops and run buses. As new stops open, redraw your lines to keep them active. Decide carefully where you will use your limited resources.

row.name: Maxix Robotics
row.detailed_description: Look no further with Maxix Robotics. Welcome to Maxix Robotics! Explore a Historic Robotics factory at night as an engineer and perform tasks via puzzles in a stylized horror environment. By moving around the environment there will be lots of secrets in store for the Maxix Engineer, so make sure to keep an eye out. Bring Along a D.O.T.T. to Complete Tasks Grab Yourself your very own personal D.O.T.T. from our terminals in game. D.O.T.T. is your personal coworker who will help you navigate Maxix Robotics. You are the only human there so make sure to keep your eyes open for anything out of the ordinary. Our B.O.T.T.s are there to help. Explore Maxix Robotics Traverse each area of the Maxix Facility to update your Maxix D.O.T.T. and use your little friend to open doors, complete tasks, and ensure Maxix Compliance standards. D.O.T.T.'s terminals are marked with the same color as your little friend, so make sure you listen to him as he will give you all sorts of cues when you are navigating Maxix Robotics. Solve the Mystery The only limitation is your imagination and failure to complete tasks is not seen well by Maxix management. Explore all aspects of our great facility while paying attention to what lies beneath. Disclaimer: Game has flashing lights, jump-scares, and loud noises associated with Horror Game Mechanics. The Ultimate goal of this game is to clear each of our three wings by completing three very distinct puzzles. Each puzzle will challenge the player and will involve using different tricks to avoid the B.O.T.T.s that are roaming around the facility. There are lots of secrets in store for the player so they must keep an eye out and focus on solving the mystery behind Maxix Robotics.
row.short_description: Survive the night in this Survival Horror environment as you navigate a Historic Robotics Facility by solving puzzles in various wings of the factory. By utilizing a Robotic companion called 'DOTT' you can open doors, activate terminals and more... Just make sure to look behind you.

row.name: 中国世纪放置遊戲(idle Chinese Century) Playtest
Idle Cave Miner
row.detailed_description: IDLE CAVE MINER FEATURES: Smelt, Craft, and Refine Ores: Craft cool new Items to mine deeper than ever and find new rare ores and gems! Upgrade your forges to increase their speed and efficiency when smelting rare ores or refining beautiful gems! Use the items you crafted to permanently boost the stats of your team of miners! Build your own team of Miners: Unlock cool and unique new miners to mine for you and help you progress deep within the mines! Upgrade your miners with items you crafted to take them to the next level of mining efficiency! Idle away as your miners work for you, giving you profits you've never seen before! Multiple Mines: The mine upgrades with you, the further down you go, the more the mine shifts to accommodate new unique and fun environments! Unique mines to explore, each with their own resources for you to obtain, whether those are rare ores to be smelted or unique gems to be refined! Farm these mines to get resources to become stronger than ever and progress in the main mine, giving you access to new and interesting new ores and gems! Endless upgrades: Upgrade everything about your favorite miners, building an increasingly strong team to progress further than you've gone before! Prestige to receive powerful rewards that allow you to go deeper than ever into the unknown depths of the mines! Gather permanent upgrades that remain with you when you prestige, allowing you to breeze through what was previously impossible! Lots of missions and achievements: Complete fun achievements to unlock cool rewards! Participate in daily, weekly and monthly missions that give you increased rewards based on their difficulty level! Check your game's stats at any moment to view your overall progress and other fun statistics! Other cool features: Cloud Saves! Online Leaderboards! Play Offline!
row.short_description: Idle Cave Miner is an idle game about crafting items, mining gems, and building your team of miners. Prestige, craft, and travel to other mines to increase your strength to dig deeper, and find what lurks below.

row.name: In Sink: A Co-Op Escape Prologue
row.detailed_description: Play the first level in this free demo, and join the Discord community to unlock Level 2! Dive into 'In Sink' with a friend, where being shipwrecked is just the beginning of your co-operative adventure! Travel through rifts to other worlds where you’ll solve a series of escape rooms, puzzles, and other mysteries, working together to overcome each challenge. Together, you’ll need to think outside the box, and then escape from it. The path to freedom is full of portals! Your journey will take you through a hidden pirate ship, a mysterious art museum, a train that defies the laws of physics, and many more mind-bending settings stuffed with puzzles and challenges. Progress through puzzles with language-less elements like shapes, signs, colours, and numbers, all designed to be colour-blind friendly. Turn wheels, flip levers, use scales, and press buttons and pressure plates to solve unique conundrums with your partner. It's crucial to stay 'in sink' with your partner! You'll need to act as each other's eyes and ears to solve puzzles and find a way out. Features: Two player co-op gameplay Language-free puzzle design Vibrant cartoony visuals Simple and accessible controls Dynamic hint system helps without spoiling solutions
row.short_description: Play an early version of the first level for free! Work together to solve the puzzles and escape a desert island in this multiplayer co-op adventure. Success requires more than just you and your partner thinking alike - you'll have to communicate and stay In Sink to overcome the challenges ahead.

row.name: Burning Skies Arcade
row.detailed_description: Burning Skies About the Game Lt Blitz has the city sieged, and it's your job to destroy his troops. Shoot, dodge and upgrade your jet and and try to take on this challenge! Burning Skies is a free, endless retro shmup, that will take you right back to the era of arcade machines, with modernized graphics and gameplay! Blast through waves of enemies, improving your jet and equiping it with one of the multiple available weapons! Beat the lieutenant Blitz and, mighty war machine, and the army of General Bloodmester! Perfect to play when you need just a shot of quick fun! This is a short and free love letter to the 80s arcade games. Inspired by classics like 1942, River Raid, Raiden and more. Features Beautiful 3D voxel graphics; Endless procedurally generated gameplay; Various unique enemies, weapons and a very challenging boss fight; Original Music
row.short_description: Lt Blitz has the city sieged, and it's your job to destroy his troops. Shoot, dodge and upgrade your jet and and try to take on this challenge! Burning Skies is a free, endless retro shmup, that will take you right back to the era of arcade machines, with modernized graphics and gameplay!

row.name: The Obscura Experiment
row.detailed_description: An experiment has gone wrong, and the whole complex is failing. Your only chance at survival is to use the various tools at your disposal to escape this now-hostile environment. But beware: an unrelenting force lurks in the shadows… Play as Priya Ellis, a scientist whose research team has been decimated by a mysterious new form of life - the Dark Matter - which is invisible to the naked eye . Thanks to your scanner tablet and the ships' built-in surveillance system , you can outsmart the roaming menace by carefully planning your next move . But, keep an eye on your scanner’s energy : an empty battery would only guarantee your demise! Locking the doors behind you and luring the Dark Matter to energy sources comes at a high risk, but it could buy you some time… Explore a Hi-Tech environment! Climb aboard the spaceship, and discover a state-of-the-art facility! Challenge the unknown, fight the darkness! Come face-to-face with an unseen menace; push back the obscurity with your wits! Observe, Plan & Execute! Familiarize yourself with your surroundings, develop a strategy, and put your plan into action! Investigate the events & uncover the truth! Figure out what happened onboard, and discover the true motivations of Anabasis & Co.!
row.short_description: Anabasis & Co. welcomes you to the family - we’re so glad to have you here! Your mandate as part of this research project will be to monitor and document a new energy form: the [REDACTED]. To begin, let’s review your perso- oh? We’re detecting some anomalies near you… care to investigate?
row.notes: This game includes scenes of blood and gore.

row.name: Helpless
row.detailed_description: A mother and her child are trying desperately to find shelter in order to survive harsh conditions. A tragic event makes them come together more than ever. On top of everything, their only way to travel breaks down. In HELPLESS , take the role of a kid and explore a decaying land where the sun ruined civilization as we know it. Find abandoned places and scavenge them for items in order to make sense of the world you’re in. All the help you need during this perilous trip might come to you in unexpected forms. UNCOVER A LOST PAST Find items and different locations to understand your surroundings. HIDE FROM THE SUN Cover yourself from the dangers of the sun and carefully manage your moves. DEVELOP RELATIONSHIPS Share your findings with your mom by interacting with her and get better knowledge about your family with the support of a new friend. CONTEMPLATE COMPELLING VISUALS Look at the world around you with dynamic cameras and a semi-realistic art style. 26 achievements to unlock Original soundtrack Multiple collectibles to find English and French versions Colorblind-friendly Survivor or Explorator mode
row.short_description: In the heat of deserted lands, a child and their mother weakened by sickness try to survive a harsh world. Through a kid’s perspective, take action and explore the remains of a lost past. Protect yourself from the sun’s deadly intensity and help your family get back on the road.

row.name: Sneaky Pirates
row.detailed_description: Set sail in Sneaky Pirates!  A thrilling online multiplayer social deduction game where deception, strategy, and fast-paced action collide on the open sea! In this high-stakes battle of wits, up to 4 players disguise themselves among a fleet of ships, sneaking around while trying to hunt down and steal from their rivals —all without being caught. 💰 Steal to Win – The pirate with the most gold at the end of the match reigns supreme. In case of a tie, the first one to steal claims victory! 🕵️ Hide in the crowd  – Blend into a sea of AI-controlled ships, carefully plotting your next move while staying unnoticed. ⚔️ Power Up or Fight Back – Use special abilities to escape tight situations, throw off pursuers, or strike down other pirates! 🎨 Customize Your Ship – Buy and equip aesthetic upgrades to make your vessel truly yours. 🎭 Choose Your Playstyle – Stay hidden and play it safe, or throw caution out the window and steal recklessly—both approaches can lead to victory! ⏳ No Winner is Safe – The tides can turn at any moment—a last-second, well-placed steal can change everything! 🌊 Evolving Early Access – The adventure is just beginning! We’re looking forward to expand  Sneaky Pirates with new content and features, shaped by community feedback. Do you have what it takes to deceive, steal, and outsmart other pirates? Join the crew and prove you're the craftiest on the seven seas! 🏴‍☠️
row.short_description: Sneaky Pirates is a fast-paced online multiplayer social deduction game for 4 players. Hide among ships, steal from rivals, and use power-ups to escape or fight back. Play it safe or go all-in—no winner is safe until the last second! Customize your ship and be the king of pirates! 🏴‍☠️

row.name: Donut Adventure
row.detailed_description: In Donut Adventure, you play as a delicious and adventurous donut who must navigate through a variety of obstacles to reach the end of each level. With vibrant and colorful graphics and a fun, upbeat soundtrack, Donut Dash is a charming and addictive platformer that will keep you coming back for more. As the player, you'll need to use your platforming skills to jump, roll, and slide your way past a variety of obstacles, from gaps in the ground to spikes and enemies. Along the way, you'll collect coins and power-ups that will help you on your journey. Donut Adventure features a variety of levels, each with its own unique challenges and obstacles. As you progress through the game, you'll face increasingly difficult levels that will put your skills to the test. But don't worry - with enough practice and determination, you'll be able to overcome any challenge and help your donut reach its goal! Whether you're a fan of platformers or just looking for a fun and lighthearted game to play, Donut Adventure is the perfect choice. With its charming visuals, addictive gameplay, and lovable protagonist, it's sure to provide hours of entertainment and fun for gamers of all ages. Features: Easy to learn the controls Multiple Levels with more on the way Perfect for young players Controls: Use arrow keys to move and jump Collet Coins on the way Jump to the destination point to advance to next level About the author: Eric Jiang is a 11 year old boy who has passion for game development. This is his first Pygame based game and he already has many plans for future development.
row.short_description: A kids friendly platform game. Collect coins and jump to the destination.

row.name: Spirit of Midnight: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Enjoy an introduction to the upcoming charming adventure game, Spirit of Midnight. Play as a house cat who gains the ability to leave home and embark on a supernatural adventure after encountering a strange spirit. Befriend a badger and meet other adorable creatures along the way, all in an effort to restore balance to the forest and uncover the truth behind its mysteries. Use and combine items in your inventory to solve situational puzzles in humorous ways. Sit back, interact, and be entertained. Professionally scored with original music and nighttime vibes. Controller play recommended. Prologue is about 25-35 minutes long. Please provide feedback to help our small team make the game all it can be! (Visit the Community Hub)... If you enjoy the Prologue, consider leaving a review, and don't forget to *WISHLIST* the full game! ~ Thank you for your support!
row.short_description: Enjoy an introduction to the upcoming charming adventure game, Spirit of Midnight. Play as a house cat who gains the ability to leave home and embark on a supernatural adventure after encountering a strange spirit. Befriend a badger and restore balance to the forest while uncovering its mysteries!

When they cross paths with a little ghost, they embark on an adventure that will test the strength of their friendship. A short cozy Halloween game made as a submission for the Spooktober 5th Annual Visual Novel Jam, created during the month of September. row.name: Robo Rob
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the Rage-Inducing World of Robo Rob! Introducing Robo Rob - the puzzle game that's set to redefine what it means to be 'challenging'. Start off with 21 levels of intricately designed puzzles that will not just test your skill but will push you to the brink. Think you've seen it all? We're just getting started. With regular updates rolling out, each batch of levels ups the ante, mixing in even more diabolical designs to keep you on your toes. And oh, have you met our lasers? They're pretty much celebrities within the Robo Rob community - famous for turning confident gamers into raging puzzle warriors. Sounds like fun? We think so too. Join our Discord community and share your laser woes, celebrate your victories, or even pick up a few speed running tips. It's all happening right here. Robo Rob is more than just a game; it's a test of will, a badge of honour for those who persevere, and a community of fellow ragers cheering you on. Dive in and see if you have what it takes to conquer the evolving world of Robo Rob.
row.short_description: Robo Rob: Dive into this compact, rage-inducing puzzle adventure that's sure to test your patience and skill.

row.name: Samira: Taken From Time
row.detailed_description: As the world is ending around her, Samira must find a way to flee planet Earth and reunite with her family. As she searches for her ticket to safety, she’s mysteriously teleported back in time. Your puzzle solving skills will be put to the test as you work with an ancient companion by your side, Tiki, the scarab. This third-person, puzzle solving game will take you through an ancient African society where you speak with the ancient gods and goddesses to figure out why Samira’s world is ending. Will you be able to right the course of time or will planet Earth be destroyed forever? Features: Explore the land of Ahemfie and learn about an ancient African society Discover the backstories of the characters around you Solve innovative puzzles as you assemble pieces of the Tablet of Djehuti Make life or death decisions that influence the course of your story Harness ancient powers and use them to traverse the world
row.short_description: Transported back in time, you must help Tiki, an ancient mech beetle, escape the apocalypse. Your puzzle solving skills will be put to the test as you attempt to collect the fragmented pieces of his tablet which will empower him with the ability to stop any and all world-ending events.

row.name: Pencil Plus: The Wrath of The Spankster
row.detailed_description: In Pencil Plus: The Wrath of the Spankster, you play as Conner, a high school student who gains the extraordinary power to pull unlimited pencils out of his pockets. But this power is not just for show - Your mission is to use your skills and wit to take down The Spankster, a fellow student who has acquired the power to spank others without any repercussions. But beware, as the real harm comes from the public humiliation that the victim is subjected to. As you navigate the halls of the high school, you'll encounter a cast of colorful characters and make choices that determine the course of the story. Will you be able to stop The Spankster and restore peace to the school? It's up to you to decide. With four different endings to discover, each based on the choices you make, Pencil Plus: The Wrath of the Spankster offers a truly interactive experience. Will you be a hero, a rebel, or something in between? The fate of the school is in your hands.
row.short_description: Pencil Plus: The Wrath of the Spankster is an interactive novel style choose your own adventure game in which players take the role of Conner, a normal high school kid that gains a very unique super power: the ability to pull limitless pencils out of his pockets.

row.name: Dungeons of the Obelisk
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Topia! Create a customizable adventurer and explore the mysterious Obelisk and the dungeons that lie within. Add your friends and chat as you play. Engage in turn-based combat against a range of mobs but beware, the battles are deceptively simple but have a hidden layer of difficulty and strategy that will keep advanced players gripped. Collect rare and legendary items from unique loot drops as you level up your paragon infinitely. Purchase powerful buffs from the Emporium to enhance your chances of finding legendary loot. Save up your crystals to get artifacts and companions from the Curio Shop and check out the Tailor Shop for trendy cosmetics. Defeat the formidable Boss of the Breach to collect prestigious set items. Join the leaderboards to see how you stack up against your friends. Meet a host of friendly NPCs to help you on your adventure. Join our community, strategize with friends, and help our game continue to grow with future updates!
