row.name: Simple Video Merger
row.detailed_description: Simple Video Merger allows you to join multiple videos into a single one. Initial videos have to be from the same or very similar source. Two outdoor cameras from the same manufacturer, for example. This limitation gives the application rocket speed and quality. The application does not do any transcoding or processing - you'll get the video in its original quality! And the main limitation is the speed of your drive. Usually, it's just a matter of minutes to join together multiple hours of videos. The input videos are preferable to be recorded onto the same device. You can't merge videos from very different sources. For example, you can't join GoPro's video with a mobile one. Or vertical video with a horizontal one. But the software will help you if one camera recorded several videos, but you want to see them as a single one. The application does not do any effects like transitions, shadows, transparency, etc. It just puts one video after another. But it does it fast! Some Use Cases: Action cameras. Have you had a good weekend and filmed multiple good videos? Do you want to grab all those videos and put them into one? Simple Video Merger is a solution! Outdoor and IP cameras. They do have a habit of splitting the video by some timeline. Usually, the videos there are one minute long. But funny moments in life last longer! Mobile phones. Have you filmed multiple videos on the same phone with the same settings? Just get a single video from them! Game or software development. If you record the videos from the same screen with the same software - you'd probably be able to use Simple Video Merger to join them. The free version allows you to merge three videos at a time. You could always take the result from the previous merge and use it in another one. But haven't you wanted to free up some of your life with this application? There is no such limit in the professional version. Just join your videos with one single click!
row.short_description: Simple Video Merger joins multiple videos together. Take some videos recorded on the same device and merge them into the single one. No setup, no options, no animation, just one video after another with a few mouse clicks! Few minutes of processing for a multiple hours of video. Fast and Simple.

row.name: The Last Pawn
row.detailed_description: Many years ago In a far, far away land, a war began between two kingdoms, the white ones, and the black ones. No one remembers who started it or why. For years the war raged without either side gaining an advantage in battle over the other. But a few years ago, a move that changed the balance of the war caused the enemy kingdom to rush toward their victory. In the years that followed, battle after battle, the number of soldiers decreased, and the force of the kingdom faded. In a desperate move, the king gathered all the last of his soldiers into one last battle that would decide the fate of the kingdom, a battle that on only one soldier managed to survive. The last hope of the kingdom, the last pawn. In The Last Pawn, you will choose the kingdom you want to play as and cross the land in order to defeat the enemy and save the kingdom by yourself. Complete 21 different levels and face bosses in your journey to win the war. row.name: He Fucked The Girl Out of Me
row.detailed_description: ⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀       ⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀  ⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀        He Fucked the Girl Out of Me is a semi-fictionalized autobiographical story about my experiences with trauma and sex work. It’s semi-fictional because it would be too painful and messy for me to write about otherwise. If you are looking for AAA gaming, then it would be better to look elsewhere. When I made this game, I expected 100% of people to hate me. Instead, what happened was many people wrote to me telling me how much the game meant to them. The game ended up being featured in museums and conferences around the world and even won awards. It was shocking to me to have people care and to be accepted by others. I never thought I would ever get to feel like a normal person ever again, but since releasing this game I have found that acceptance. Despite the uncomfortable things in this game, I still think there is value in it existing. I am very grateful to anyone who is willing to play this game. This is a Game Boy narrative game. I consider it to be a visual novel but others have considered it an adventure game. I used Electron to turn it into a standalone game for personal computers. It is approximately 40 minutes long. After a certain point there was nothing more worth saying. The truth about fucked up things is that, after being repeated enough, they lose their impact and become pointless suffering. If you are a gamer, then you understand the impulse to escape to virtual worlds. If you’re like me, you play games to have fun. There are zero fun elements in this game. The fact is, making this game was an act of desperation. The pain from shame was destroying my mental health. I couldn’t talk about the things that were hurting me and that made everything worse. The best way to overcome shame is to be open about whatever you are ashamed of. I didn’t have the courage to say it out loud, so I made it into a game. Some people have told me that I am brave for making this game. I just wanted to make the pain stop. I thought, I’ll make a game, just once, and “Ann” can say the things I don’t feel brave enough to say. If the game was played enough, then I’d be unable to go back to hiding in shame again. The game would just be out there. I’ve realized that a game doesn’t have to be fun or escapist to have value. Games can have value on their own as art in their own right. As a game designer and a human being, if you think you would be able to safely play this game then it would mean the world to me if you’d consider trying it. The game is free. None of the DLC is required to experience the game. It’s a way for you to support the game if you want. Controls: Keyboard: Action Button = Space Bar Movement = Arrow Keys X-Input: Action Button = 'B' Movement = D-Pad Content Warnings are listed in-game.
row.short_description: He Fucked The Girl Out Of Me is a semi-autobiographical narrative visual novel about trauma and sex work made for the gameboy. The author explains how sex work impacted her life and changed her perception of the world. The game takes approximately 40 minutes to play from start to finish.
row.reviews: “Where He Fucked the Girl Out of Me is important is in how it can help you understand trauma. Not just the kind experienced by other people, but quite possibly your own. It’s a subject that is incredibly difficult to both explain and wrap your head around, to the point where a lot of people don’t even try. And that’s to the world’s detriment.” Destructoid - Zoey Handley “He Fucked the Girl Out of Me makes me feel how small our words are. I tried to call the developer’s experience ‘painful’ when I started writing this, but does that word even begin to contain what this experience wrought? Does ‘Trauma’? Trying to distill these intense feelings into words feels like it minimizes them. It cools them and makes them easier to handle. But you can sense the volatility these words contain. The immense darkness inside. My words don’t feel like enough to express what this game made me feel.” DreadXP - Joel Couture “This raw, harrowing and very rough to get through Game Boy game deals with the developer's experience as a transgender woman doing sex work. The trigger warnings are real and the trauma is real. It's possible that this game saved the developer's life, and that's not nothing.” Red Pages Podcast
row.notes: This is a game about the author's experience with sex work. To make it easier to write about she semi-fictionalized it. Content Warnings: Sex Work Nonconsensual sex/ dubious consent/rape Date rape Sex/Nudity Sissification Kink Transphobia Deadnaming Gender Dysphoria Age Gap Abuse Suicidal ideation Blood

You play as Mila, a vampire huntress who secretly fantasizes of being taken and turned into a vampire herself. Her inner conflict is yours to control by either engaging with or surrendering to your enemies to view the game’s vast collection of possible bad endings! (as of version 5.7.1) The game features: -  20+ hour campaign across 5 chapters. - 170  unique pieces of artwork which can be collected for your in-game Picture Gallery. - Over 60  fully illustrated characters to interact with. - Over 20 optional hunting contracts and side quests that feature other monsters capable of corrupting you, such as succubi, lamias, slime girls, and many more! - An alternate Vampire Route - take on an entirely separate story as a playable vampire, if you so desire. - A Bad Ending Theater to view every lewd scene included in the game! row.name: Let's go back to our village
row.detailed_description: Asti is a girl who lives in the small rural village of Taram. She decides to set out on a journey to find her brother Arte, who disappeared a year ago. She is preparing for the journey with Fillio, the best hunter in the village, and Mimi, a traveling medicine seller, when a messenger from the royal capital, Minister Lucar, visits the village. Minister Rukal, a messenger from the royal capital, visits the village. Lucar's purpose is to demolish the village of Taram in preparation for the upcoming war. Naturally, the residents of Taram village resist. So, Rukal calls a man to subdue the villagers. That man is Asti's brother, Arte, who went missing a year ago. The play time is about 1 to 2 hours. It is a simple short story with a lot of RPG charm, including character interaction and storyline, and is recommended for RPG beginners. This work is a port of 'Let's Go Back to Our Village,' which was released at RPG Maker Fes in 2016, to the RPG Maker MZ version. Operation Methods 　Z button: Decide, Fast Forward 　X button: Open menu screen, Cancel 　Cross key: Move character 　Shift key: Dash This is a sample game that uses 'FES Resource Pack'. Only Japanese is supported.

Where is the key to this true story, stored in the Gard departmental archives? It's up to you to find out... But beware, some people are not ready to empty their bag so easily.
row.short_description: In an investigation where the thieves are not necessarily the ones you think they are, follow the clues, question the suspects, and get to the truth by avoiding false leads. But beware, some people are not ready to give up so easily.

row.name: Vivat Sloboda (2019)
row.detailed_description: This Vivat Sloboda is a patched Xbox One version of the game originally released for the 30th anniversary of the Velvet Revolution in 2019. It contains the most significant bugs fixed and a new achievement. We recommend downloading Team Vivat games only from official sources such as this Steam page. What we already had then: An open world game taking place in Bratislava. It dates back to 1989, when freedom was not a matter of course. A small game on big platforms. Price like in the good old days. 😉 Member of the Communist Party As an employee of the state taxi service, you will receive a priority order. A member of the Communist Party of Czechoslovakia needs to move somewhere. He doesn't like the situation in the country very much. After all, young people should not speak to directing the state. Nothing will change anyway. Students requesting change Students feel a chance and despite their fears they go to protest on the Square of the Slovak National Uprising. They take banners from the bed linen and fold up for a taxi. They definitely don't feel safe about Public Security cars.
row.short_description: In minigame Vivat Sloboda, players will experience the period of the Velvet Revolution from the point of view of a taxi driver of the state taxi service, who accepts orders from staunch party officials, but also from students demanding change. Players will thus hear vastly different opinions.

row.name: Space Game: Star We There Yet?
row.detailed_description: Welcome to “Star We There Yet?”, a game about traveling the cosmos, collecting extraordinary crew, and battling with friends and foes alike in exciting merge-conflict matchups! Engaging! A wholesome mix of idle “Catch Some Zs” gameplay and “Catch Them All” combat, “S.We.T.Y?” features a huge cast of loveable and loathsome characters, faster-than-light space travel set to a slower-than-slight soundtrack, and tons of intriguing destinations to discover and then immediately leave behind. Fun to play for five minutes or five hours, it’s the perfect game to play in between other more demanding games! Featuring: A cast of 65 characters to collect, each with their own special abilities and winning personalities. Just so many personalities. A relaxing (and oddly addicting) idle space travel experience. Crank the cosmic-y tunes and tap your ship to get up to max speed. Or just use the auto-tappers. That’s what they’re for. Hundreds of stories and Missions for your crew, as they encounter black holes, super novae, hostile aliens, evil twins, space cows, hair stylists, cosmic horrors, and Larry. A unique Merge PVP battle mode, with highly advanced turn-based combat. Merge ships together to form your fleet, deploy them to attack your enemies, or activate your Crew’s special abilities! Basically unlimited planets and star systems to explore. Well not really - but there’s a lot. Space is big! It’s right there in the name. A super chill soundtrack that will make the lightyears roll by in a contented vibe. Optional in-game purchases can boost your progress (and feed our artists), but the game is completely do-able Free To Play. Just like a real post-scarcity futuristic society! “Star We There Yet?” is a fresh and flavorful blend of different game styles, with a little something for everyone. When fully operational, it will allow players to battle across platforms and continents and probably solar systems eventually. What are you waiting for? Play Space Game: Star We There Yet? and set a course for adventure! (And cosmic horror. As previously mentioned.)
row.short_description: It’s an idle game! It’s a battle game! It’s a SPACE GAME! Welcome to the ultimate interstellar road trip. Travel across the cosmos, collect rare and honorable crew, then use them to battle against friends and foes alike in this unique (and oddly addicting) adventure!

row.name: The Homecoming Exhibition
row.detailed_description: Welcome to The Homecoming Exhibition , a high-fidelity immersive gallery experience created in Unreal Engine 5 with Lumen . Immerse yourself in a fully interactive 3D world of modern art, sculptures, and culture as you explore the beautiful & extraordinary minimalist environment inspired by Hiroshi Senju Museum . Experience the future of art with 'The Homecoming Exhibition' showcasing the groundbreaking work of Nako Baev . Minimal yet modern & elegant I strived to create an open, luminous space where people would observe my works, relax and spend time in contemplation. I took on the creative challenge to design something where people could get inspired and driven towards their dreams and desires. My mandate was to explore how far I could push the quality of a real-time 3D museum for digital art. Listening to our lovely ambient soundtrack created by Evolsound which perfectly fits the gentle and calming sounds of nature around it. If you closely pay attention to the details you could find yourself an easter egg. Making it one unique experience you'll never forget. About the art & the artist: Nako Baev is an award-winning 3D artist who has worked on various projects in the film and video game industry. His current exhibition focuses more on modern, minimal and restraint outlook giving the goal of this type of exhibition to showcase a number of pieces in a way that allows viewers to fully appreciate their beauty and simplicity. The pieces themselves are characterized by clean lines, a limited color palette, and a focus on form and texture they feature abstract or minimalist compositions. The sculptures are made of materials such as Calacatta marble, Ekeberg marble, or limestone. Each piece would have ample space around it to allow viewers to appreciate it fully and to avoid distractions.
row.short_description: A high-fidelity immersive gallery experience that places you into fully interactive 3D world of modern art, sculptures, and culture as you explore the minimalist environment inspired by Hiroshi Senju's Museum. Experience the future of art with groundbreaking work of Nako Baev.

row.name: Мафия шахматы (Жмурки)
row.detailed_description: Desktop mafia online in a new format 1 on 1. There is no communication in the game. You yourself play for the entire mafia team or the entire peaceful team. Among the 15 inhabitants of the house there are 5 killers, find them as civilians, or fool your enemy as the mafia. There are many roles in the game, from which you yourself can assemble a unique composition and come up with your own victory tactics. Compete with other players and increase the rating or play with friends.
row.short_description: Tabletop mafia in a new 1v1 format. There is no communication in the game. You yourself play for the entire mafia team or the entire peaceful team. You have never seen such Mafia!
row.notes: murders are shown

row.name: Mr. Mat Hematic
row.detailed_description: WISHLIST OUR NEW GAME! Mr. Mat Hematic is a short, fun, 2D platformer puzzle game where you must use given mathematical operations to alter the environment so you can move around. To complete a level, you need to reach the black door. Use MOUSE for OPERATION, and KEYBOARD to MOVE There are 4 OPERATIONS: PLUS: Duplicates a green block and you can place it anywhere. MINUS: Removes a green block SQUARE: Doubles the sizes of the green block SQUAREROOT: Shrinks the size of the green block by 2 Features: 12 levels with a unique puzzle mechanic cute art nice music short story with cutscenes level selector level editor PRESS KIT:
row.short_description: Mr. Mat Hematic is a short, fun, 2D platformer puzzle game where you must use given mathematical operations to alter the environment so you can move around. To complete a level, you need to reach the black door.
row.reviews: “I like that guy! He looks like me when I don't exercise enough. This actually looks pretty sweet” GameDev.tv

row.name: Gladiators: Survival in Rome
row.detailed_description: Gladiators: Survival in Rome is an Action RPG with casual survival game mechanics and big city-building possibilities. You'll experience a new type of survival game with quests, continuous open world progression, monthly events and your dumb ways to die not harming your fun level. 🏹 Survival Games, casualized Chop every tree, hunt rabbits and deer, stone and copper mining - resource management are a staple of every survival game, and Gladiators is no different. However, we threw away the hunger games in favor of a replenishing stamina pool so you can start every game session on exploration instead of just preventing yourself from dying. 🏛️ Build your own Roman village From setting up your first camp to building an entire Roman city, you'll be pretty busy making a home for yourself and all the rescued slaves that turn up to settle as workers. Manage their resource refining jobs, build houses and beautify the city with fountains and other decor. ⚔️ Carry a big stick (mind the pointy end) Craft your weaponry from a selection of clubs, axes, bows, spears and more. Upgrade them to make pointy ends even more pointy, embellish your craft with gems and their attributes, and poke around at Roman legions, bandit bosses and other generally unfriendly folk. 🗺️ Explore Rome and its dungeons Dive into dark caves and unravel the story of Proserpina, better known in Greek mythology as Persephone; lead the siege to the stronghold of Castrum, or rebuild the ancient city of Perugia. Learning about history has never been more fun! 📅 Enjoy Seasonal Events Keep coming back for freshly designed seasonal events as they happen: the Winterfest with Teuton wildlings, the Origin of Saint Valentine, Halloween and many more to come. Missed one? Don't worry, we've put them into your game progression and keep them fresh every year. 📱 Put Rome in your pocket Not at home? Experience Gladiators: Survival in Rome on your phone or Steam Deck, fully optimized for the mobile gaming experience. And we're working to make your savegame available fully cross-platform. And many more features to come: Events ⭐ Quests ⭐ Talent Trees ⭐ Coop Building⭐ Mini Games ⭐ Achievements ⭐ Colosseum PVP Leaderboards ⭐ Guilds & Chat As developers of Gladiators: Survival in Rome, we hope you enjoy our casual approach to the Survival RPG genre. We are always happy to get in touch directly with our players and gather feedback - hop onto our Discord: 💬 Thanks and have fun surviving!
row.short_description: Gladiators: Survival in Rome is an Action RPG with casual survival game mechanics and active city building. You'll experience a new type of survival game with quests & dungeons, continuous progression, seasonal events and lots of spear poking.

row.name: Citadale Resurrection
row.detailed_description: Infamy returns - and this time it is free! The dark lord has been slain. But evil forces throughout the centuries have always tried to bring him back to un-life. And every time, heroes stood against them, preventing the worst from happening. And these are their adventures. Set throughout history, their strength, wisdom and courage lead them down into darkness. Can they bring back the light, or die trying? Citadale Resurrection is a collection of old-school retro Citadale games in the style of various systems released in the mid 1980s to early 1990s. Each game has its own unique look, sound, gameplay style and feel. And yet, they are all distinctly Citadale. And, to lure you in, the first two games in this collection are free. Start up and play, no hidden fees, no secret costs, 100% free. Should you like what you get, you can buy the other games as DLC. Five games are available, two are free and three are paid DLC, completing the package. Bringing back the past to forge a future. Strength in Agony This is the tale of a young girl’s struggle to escape the dark halls of the castle after her abduction. This Content Pack is automatically installed when you download this game. It also unlocks the soundtrack in the in-game jukebox. Suffer on Revival The very first Citadale game was released in 2013 and wasn't even a Citadale game to begin with. Discover the true origins of the series in this free revival of the game once called 'Minivania'. It also unlocks the soundtrack in the in-game jukebox. Book of Shadows A journey into darkness begins when the missing pages of an infamous tome threaten to fall into the wrong hands. This DLC Pack unlocks the whole Book of Shadows game as well as its soundtrack in the in-game jukebox. Prelude to War The son of the Dark Lord of the old lands searches for a fitting resting place for his father’s cursed remains. This DLC Pack unlocks the whole Prelude to War game as well as its soundtrack in the in-game jukebox. Darkness my Curse Gabriel Dorleac scours Citadale island for the very first time in search for his missing brother. This DLC Pack includes the full game as well as the soundtrack for the in-game jukebox. ------------------------------- Controller Information: Due to limitations with the engine, some controllers may not work properly. There is, unfortunately, nothing I can do about that. Should you have any trouble with your gamepad, maybe try another gamepad or use the keyboard. I apologize for the inconvenience.
row.short_description: A collection of old-school retro Citadale games in the style of various systems released in the mid 1980s to early 1990s. Each game has its own unique look, sound, gameplay style and feel and yet they are all distinctly Citadale.
row.notes: Contains low resolution pixel-art violence and nudity.

row.name: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2: Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game IT'S GOOD TO BE BACK IN THE BUSINESS! Ship Graveyard Simulator 2: Prologue is back bigger than before and it doesn't matter if you're a veteran in the game or for the first time you will have a hammer and a torch in your hands there are a dozen of kilometers of wreckage on the coast, and thousands of tons of steel - you will get into this business. DISASSEMBLE BIG SHIP PARTS Large ship parts? Oh yes! You will need a special crane and a large container for it. Ship Graveyard Simulator 2: Prologue will have large fragments, modules and wreck components available for demolition, including engines, pumps, control panels, and much more. HUGE SHIPS Order new ships waiting for demolition via the computer in your home, and with the new ship, you will receive a new task! Collect all the necessary steel, aluminum, or copper parts, even a small part has its own value. There will be several types of ships available in the game, which will be divided into individual categories - some of them are real colossi. DESTRUCTION Your main task in the game is to dismantle ships into small parts. Some of them will be small, but a huge challenge awaits you, which will be the disassembly of real giants, and hiring workers who will be able to help you. Use the available tools - hammer, saw, torch, etc. - to disassemble individual pieces of the ship into smaller pieces, collect as many of them as possible and develop your business! DANGERS Remember that you are doing one of the most dangerous jobs in the world and you disarm the biggest shipwrecks in the world, so what could go wrong? In Ship Graveyard Simulator 2: Prologue there are many dangers waiting for you - gas leakage, electric shock from cable, and poisoning with toxins in unsecured rooms. Do you remember about large fragments and ship modules? You'd better have your helmet on.
row.short_description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. Visit the new beach coast with the largest, biggest ship graveyard in the world, dismantle huge ship parts and collect tons of precious steel. Roll up your sleeves, it's time to get back to the business.

row.name: Deckweaver: Descent Into Chaos
row.detailed_description: In the fantasy realm of Alveria, step into the shoes of The Wanderer, a daring adventurer who draws their power from a deck of enchanted cards. However, dark and malevolent forces in the form of Lovecraftian monstrosities have descended upon the realm, spreading corruption and chaos throughout the land. As The Wanderer, you must brave the hostile terrain of Alveria, venturing into the very heart of this malice to purify the shrines that lie within. Your ultimate goal is to summon a portal to The Great Abyss, the shadowy realm from which these terrifying creatures emerge, and confront the Elder Being at its heart. Only by destroying this malevolent force can you hope to save Alveria from certain doom. So gather your strength, sharpen your wits, and prepare to face the ultimate challenge in this epic adventure of heroism and magic! The agents of chaos are powerful and runs will be tough. If you are defeated, rest up and venture out to try again in this First Person Deckbuilding Roguelike . Features: Find and choose from 30+ different cards to weave into your deck of spells. Slay agents of chaos as you battle through different maps and environments, purging chaos wherever it stands. Collect artifacts that alter the way you play and explore. Face off against Chaos itself in an epic boss battle to save Alveria.
row.short_description: Deckweaver: Descent into Chaos is a first person deckbuilding game where the player crafts their abilities using different cards they find in the environment. Obliterate forces of chaos, fighting through corrupt locations in the world before getting the chance to face and defeat Chaos itself.
row.notes: Deckweaver: Descent Into Chaos contains grotesque monsters, blood splatters when monsters are hurt and killed, and bloodstained maps.

row.name: HellFurnace
row.detailed_description: Having encountered a god, you must protect this world from demons. Enter the demons' lair and wipe out the demons before they damage the world! If you dodge the enemy's attacks, you can acquire orbs that can be used to craft weapons. When two orbs are acquired, a weapon is created. Depending on which orb you have acquired, the weapons you can use will vary. You can use your weapon to damage enemies. It is a boss rush game where you clear the game by defeating the bosses you encounter. features 2D side view game Boss rush Avoid enemy attacks Attack by combining marbles
row.short_description: Go to save the world from HellFurnace. HellFurnace is a 2D boss rush game in which the protagonist, who has fallen into another world, defeats the boss. Avoid enemy attacks to collect beads and create weapons to defeat the boss.

row.name: DIGITAL EXORCIST case_(0);
row.detailed_description: Open the door to a world where demons whisper from beneath the glow of the screens. A compact adventure game inspired by Japanese adventure classics like Snatcher, Policenauts and The Silver Case. Join retired Digital Exorcist Sawyer and his trusty sidekick Tomo as they investigate chilling crime scenes. Use your wit to guide conversations and help Sawyer rediscover his old techniques to solve the mysteries lurking throughout your adventure. Investigate Gruesome Crime Scenes Thoroughly explore crime scenes with your trusty computerized companion, Tomodachi, as you collect evidence and equipment to assist in your investigation. Purge like it’s 1999! Go head-to-head with demons, and use items and weapons you find to fend them off! Elevated Experience with Stylized Art Style and Soundtrack An immersive, dark and gruesome setting. Brought to life through charming pixel art and a boppin’ soundtrack produced with classic digital synthesizers.
row.short_description: Step into a dark world where cyberdemons haunt humankind. When mutilated bodies start appearing all over this sleepy town in the Mississippi inaka, Sawyer, ex-AGENCY operative; now unemployed shut-in, must exorcise the demon perpetrator in this story-rich, PC-98 style adventure game.
row.notes: Some Strong Language, Violence and Blood.

row.name: Duckball
row.detailed_description: Duckball is an action-packed battle royale game where up to 100 players compete to be the last duck standing. Play with friends online and collect wacky items to knock your opponents off the stage in an ever changing 3D environment. Do you have what it takes to be truly glorious? There are 2 main gamemodes to choose from: Deathmatch and Battle Royale. In the Deathmatch gamemode, if you get knocked off of the stage, don't worry you'll respawn in a cannon and be launched back into the fray. In Battle Royale, you have only one life and want to knock out all of your competitors. Roll into the items that are scattered throughout the arena and use them to fight and outmaneuver your rival ducks. Try combining various items such as Flight, Boost, and Bullet to become a fly by Duckball fighter jet! Customizable rulesets provide an unlimited amount of gameplay scenarios. Dive into the world of Duckball and discover what other secrets await.
row.short_description: Duckball is an action-packed battle royale game where up to 100 players compete to be the last duck standing. Play with friends online and collect wacky items to knock your opponents off the stage in an ever changing 3D environment. Do you have what it takes to be truly glorious?

row.name: Noah Please!
row.detailed_description: Noah, you have one task : to allow two of each animal onto the Ark before the Great Flood. To do so, you shall be granted the ability to WHACK ! Use it to push animals you don't need away from the ark and knock them out! Furthermore, you shall be modestly bestowed with energy orbs , which you shall use judiciously in your effort to manage the boarding. Watch out for funny-looking animals ; if you see one of those, you'll wanna put it down quick before it starts outrunning ya. Finally, the Minimap will prove a worthy tool at your disposal. Spots are limited!
row.short_description: Dash and whack your way through waves of animals that want a piece of that ark. There's only room for two of each!

row.name: Dual Chroma: Academy Carols
row.detailed_description: Dual Chroma: Academy Carols is a short prequel to our upcoming game: Dual Chroma, a fantasy romance visual novel. Select your magic type, pronouns and name and enter a magical world with other arcane students! Story: Winter break has come to Aradal. Unable to afford the journey back home, you brace yourself for a long snowfall alone at the Magic Academy, only to find you aren't the last student left on campus. What's more, among your newfound festive companions is the popular and typically unapproachable Prince Keldrannon - the last person you'd expect to stay. What begins as a sad and solitary wintertide soon thaws into the promise of something far more precious. Warmth, friendship, perhaps even love. A thoroughly merry and magical celebration may await you, after all. Features: English Visual Novel Multiple endings Fully illustrated
row.short_description: Spend Winter break with the popular and unapproachable Prince of the Empire in this cozy and heartwarming Magic Academy visual novel

row.name: Tales of Rein Ravine
row.detailed_description: In lush alpine mountains and meadows stands the renowned equestrian capital of Europe, a town called Rein Ravine and its surrounding province of the same name. You have been admitted to study in its highly sought-after Rein Ravine Equine University International , alongside with other ambitious equestrians from around the world. This once in a lifetime opportunity leads you to train in the three most common European disciplines - showjumping, dressage, and cross country - under the eye of masters claimed to be some of the best in the world. But is equestrian life in this prestigious village as glamorous as it appears? The Early Access version of Tales of Rein Ravine doesn't contain the storyline yet, but while waiting for the school year to begin, you can visit the barns in Rein Ravine and take summer riding lessons! Tales of Rein Ravine aims to challenge its players with first-of-its-kind riding mechanics and gameplay heavily inspired by real-life horse riding, as well as tell an intriguing story - more mature than typical in its genre - to a young adult audience of horse gamers. Horses in Rein Ravine are versatile to ride, ranging from calm and experienced geldings to hot-blooded mares and easily spooked young stallions.
row.short_description: Tales of Rein Ravine is an indie horse game that aims to challenge its players with unique real-life inspired riding, as well as tell an intriguing equestrian story to a young adult audience.

row.name: World of Mines Creator's Edition Playtest
Memory Land Extreme
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Memory Land Extreme, the game where your memory skills will be pushed to their absolute limits! In this experimental game, we've thrown all notions of 'fun' out the window and replaced it with a singular focus on memory retention. If that doesn't make you want to play this, we don't know what will. Shoot the correct objects: You'll need to remember which objects to shoot in order to progress through the level. Which objects are correct? It's up to you to figure it out! Arbitrary correctness: There's no rhyme or reason to which objects are correct. It's all completely arbitrary, which means you'll need to rely solely on your memory skills to succeed. 4 different guns: Spice up your memory training by using one of our four unique guns to shoot the objects. Each gun has its own strengths and weaknesses, so choose wisely! One thousand objects: The ultimate goal of the game is to correctly remember one thousand objects. Can you do it? Features Remember Boats Remember Vegetables Remember Numbers Remember Tables Remember Sofas Remember Letters If you're looking for a challenge and a chance to push your memory skills to their limits, then Memory Land Extreme is the game for you. Just don't expect to have 'fun' while you're at it!
row.short_description: Welcome to Memory Land Extreme! Can you remember 1000 objects? Do you want to?

row.name: CARTOONITE
row.detailed_description: Are you looking for something new and never seen before? Cartoonite is for you. It offers you a completely innovative sand box racing game experience never seen before. Do the usual games bore you and would you like something fun and competitive at the same time? Cartoonite is for you. It takes you to the discovery of a colorful and fully explorable world in which you can build and collect resources crashing into objects while challenging your friends in multiplayer with a cartoon style. Do you want to have fun in a colorful world and challenge your friends in multiplayer? Cartoonite is for you. Choose your favorite vehicle from an infinite number of possibilities. Decide between offroad, drift with FR legendary cars or choose between all sorts of vehicles. Have fun crashing into objects to collect resources and build your own world. Show your friends what you've built and do stunts with them. Cartoonite is a limitless world full of color and fun. It offers you a box full of tools and toys to enjoy with your friends in multiplayer in this sand box game. Download now to experience the fun: - A FULLY EXPLOREABLE WORLD : you have the freedom to do what you want. You can play with your friends or challenge them to breathtaking races. Exploring a free and colorful cartoon style world. - BUILD AND RESOURCE SYSTEM : A racing game finally joins a survival game. Collect resources by crashing into all sorts of objects and use your resources to build your world. Like any survival game you have to manage your resources well and explore the map to find all sorts of secrets. - ALL SORT OF VEHICLES : You have the option to choose all sorts of vehicles. You can drift with FR legendary cars or get your car dirty with mud from offroad cars. You can choose trucks or supercars. The important thing is that you make them as unique as you are. - MULTIPLAYER SYSTEM : Share your creations with your friends and have fun with them. Race alongside your friends in this survival racing game and become legendary. Download now and enter the world of your dreams through this revolutionary new sand box racing game full of fun and color in a cartoon style.
row.short_description: Choose your favorite vehicle from an infinite number of possibilities. Have fun crashing into objects to collect resources and build your own world. Show your friends what you've built and do stunts with them.

row.name: RagBrawl
row.detailed_description: Welcome to RagBrawl, the new party game on the block that has you grappling, ragdolling, and battling your way to victory! In this online multiplayer party game, you compete as a floppy Tuffling toy, taking on a variety of objectives and challenges. RagBrawl is all about fast-paced, chaotic action. With a range of game modes to choose from, there's always a new challenge to tackle. Whether you're looking to team up with friends or take on the competition solo, there's a mode to suit your playstyle! Game Modes In Infected mode, avoid being 'infected' and turned moldy. Only the strongest players can survive until the end. In Spool mode, the last player with the spool takes it all! Hold onto a spool until the end of the round or get eliminated! Rag Race mode puts players' grappling skills to the test. Race through an obstacle course, zipping from one room to the next, all while avoiding obstacles along the way. Finally, Stuffed mode is a free-for-all skirmish where you battle it out to defeat other players and collect the fluff they drop behind. The player with the most fluff at the end of the game wins! Customization Stand out in the crowd! RagBrawl features a robust cosmetic system to customize your Tuffling toy with hats, colors, and patterns. Show off your style as you battle your way to the top! No matter which mode you choose, RagBrawl is packed with features to keep the action fresh and exciting! Using ranged and melee combat, or the ability to grapple and ragdoll your way around the map, players need to be quick on their feet and creative in their approach to emerge victorious. So get ready to ragdoll in RagBrawl, and show the competition what you're made of! With its fast-paced action, exciting game modes, and endless customization options, it's the perfect game for any party!
row.short_description: Get ready to ragdoll in RagBrawl! Compete as a floppy Tuffling toy with up to 12 players online and show them your stuff in this chaotic party game!

row.name: 天羽传奇Online
row.detailed_description: 《天羽传奇Online》是一款Q版仿3D即时战斗类MMORPG，游戏取材于中国神话故事“后羿射日”。玩家可以身临其境于温馨可爱的东方武侠画风，体验后羿与嫦娥之间凄美动人的爱情故事，通过在游戏虚拟社区中的各种生活，丰富的纸娃娃变装，发型、头饰、衣服、背饰、尾巴自由DIY自己喜欢的造型，超萌宠物、骑宠设计，充满温馨的门派、部落，仿3D即时战斗、队伍群P、部落战争……逐渐成长起来，影响着整个世界的进程发展，成就一方诸侯、天下巨富、武学宗师……
row.short_description: 《天羽传奇Online》是一款Q版仿3D即时战斗类MMORPG，温馨可爱的东方武侠画风，丰富的纸娃娃变装，发型、头饰、衣服、背饰、尾巴自由DIY自己喜欢的造型，超萌宠物、骑宠设计，充满温馨的门派、部落，仿3D即时战斗、队伍群P、部落战争……

row.name: Quacktown Smackdown
row.detailed_description: Quack Town Smack Down is a 3rd Person Arena shooter wrapped in a Goofy Rubber Duckky Toon Theme! Hustle to pick up randomized abilities spread throughout each map to give you an advantage. The Pistol, Bubble Buckshot, Sniper Soaker, Kahuna Kreator, and Whirler all await to give you an edge over your fellow Dukkies in Free-for-All water combat! Soak the competition by utilizing Bounce pads, water abilities, and terrain. The Bubble Bathtub is the Dukkies home turf sporting colorful toys and open areas. Take it out back in the Sandbox with more verticality, tight spaces, and run-and-gun tactics. Don't forget to customize your Dukkie's Hat, Eyes and the very rubber around their squeakers to make sure the lobby knows who the Smack Down King is!
row.short_description: Play as a Rubber Ducky in this 3rd Person Arena Shooter! Utilize squirt guns and water abilities and sink your opponents to become top duck of the tub! Battle it out in the Bubble Bath Battlefield or the Stormy Sandbox. Customize your ducky to make sure the lobby knows who's the Smack Down King!

row.name: Pato Martinez
row.detailed_description: Pato Martinez is a Shoot’em Up videogame set during the Spanish Civil War, thought as a learning tool and to make the history more entertaining. We propose a trip though the most important air battles of the war: El paso del estrecho, la ofensiva de Madrid, la batalla del Jarama, etc. Educational material When you begin each game, the player can watch a cinematic about the evolution of the war, the men that fought and the planes they controlled. Inside the game you can access information about all the forces that fought, planes description, the list of all the aces that fought, etc. All the educational material was reviewed by aviation history experts so that it has historical accuracy. Game After the cinematics you’ll be able to flight with planes like Polikarpov I-16 “Mosca” or the Fiat CR-32 “Chirri”. All the planes that appear on the games are real representations of aircrafts that fought during the war. The backgrounds of each game reflect the environmental conditions on those fights and the other vehicles that fought there like the T-26 or the CV-33. Special features We’ve added a special emphasis on both the music and the graphic style so that the can represent the atmosphere of the war, using music, typos and graphic designs used at that time.
row.short_description: History can be thrilling, learn the importance of the air force during the Spanish civil war, the most important air battles, the pilots that fought and the airplanes they used. Fight through the air around the Jarama, Brunete or Ebro. Learn, at the same time you become a flying ace!

row.name: Fantasy World Souls
row.detailed_description: -MMORPG -Old school JRPG style game -Indie Game -Monster training game -Story mode -Real time CO-OP Battle -PVP Arena -100% animated battle -Chat (Steam Deck Compatibility) Summary of story mode: Something goes wrong in creation and a cosmic battle ensues between spiritual beings. They fought for a sphere called 'Exfera Celestes', which would give unimaginable power to those who possessed it. The struggle was so intense that the veil between the spiritual and material world was torn apart and the sphere entered the material world. For some unknown reason the sphere broke into several upon falling into this material world. That's when a part fell near where the hero was, and with his curiosity he ended up possessing it and receiving some power. Now a spiritual Elder appears to him in visions and dreams and tells him the importance of preventing other beings from getting hold of the spheres. Each sphere that the hero gets throughout the story gives him capabilities such as: floating, breathing underwater, seeing spirits and so on.

row.name: Journey to the Rift
row.detailed_description: In the far north, a strange melody has been luring all manner of monsters, misfits, and miscreants into the depths below. A mysterious power lurks beneath, but to uncover the secrets of this place, you'll need to be equipped with all the wit, strength, and cunning that you can muster, in your Journey to the Rift! Text-based fun for your imagination! Uncover the secrets of a mysterious dungeon in this text-based adventure, where every adventure is different! Establish a base camp, venture forth into the dungeon, and get ready for the many puzzles, monsters, and other strange denizens that await! Tackle each encounter in your own way, with each situation having multiple ways to progress. A different adventure with each playthrough With over a hundred unique encounters, no two playthroughs will be the same. To add even more variety, the residents of the dungeon will react to how you have handled previous encounters, allowing you to discover different secrets based on how you play! The choices you make will have far reaching consequences beyond the dungeon, so choose wisely! Make your base camp, a base home! Between episodes of spelunking you'll need a place to rest and recuperate. Grow your base camp into a burgeoning settlement complete with everything you'll need for your adventures. Expand enough and you'll attract an eclectic gang of characters that can offer their help, while giving you more opportunities for special quests and adventures!
row.short_description: Uncover the secrets of a mysterious dungeon in this text-based adventure, where every adventure is different! Monsters, puzzles, and strange secrets await within, in this quest where the only limit is your imagination!

row.name: SomethingWithSpace
row.detailed_description: A desolate and derelict station has been uncovered. You've been tasked with investigating, only to find the station's automated defenses are still active! Where did this place come from? How is it still... 'alive'... ? In this arcade space shooter, you pilot a ship equipped with bullet-buddies and take on an onslaught of attacks from alien-like automata (and organisms!?). Luckily, your ship is adaptable to some technology provided by the encounter, such as ship repair and weapon upgrades! Don't deploy too many bullet buddies, your ship's hull has only so much material it can use to fabricate mobile turrets! Use the ship's ultima-beam as a way of bull-dozing away much of what stands to hold you back! What lies beyond the veil of space and uncharted territory? Controls: Mouse - Moves the ship Left Click - Primary Fire Right Click - Ultima-beam 1-4 - Spawn Bullet Buddy Left Shift - Speed up Left Ctrl - Slow Down This also helps me get through school! Hope you enjoy!

row.name: Blackout Hospital
row.detailed_description: Blackout Hospital is a game where you play as Vasilis, a nonbinary janitor at Altobuck Hospital. When the power goes out while working the night shift, the emergency lights come on and bask the halls in an eerie, ghostly glow. Bizarre happenings start to occur at the hospital, and Vasilis wants no part in it as they try to look for a way out! Along the way they will fight off mysterious enemies, meet strange characters, and make a few allies--but will any of it mean anything if they can never return home? Blackout Hospital is a story-driven RPG game that contains battles, puzzles, and character interaction. This RPG game consists of 3 different endings: A bad ending, a secret ending, and a true ending. Average playtime is about 6-8 hours! Credits follow the true ending!

row.name: Misteri Rumah Pak RT
row.detailed_description: 'Misteri Rumah Pak RT' is a horror-themed action-puzzle multiplayer game set in a mysterious mansion house owned by Pak RT. Players must explore the dark and eerie corridors, solve challenging puzzles, and uncover the secrets of the mansion to find the keys that will unlock the exit and allow them to escape. In this game, players must use their problem-solving skills and quick reflexes to navigate the dangers of the mansion, as they face a variety of obstacles and challenges that threaten to prevent their escape. The game can be played with up to 4 players in co-op mode, allowing players to team up and work together, or as a single player experience, where players will face the computer-controlled antagonist. The computer-controlled antagonist adds a unique and challenging twist to the game, as the AI is programmed to be highly intelligent and adaptable to the player's actions. The computer will actively try to prevent players from escaping, making the game even more challenging. With a spooky and immersive atmosphere, challenging puzzles, and intense action, 'Misteri Rumah Pak RT' offers an unforgettable gaming experience for players looking for a horror-themed action-puzzle multiplayer game. Whether playing alone or with friends, players will be transported to a world of mystery and terror as they try to solve the mystery of Pak RT's mansion. The game is available now on Steam, so gather your friends and embark on an adventure to escape the mysterious mansion of Pak RT.

row.name: Rally31
row.detailed_description: Rally31 is a small open-world racing game with 12 unique and experimental vehicles. The vehicles are physics-based with each one having a different setup to the suspension system. This adds variety to the difficulty level and driving experience of each machine. The vehicles use a cell shader inspired by the anime Wangan Midnight and the rest of the environment is done in a cartoon style. The level is a chain of islands that are built on a base that is 6 km long and 3 km wide. Each island is fully explorable. You can buy more cars and access your inventory at the player’s house. You can earn money to buy cars by finishing stages. You can get a reward bonus by beating your best time or for completing a stage with a car that is difficult to drive. All the controls are listed in the pause menu that is accessed with the escape key. You can open and close the map with the “M” key. The map marks the start of stages with red flags and the player’s house with a blue house icon. If you get stuck, you can rewind by holding “X” on the keyboard or ”Y” on a controller. If you cannot free yourself with the rewind, then press “R” on the keyboard to reset your position back to the start of the level. The controller can be turned on in the options menu accessed via the pause menu, by clicking “CLICK TO USE A CONTROLLER”. The options menu also allows you to adjust the volume and change the gearbox behaviour from automatic to manual. I plan on supporting and updating this game for the foreseeable future.
row.short_description: Rally31 is a small open-world racing game with 12 unique and experimental vehicles. The vehicles are physics-based with each one having a different setup to the suspension system. This adds variety to the difficulty level and driving experience of each machine.

row.name: Stacks:Space!
row.detailed_description: Stacks:Space is a space-themed base builder card game with rogue-like elements. Buy booster packs to get new cards, discover craft recipes by stacking cards together, create structures, manufacture drones and droids, defend your base from enemies, visit distant planets, and more! DISCLAIMER: This game is inspired by Stacklands, but it is not Stacklands, and it is not a sequel to Stacklands - it is a completely independent project that feels and plays differently from Stacklands. Options and Features Created with Stacks:Engine, a card game framework that is heavily inspired by the Stacklands and Cultist Simulator games ~370 cards to collect and use in Stacks:Space (~370 cards in Stacks:Village mod) ~100 craft recipes (some cards could be crafted via multiple recipes) 7 unique bosses to defeat 1 base location + 12 visitable quest locations (incl. shops) Astronauts / Settlers have trainable attributes: Strength, Agility, Endurance, Intelligence Various scenarios - each having different starting conditions, different end-game goals, or even a different location Game Tutorial included for the first scenario Daily Challenge Mode - an option to have a relatively quick game run with random goals and restrictions each day Modding support Combat Both ranged and melee combat modes are supported (no combat box!). Melee units will move toward the enemy as soon as they see it. Drag your card next to an enemy card (do not stack them!), and you'll see them punching each other. Ranged units will shoot their projectiles immediately. Stacked cards - the ones doing crafts - do not engage in combat, but could be attacked by an enemy card. Some enemies prefer to attack resource cards instead. Modding support Stacks:Space is moddable! The built-in mod management interface allows near-infinite extension of a game. With just a tiny bit of JSON knowledge, it is possible to create and add new cards, recipes, scenarios, locations, and even completely new games. This game is so moddable that it already includes Stacks:Village , a fantasy village sim, as a mod - accessible via the top-right corner of the starting screen. See this youtube video for gameplay details. The comprehensive modding manual is a work in progress, please stay tuned.
row.short_description: Stacks:Space is a space-themed base builder card game with rogue-like elements. row.name: MementoMori
row.detailed_description: “All roads lead to our ‘Goodbye.’” Boasting an epic soundtrack that can turn the world of gaming on its head, and some of the most stunning designs ever seen in a game, Bank of Innovation’s newest title, MementoMori, is finally here! Songs performed by many renowned artists enhance the rich world of MementoMori. *We recommend playing while wearing earphones or headphones. ◆ STORY: A tale of “justice” woven by girls whose fragile hearts verge on shattering... There are girls who many call “witches.” Although they themselves are ordinary, they can wield slightly extraordinary powers. However, when calamity spreads throughout the land, witches begin to be feared and detested. Before long, the Church of Longinus commenced what would be known as “The Witch Hunt.” “Witches are to blame for this calamity. If we kill them, then the calamity will vanish along with them!” Witches are executed one by one. But one day, as madness seizes control of the world, it is suddenly overrun by “Curses.” A country incinerated by hellfire. A kingdom consumed by crystals. An empire purged by the Tree of Life. Such are the woeful desires of those who are called “Witches of Qlipha.” Without any means to defend themselves, nation after nation falls into ruin, until finally— The fractured land is sent adrift high into the sky. Meanwhile, the people have yet to take notice. From within these girls cursed to be witches, there emanates glimmers of hope. In order to save their decimated world, these girls set forth liberating the land from darkness. For they believe that it is the right thing to do... ◆ GAME: ・Play utilizing both easy-to-use full auto-battles and high-level strategy! ・Behold stunning action-packed battles animated using Live2D! ・Harness the “Idle System” to gradually get stronger as the girls fight even while you’re away! ・Unlock tons of content as you advance the story! ・Discover infinite strategic possibilities by combining your wit with the girls’ magical powers! ・Enhance gear to precisely influence how the girls grow stronger! ・Communicate with your friends as you form the most powerful guild in the land! ◆ SOUND: The girls of MementoMori are burdened with cruel pasts and inevitable fates. ・Cry to “Laments,” which sing each girl’s emotions to life. ・Play accompanied with a high-quality soundtrack not bound to the limits of game music. The diversity of high-quality musical compositions heavily intertwines with the perilous world of MementoMori, providing a new and exciting gaming experience. ◆ CV/SONG: Illya (CV Kana Hanazawa) (Song by Daoko) Iris (CV Inori Minase) (Song by Hakubi) Rosalie (CV Sumire Uesaka) (Song by Sayaka Yamamoto) Soltina (CV Yoshino Nanjo) (Song by Koresawa) Amleth (CV Atsumi Tanezaki) (Song by Atarayo) Fenrir (CV Minami Takahashi) (Song by Kano) Freesia (CV Yui Horie) (Song by Sonoko Inoue) Belle (CV Yuu Asakawa) (Song by 96NEKO) Luke (CV Ami Koshimizu) (Song by Ayaka Hirahara) Carol (CV Hina Tachibana) (Song by kurokumo) ...and many more! *The above is the Japanese cast for the game. Voices can be changed from English to Japanese in the game’s settings. ------ Powered by Live2D

row.name: 花火与幽灵少女 - Hanabi and Ghost girl
row.detailed_description: 蝉鸣声中偏远的山中小镇，表面上随和实则却因封建迷信而变得十分异常的镇民。 几年前跟随父母一同来到空铃镇的女主角结城花火，在父母的事故后因为内向的性格被排挤的她如今一个人生活在小镇上，直到在旧校舍邂逅本已死去的“幽灵”。 从各种超自然现象的事件里找出隐藏在绚烂烟火中祭典之下的真相，在这个不同寻常的夏日里，体验此由制作者精心打造的日式像素风互动小说吧。 您或许可以从《花幽》体验到的： 时而有趣轻松、时而紧张刺激的剧情； 经典的日系RPG氛围，多结局分支的攻略； 常常会突破第四面墙的、各式各样有趣的ACG梗； 简单但并不无趣的解密等。 此外，游戏里还存在追逐战、一定程度的猎奇恐怖表现、轻百合、多个分支选项以及一些无厘头的奇怪要素。 通关游戏时长约3-8h左右（因个人游戏速度以及不同分支的收集数量会有一定程度改变）。 共拥有13个因选项分支进入的不同结局（含一个真结局）及13个被怪物杀死的死亡结局。 操作说明： WASD键操控人物移动，ESC键可打开菜单（部分情况菜单会关闭），按下Enter与面前的物体进行互动 F4切换全屏/窗口 在对话时，长按Enter可以快进对话。 游戏也可以使用鼠标操作，但我们建议您只使用键盘。 游戏开始后，除自动存档外，需要玩家向游戏里出现的神秘小猫【米苏】投喂小鱼干，才能进行手动存档！ 关于STAFF 制作人、编剧：怠怠Shina 美术：怠怠Shina、口蘑、愚者吃鱼、王潜、差异君 音效：怠怠shina 本地化（日语）：史泰达 玩家交流群：858937549 （引用素材的来源可详见游戏内的ED）

row.name: SkyIsland
row.detailed_description: Synopsis While trying to make his grandfather's dream come true, An unknown creature attacked Pino, which led him to crash-land on the Skyisland. To return home safely, fix his broken plane, and defeat the monster. The game 'SkyIsland' is an adventure game created by a team of college students. You can use a sword, spear, and hammer as primary weapons and a bow as a secondary weapon. Each weapon has its own identity and temporary skill. You can advance these weapons to make them more powerful. Charming Levels SkyIsland has four islands as a theme Spring island 'Epirus' is filled with blue sky, grass, and flowers. Summer island 'Io' with lush forests and a village of puris. Autumn island 'Thessaly' has unpredictable monster-filled wheat fields and many types of mushrooms. Winter island 'Crete' where everything is frozen and inhabited but only snow golems. Enjoy the game with its fantastic story and graphics! ----------------------------------------------------------------- Sound support - Artive Sound Team(official@artivesound.com) Translation support Japanese : 정재현 French : Félix Lafargue Spanish : Sergi Castarnado Ordóñez
row.short_description: 'SkyIsland' is made by a group of students in a college, quarter-view action-adventure game. Enjoy the wonderful world and beautiful environments as you help the protagonist, Pino, fix his broken plane and defeat monsters to return home safely.

row.name: Class Reunion Chat Room
row.detailed_description: 'THIS STORY IS A WARNING. YOU COULD BE NEXT.' Amy receives an invitation to a group chat set up by some of her former classmates. Its purpose is to reconnect after all these years. But soon more and more disturbing facts about Amy's classmates are revealed, and Amy begins to fear that the people she's texting with may not be what they seem. Class Reunion Chat Room is a visual novel that immerses you into Amy's role by letting you type her predefined chat messages. What you're supposed to type is visible in gray letters. What you are currently typing will be overlaid in black letters. If you've typed everything correctly, then your black text should overlay the gray text perfectly. Press 'Enter' or klick the send button on the right hand side of the text box to send your message. If you're unable to send your message then you haven't typed the message correctly. Make sure not to forget any easy to miss dots and commas. You can listen to and download the soundtrack on Bandcamp. Features Over 5000 words in length. 20–30 minutes playtime. Original music and sound design. Text input system that lets you write Amy's predefined messages. Authentic chat interface and experience.
row.short_description: Amy receives an invitation to a group chat set up by some of her former classmates. Its purpose is to reconnect after all these years. But soon more and more disturbing facts about Amy's classmates are revealed, and Amy begins to fear that the people she's texting with may not be what they seem.

row.name: JUMPWORK
row.detailed_description: [Notice] Please ensure your computer meets the following requirements: 1. You need any headset that supports SteamVR. 2. Please make sure you are using an NVIDIA 3060 or above. AMD and Intel GPUs are not supported at this time. 3. Ensure that the JUMPWORK cameras are connected to two separate, non-shared bandwidth USB 3.0 ports. - Want to have your own legs in VR? - Tired of spending half an hour setting up just to play for ten minutes? - Had enough of the hassle of wearable full-body tracking? - Had already tried non-wearable tracking solutions but feel disappointed? High latency? Unstable and inconsistent? Low accuracy? Only support single cam? Turn around lost tracking? Try the new solution we built 3 years by JUMPWORK.AI: Achieve 360-degree, high-precision, non-wearable full-body tracking with just 1 or 2 depth cameras. • Set up in 1 second • Up to 9 trackers covering your lower body and elbows What can it do? • Show off, dance, and most importantly, ERP or kick whoever you want, whenever you want in VR. • Supports stepping-in-place movement* so you can finally have your own legs in VR. • Offers 3D reconstruction that can be imported into Unity and used in VRChat, or even for reconstructing small objects*. • For studio users, we provide a low-cost solution for recording skeletal data files (motion capture). Note: Features marked with an * are still in the testing phase. Beta versions will be released at anytime and may be unavailable anytime until stable.
row.short_description: JUMPWORK I is back! After receiving a ton of negative reviews, we have returned with our self-developed JUMPWORK I, completely revamped and ready for action! JUMPWORK I is a seamless VR FBT system that requires no charging or wearing.

row.name: Vacuum Warrior - Idle Game
row.detailed_description: The crisp crackle of dust and debris entering your vacuum is the sound of Vacuum Warrior. Suck up ridiculous amounts of dust using overpowered industrial vacuums and robots from the comfort of your desk chair. Take on the world of vacuuming today! Watch the numbers go up in this incremental idle game featuring: Numerous vacuums Autonomous vacuuming agents that do the work for you Tons of dust to vacuum Sell your dust for profit Prestige to explode your gains Upgrade your robot vacuums Hire managers to help you Find valuable chests Unlock achievements Unique game mechanics Unlimited fun!
row.short_description: Vacuum Warrior is a Free to Play incremental idle game. Listen to the crisp crackle of dust and debris entering your vacuum as you vacuum ridiculous amounts of dust. Upgrade your vacuums, idle gains, and robot vacuums, earn achievements, and explore numerous locations in the Vacuum Warrior universe!

row.name: Film Studio Manager
row.detailed_description: Film Studio Manager - a strategy game and management simulation that simulates the business of the film industry. Are you ready to take on the challenge of managing a film studio?
row.short_description: Film Studio Manager is an interactive business simulation game where you manage your own film studio. You need to be creative, strategic and have an eye for success to succeed in the game's business.

row.detailed_description: A very short dinosaur jump when internet is down-like game. You play as a girl which fell down from sky and just try to stand her ground. Press space to jump and you are good to go. features: - unlockable costumes - various enemy type - easy to understand mechanic - require only one button to play - secret boss?
row.short_description: A short anime jump game where you just jump and... well jump

row.name: Virtual Families 3
row.detailed_description: The Mountain Resort is here! Take your family on a trip to this scenic mountain getaway and renovate this old Resort in need of repair into a popular vacation destination! AI Guests will visit and stay at the Resort, so decorate it creatively to give them a unique and enjoyable experience! ADOPT YOUR FAMILY TODAY! Adopt a little person from the thousands living inside your mobile device! In this life simulation game, help them choose a husband or wife and start their virtual family! Make babies and pass the house on to the kids! Help nurture and guide generations, managing your own beautiful family story. DESIGN YOUR DREAM HOME Expand and renovate your virtual house. Your adoptee’s new home has a lot of potential, but they need your help to fix it up! Imagine your dream home and make it a reality. Add bedrooms, a garden, a home theater, or even a game room! Collect decorations to customize and design each room. MAKE A HAPPY, PROSPEROUS LIFE Train your little people from babies to adulthood to take care of their home and make the best choices in life. Encourage them to work on their career and earn money for decorations, necessities, and luxuries. Upgrade your virtual family to be the best versions of themselves. Your little people will send you messages, thanking, pleading, and praising you for caring for them. Don’t forget to check in on them, because they miss you and become very sad! LIFE SIMULATION RUNS IN REAL TIME! Your little family continues to live, eat, grow, and work when the app is switched off. Along the way, there will be many different random events to respond to, all of them adding surprise to this simulation game and unexpected elements to routine, daily virtual life. Find highly varied, unpredictable game play. No two games run the same; the story unfolds differently for everyone who plays it. This simulation game is designed to have a life of its own!
row.short_description: The sequel to the smash hit mobile game “Virtual Families 2” is here!

row.name: Chrono Rift
row.detailed_description: Step into the shoes of a wizard in Chrono Rift and embark on a thrilling adventure to defend the world from monster invasions caused by mysterious spatiotemporal breaches! Join the Breach Hunter Guild and team up with other players online to take on the challenge. With a mix of fantasy, action, and roguelike elements, get ready to unleash your magic and destroy the breaches before it's too late. Will you be the one to uncover the truth behind this crazy phenomenon and save the world? Play Chrono Rift now! Replay the game an infinite amount of time by testing different combinations of spells and effect. Wanna go full DPS? Then get the 'duplicate projectile' effect to multiply your damage! Wanna deal massive damage to a large crowd of enemies? Why not opt for the 'projectile ricochet' effect and AOE spells! Each enemies have elemental strength and weaknesses. Choose your elemental type of damage wisely depending on your teammates and the opponents you will be facing. It is your duty as Breach Hunters to face invaders of different universes and timelines. Determined to destroy your kingdom, an evil entity opens portals to realms where all sorts of evil creatures reside: Zombies, Aliens, Robots, Orcs and even Pirates! Each of these species have their own behaviors and will use different tactics to try to destroy you. Zombies are slows but numerous melee foes. Aliens are fast but afraid of fire. Robots use futuristic tech and more tactical strategies. Orcs are walking tanks who gets close and personal with his enemies. Finally, pirates are... Well they are pirates! Team up with up to 3 other Breach Hunters and stop the evils that are invading your realm! Purchase of this game contains the main game only.
row.short_description: Join the Breach Hunter Guild in Chrono Rift, a multiplayer online coop game of fantasy, action and roguelike elements. Defend the world from monster invasions caused by mysterious breaches and uncover the truth behind the phenomenon. Play now!

row.name: OWLMAN
row.detailed_description: The following is a series of tapes recovered near the Overlook National Park where four people were recently reported missing- a family of three and one motorist. OWLMAN is a retro-stylized, first-person horror game played through the lens of a motorist documenting their favorite getaway. As they proceed back down the mountain and the sun starts to set, it becomes clear something is wrong. Explore an atmospheric open-world forest and evade the OWLMAN, among other threats. Features VHS , retro aesthetic. Linear story taking place across a series of tapes. Infinite Chase Mode : See how long you can evade the Owlman and explore the open world without the constraints of a narrative. OWLMAN is not a you-die-you-lose sort of game. It is sometimes necessary that the characters in the narrative meet their intended fates.
row.short_description: The following is a series of tapes recovered near the Overlook National Park where four people were recently reported missing- a family of three and one motorist.
row.notes: Contains Violence, Depictions of Murder and other Violent/ Disturbing Imagery.

row.name: Thalassic
row.detailed_description: Thalassic is a VR underwater horror survival game where you explore a planet a few thousand years after its evacuation. Venture through the depths of this new ocean world with your capsule communicator George who is on the radio to guide you on your mission. You must take radiation tests every 200 meters you go to ensure that you are not risking your safety and to see if the planet would be suitable for human life to inhabit the planet once more. Encounter different creatures long thought to be extinct as you go deeper and find what lurks down in the depths. You play the entire game inside your submarine and the only way you can move your lever is down. George your capsule communicator will be guiding you on the way to prevent you from getting lost in what you're doing. He will guide you through puzzles such as finding hologram discs and working other parts of the ship. You must also manage your hunger and vitals during the trip. If they get too low, you will die. Food can be acquired through fishing and the vending machine. There are 4 main rooms in the ship that you must use. The first being the bridge, the bridge is where you control the movement of your submarine, it is a semi-circular glass dome so it is also the best view for the environment around you. The radio that George uses to communicate with you is in this room so being in the bridge is the only way to hear him. The next most important room is the research room, this contains the hologram pad which you use to display radiation levels, fishing and many more hologram discs. This is your living quarters and where you spend most of your time on the journey there. It also holds the vending machine which is your main source of food during the expedition. The next room is the engine room, it is where the engine powering the ship is held, there isn't much else in that room but you want to keep an eye on it because it can overheat sometimes. lastly is the ballast tank, this is what controls the buoyancy allowing the ship to go down.
row.short_description: Thalassic is a VR underwater horror survival game where you explore a planet a few thousand years after its evacuation. Explore the depths of this new world ocean with your capsule communicator George. Encounter different creatures as you go deeper and find what lurks down in the depths.

row.name: The Scrap
row.detailed_description: The Scrap is an independent third-person shooter that takes place in a futuristic world inhabited by robots. Meet B9-X, a robot from the scrapyard who turns out to be the only hope in the fight against aggressive aliens. Constant struggle Defeat dozens of dangerous opponents. Dynamic gameplay Jump into the action, use futuristic weapons, move agilely, and deliver melee attacks. Various covers Use covers to avoid getting hit.

row.name: Project Chaos
row.detailed_description: Based in claustrophobic small maps, with reactive and fast paced movement, PROJECT CHAOS boasts a lack of lengthy death timers, transporting you back into the fight instantly, keeping the momentum of the game rolling. Deaths and kills are not recorded and displayed, in favour of a score based system, where bonuses and also detriments can increase or decrease the score. With the goal of the game to obtain the highest score as either a team or a solo player. Jump into chaotic battles with Project Chaos signature mode: Chaos. Where with each life you spawn with a completely different loadout. Use the constant changes to learn new weapons, experiment with different playstyles or just enjoy the bonkers mess the gamemode produces. Or for the more classic players, jump into the normal Team Death Match and Free For All gamemodes, where you can use your pre-set loadout in an attempt to cause as much chaos as physically possible. You can only cause so much chaos with a stick, so Project Chaos only the provides the most powerful weapons for players to wield. With options like: Smart Rocket Launchers, .50 Cal Snipers, Miniguns, Lightning SMG’s, Full Auto Incendiary Shotguns, and much more make up the in game arsenal.
row.short_description: Project Chaos Is A High Octane, Manic & Chaotic, Multiplayer First Person Shooter. Set In 2098, A Team Of Rebels, Activists & Terrorists Band Together With One Goal: To Incite Change. Their Method Of Choice? Chaos!
